Nothing.obtainment: Exclusive to THE LIMBO (1 in 1); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Nothing.description: Nothing is a Basic aura that was officially added on Eon 1-5. It has a base chance of 1 in 1, and can only be obtained in the The Limbo.
Nothing.appearance: As the name of the aura suggests, nothing happens when you equip the aura. There are no effects that appear when equipped, and the name of the aura displayed above the player is nowhere to be found.

Common.description: Common is a Basic tier aura that was added with the game, and has a 1 in 2 chance of being rolled.
Common.appearance: Common consists of white smoke/fog billowing around the player's character. It also adds a white light effect around the bottom of the player's torso.

Uncommon.description: Uncommon is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update and has a 1 in 4 chance of being rolled.
Uncommon.appearance: Uncommon's effects are similar to Common's. Faint, light-green smoke/fog manifests around the player's hips.

Good.description: Good is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update and has a 1 in 5 chance of being rolled.
Good.appearance: Good creates white particles at the player's feet, floating upward and surrounding the player until they eventually fade away.

Natural.description: Natural is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update and has a 1 in 8 chance of being rolled.
Natural.appearance: Natural consists of long, green curved slashes circling around the player, gradually shrinking towards the player's torso until they disappear. The player also emits the same particles as Good, though they are of a green hue.

Rare.description: Rare is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 16 chance of being rolled.
Rare.appearance: Rare grants the player a light blue portal/force field effect around them that appear as 2 discs around the player and is displayed at the back of the player, spinning clockwise and horizontally.

Divinus.description: Divinus is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 32 chance of being rolled and 1 in 6 chance in the Heaven Biome.
Divinus.appearance: |-|New= Divinus surrounds the back of the player with a few different symbols, in addition to granting the player a yellow, pulsating shield at the center of their torso. Like below, Divinus also emits a noticeable number of yellow particles, floating around the player, alongside them emitting from the pulsing shield on the player. |-|Old= Divinus surrounds the player with a bright yellow fog, in addition to granting the player a yellow, pulsating shield, situated at the center of their chest. Divinus also emits a noticeable number of yellow particles, floating around the player. Said particles are similar to that of Good’s, but not exactly the same, as these particles spawn from the legs/lower torso area of the player, and not the floor.

Crystallized.description: Crystallized is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 64 chance of being rolled.
Crystallized.appearance: The player is enveloped in a purple fog, with particles of a similar color surrounding them. Additionally, purple sparks move upward from around the player’s lower torso, accompanied by occasional bursts of violet electricity crackling in the same area. These effects resemble of Good, but re-colored.

Dizzy.description: Dizzy is a Basic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-20 update and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 123.
Dizzy.appearance: Dizzy is a basic aura, with star-like yellow effects circling the user's head and a rotating swirl on the user's eyes.

Rage.description: Rage is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update and has a 1 in 128 chance of being rolled.
Rage.appearance: When equipped, bright red flame spins clockwise in the center of the player’s torso, with a larger flame being emitted from this same area occasionally, dissipating after around 0.5 seconds. A faint red mist surrounds the player, as particles of the same color float upward.

Topaz.description: Topaz is a Basic tier aura that was added in Era 6. It has a 1 in 150 chance of being rolled.
Topaz.appearance: Topaz features a vertical bronze ring that circles the player, similar to Rare, but slightly fainter. This aura also has small bronze particles floating upwards, similarly to Crystallized. Additionally, a bronze hued glow envelops the player.

Ruby.description: Ruby is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update and has a 1 in 350 chance of being rolled.
Ruby.appearance: The player is given a red pulsating triangle, accompanied by square particles of the same color. In addition to this, string-like effects are released from the player, reminiscent of the ones that Natural possesses, but in an inverse fashion.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden is a Basic tier aura that was added in Era 7. It has a 1 in 403 chance of being rolled, or a 1 in 202 chance of being rolled in the Cyberspace biome.
Forbidden.appearance: When equipped, Forbidden takes appearance of a basic aura, with the player standing and having a glitching animation, similar to what Aegis has. The player also keeps their right hand on their face, hiding a blue and white warning symbol. Around the player, a line that says FORBIDDEN⊘ slowly rotates. Finally, around the user, a lot of blue and white rectangles appear.

Emerald.description: Emerald is a Basic tier aura, added in the Era 6 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 500.
Emerald.appearance: A stationary green square appears at the player's torso, pulsing brighter, before fading, and emitting square particles that shrink inward towards the player's chest. Additionally, 2 smaller towers of green squares appear around the player parallel to each other, but fade from the bottom up. New squares, however, are always supplied to the top of the tower, so it never completely fades away. This effect is similar to the whirlpools that Aquatic possesses, among other auras. The aura also gives off green, string-like effects, similar to Ruby.

Gilded.description: Gilded is a BASIC tier aura added prior to the Main Update. It has a 1 in 512 chance to be rolled normally, and a 1 in 128 chance to be rolled in the Sandstorm biome.
Gilded.appearance: The player is given a yellow ring that is constantly spinning around them, emitting a large gleaming effect. A large, golden mist surrounds the player, whilst more golden particles rise from the surrounding ground. More golden particles sparkle come off the player's waist area, similarly to Crystallized, though they are of a different color.

Ink.description: Ink is a Basic tier aura, added in the Era 7 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 700.
Ink.appearance: Ink consists of ink clouds surrounding the player, dripping onto the floor into a large, black puddle, with splatters of the same hue forming around it. While equipped, it will also produce a dark aura. The effect being displayed at the bottom of the player goes from the inside to the outside.

Jackpot.description: ===Overview=== The is a Tier 3 left-handed craftable gear, which increases the player's Luck by +77%, increases Roll Speed by +7%, and provides 77 (+277 if Bank is active) upon rolling a Jackpot, making it very useful for farming. The is crafted in Jake’s Workshop.
Jackpot.appearance: The resembles a slot machine, and features a red lever on the front. On the back, it consists of a screaming yippee, a triple scoop strawberry ice cream cone, and an over exaggerated crying face. In addition, the following images appear in the slots: *The [ Yippee] Meme *The Number 7 *The "[ 😂]" Emoji *A Banana

Sapphire.description: Sapphire is a Basic tier aura, added in the Era 6 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 800.
Sapphire.appearance: Sapphire's most prominent feature is a pulsing blue pentagon wit the middle third of each line removed. Similar to Natural, there are "slashes" going towards the player, except there are more of them and smaller, similar particles exist on the floor. Finally, particles and fog like Crystallized, are behind the player.

Aquamarine.description: Aquamarine is a Basic tier aura, added in the Era 6 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 900.
Aquamarine.appearance: Aquamarine is characterized by a cyan whirlpool under the player, with a blue ring floating above their head. Small cyan triangles can be seen rising up from the floor around the player, as a faint cyan mist surrounds them. The bottom consists of a blue spinning tornado like pool of blue that is spinning from the outside to the inside.
Aquamarine.lore: A gem of an aqua hue, able to survive unimaginable pressure.

Wind.description: Wind is a Basic tier aura that was added in Era 1. It has a 1 in 900 chance of being rolled and a 1 in 300 chance of being rolled in Windy.
Wind.appearance: When equipped, the player is surrounded by a cyan aura alongside a faint cyan light under their feet. Small cyan beams rise from the ground alongside five small, curved rings that rotate counterclockwise around the player, resembling Windy.
Wind.lore: The wind spirit is hovering around you

Diaboli.description: Diaboli is an Epic tier aura added prior to the Main Update and has a 1 in 1,004 chance of being rolled.
Diaboli.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a light red, and a black-colored slash at the center before eventually revealing .
Diaboli.appearance: Diaboli is an aura with small, red, horizontal particles that ascend from under the player. The player also receives a red eye muzzle flare in front of their face, in addition to a red sword symbol that emits a shining aura that also pulses on their torso. Diaboli also maintains a large, red smoke, beneath the player; continuously flying upwards. Diaboli has what seems to be a portal or a fire pit underneath the player.

Penumbra.description: Penumbra is an Epic tier aura, added in Eon 1-23 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 1,010.
Penumbra.appearance: When equipped, Penumbra grants the player a default roblox animation. The player also gets a tiny glint of light in their eye, alongside a chinese symbol for balance, (衡), on their torso, shining brightly, releasing small white particles.

Umbra.description: Umbra is an Epic tier aura, added in Eon 1-23 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 1,010.
Umbra.appearance: When equipped, Umbra gives the play a default roblox animation, the player also gets a tiny, black glint where their eyes are. In the center of their torso, The chinese symbol for balance, (衡), is placed. The symbol pulls in black specks, and the player's body is surrounded by small flickers of black electricty.

Precious.description: Precious is Epic tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 1,024 chance of being rolled.
Precious.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a light blue, revealing .
Precious.appearance: The player is surrounded by a blue aura that emerges from their feet and ascends in a tornado-like fashion, accompanied by blue clouds emanating from their sides of their legs. Precious is very similar to Wind, with its similar color scheme and similar effects.

Hydrogen.description: Hydrogen is an Epic tier aura added in the Boss Raid Chapter 2 update. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 1,111.
Hydrogen.appearance: When equipped, Hydrogen takes appearance of a simple aura. A small fog rises up from the aura's floor and slowly rises up, disappearing afterwards. The player floats slightly above the ground, with a glowing red nucleus at their torso, and a small electron quickly spins around the player.

Atomic.description: Atomic is an Epic tier aura, added in the Eon 1-7 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 1,180.
Atomic.appearance: When the Atomic Aura is equipped, a bright red dot appears in the player's chest, representing an atom's nucleus. A rotating vortex in light blue and red can be seen at the player's base. Blue spheres, representing electrons, orbit the player: hence the name of the aura. It also has a feature. If you move your camera around, the blue part of the aura actually follow your camera
Atomic.lore: It is a tiny unit of matter with a central core and moving parts around it. This is what everything physical is made of.

Glock.description: Glock is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Era 7, and has a base chance of 1 in 1,700 of being rolled.
Glock.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise will play in the background before the top edges glow a dark grey, revealing .
Glock.appearance: The player's left arm is placed on their hip, while their right hand wields a Glock that they hold up in the air next to their face, striking an intimidating pose.
Glock.ability: Shoot — [F] Shoot : The user extends their arm forward, before shooting and moving their arm back from the recoil. This ability can hit up to 40 studs away from the user and deals 20 damage on hit. -This ability has a 15 second cooldown and a 0.25 second windup. -In boss raid the cooldown is 2 second | Melee — [E] Melee : The user swiftly does an elbow strike in front. This ability deals 12 damage on hit, has a 10 second cooldown and a 0.2 second windup. -In boss raid the cooldown is 5 second
Glock.lore: What do you mean by Aura ? It's literally just a Glock-17 !

Magnetic.description: Magnetic is Epic tier aura added prior to the Main Update and has a 1 in 2,048 chance of being rolled.
Magnetic.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as ominous noise plays in the background. The left edges then glow red, and the right blue, revealing .
Magnetic.appearance: The player is enveloped by two spinning rings, blue and red, with both of these rings spinning around their body. Beneath the player, a portal with a blue inner ring and a red outer ring pulsates outward. Occasionally, red and blue lightning forms around the player momentarily.
Magnetic.lore: It's surrounded by powerful magnetic force

Ash.description: Ash is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Era 9, and has a base chance of 1 in 2,300 of being rolled.
Ash.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black, as an ominous noise plays in the background, before the edges glow light grey, revealing .
Ash.appearance: Ash envelops the player with dark smoke, resembling ash, coming out from their body, and flickers erratically as it rises. Beneath the player's feet lies a pool of black ash. Ash's effects are similar to Ink’s and Ink : Leak's effects.
Ash.lore: Everything that is destroyed goes back to ashes ,

Glacier.description: Glacier is Epic tier aura added prior to the Main Update. It has a 1 in 2,304 chance of being rolled normally, and a 1 in 768 chance of being rolled in the Snowy biome.
Glacier.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as an ominous noise plays in the background. The edges then glow a very light-blue, revealing .
Glacier.appearance: The player is enveloped in an icy, light-blue fog, along with a bright white light, with light-blue shining particles surrounding them. Smoke also moves inward towards the player, from below them.

Player.description: Player is a Epic tier aura that was added in Era 9. It has a base chance of 1 in 3,000 or 1 in 1,500 during Cyberspace.
Player.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen becomes black as the edges of the screen glow green and expand, revealing .
Player.appearance: Player features a simple animation of the player moving their arms up and down. It has a custom walking animation that is intended to represent how 2D sprites would walk and move in classic Flash games. Player also features a single green gem that floats above the players head. In addition, a green heart that is depicted in a pixel-like style can be seen in the players chest. Under the feet of the player a green circle appears that pulsates from bottom to top. A green circle made of green lines that are apart from each other can also be seen moving around the player in a circular motion.

Flora.description: Flora is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-7, and has a base chance of 1 in 3,700 of being rolled, and 1 in 1,850 in the Lost Forest biome.
Flora.cutscene_note: The screen will become black as an ominous noise plays in the background before the edges of the player's screen begin to glow green, while the upper left hand corner glows pink, revealing Flora.
Flora.appearance: Flora is an aura with a flower theme, making the user hold blue, yellow, and pink flowers in their hand, it's also seen flower petals that drop to the floor, making a flower shape on the floor with the same colors as the flowers that the player is holding. It also shows a green neon crown on their head with an orange petal, a pink petal and a blue petal. Additionally, green mist is seen around the player, and in their right hand, it is seen a red pinkish and a green mist in their hand. When the player is idled, they move their torso, hands and head left and right.

Cola.description: Cola is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-8, and has a base chance of 1 in 3,999 of being rolled.
Cola.appearance: The player stands in a relaxed position, sweat dripping from their body, while holding the famous Roblox [ Bloxy Cola]. The player also has a faint orange beam that goes through their body, Additionally, some bubbles are floating around the area that later pop, the player also glows in an orange aura and has a tiny swirly pool of orange beneath their feet.
Cola.ability: Upon clicking E (or pressing the ability button) the player drinks a [ Bloxy Cola] and heals 15 HP.
Cola.lore: A sharp, sparkling fizz bursts out across your tongue.

Sidereum.description: Sidereum is an Epic tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 4,096 chance of being rolled.
Sidereum.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black as an ominous noise plays in the background before the edges of the player's screen begin to glow purple, while the upper left hand corner glows yellow revealing .
Sidereum.appearance: Sidereum consists of an orange star that can be seen in the players chest, surrounded by swirling purple and yellow lines. Occasionally, the ground below the player animates, displaying a distinctive purple crack. This aura is reminiscent of Natural, but in reverse; while Natural features strings going into the player, here, the strings appear to emanate from the player. However, the strings are also purple and yellow, like the colors of the font of Sidereum.

Bleeding.description: Bleeding is an Epic tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 4,444 chance of being rolled.
Bleeding.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a dark red, revealing .
Bleeding.appearance: A blood spraying effect emanates outward from the player’s torso, and follows them around slowly as they walk.
Bleeding.lore: Endlessly oozing blood ... Hey, you sure you alright?

HellFire.description: HellFire is an Epic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-28 Update and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 4,776 and 1 in 796 chance in the Hell.
HellFire.cutscene_note: The screen fades to black. After a few seconds, the edges of the screen glow red, revealing HellFire.
HellFire.appearance: When equipped, HellFire places the player on a ring of flames, which slowly spins. Particles slowly float up from the bottom, while a small, bright object orbits around the player, leaving a thin trail. In the very center of the player sits a bright light.

Flutter.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Flutter.description: Flutter is an Epic tier aura, added in Eon 1-14 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 5,000, and 1 in 2,500 in the Lost Forest biome.
Flutter.appearance: Flutter’s appearance consists of a butterfly’s parts/features, thus the aura being based off butterflies. The aura also has a purple fog surrounding it alongside a yellow shining star in the middle of the player as a symbol like Divinus. Beneath the players feet is a glowing yellow light.

Targeted.description: Targeted is an Epic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-21 update and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 5,000.
Targeted.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== starts with a black background and is followed by some red and black stripes fading in 2 seconds later, revealing .
Targeted.appearance: The player slightly shakes, holding an arm up, and one arm across their torso. A red reticle spins clockwise on the users torso, with a much smaller reticle spinning counter-clockwise. multiple red hitmarkers are placed on the user's body, with small, short lasers connected to them. Finally, a soft, red fog surrounds the player.
Targeted.lore: Hunted by the agent codenamed "Shift_Lock," the target is tracked down without mercy. One error in movement, and Shift_Lock will strike instantly.

Watcher.obtainment: Exclusive to THE RADIANT FOREST (1 in 5,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Watcher.description: Watcher is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Radiant Forest Update. It can only be rolled inside the The Radiant Forest with a chance of 1 in 5,000.
Watcher.music_file: Silently Deep Relaxing - Rain on the Skylight Deep Sleep Dream Ambient.ogg
Watcher.lore: A sprite of memory, who wanders the forest. For whom this sprite belongs to, no one remembers.

:Flushed:.description: :Flushed: is a Epic tier aura that was added with the game, and has a 1 in 6,900 chance of being rolled.
:Flushed:.cutscene_note: The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow yellow, revealing :Flushed:.
:Flushed:.appearance: A yellow particle aperture is created around the player by two particle emitters parallel to each other, spiraling upward. Additionally, a Flushed face emoji is displayed as a billboard, overlapping the player's head. However, zooming in close enough to a character causes the Flushed face to disappear, revealing the player's actual face.

Hazard.description: Hazard is a Epic tier aura that was added in Era 7. It has a base chance of 1 in 7,000 or 1 in 1,400 during Corruption.
Hazard.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, an ominous drop beat noise playing in the background, before the edges glow a light purple (notably similar to Lunar) revealing . Its breakthough variant, along with the glow from the edges, includes a light purple star that revolves and slowly expands in the center of the
Hazard.appearance: Hazard has a purple-blue color scheme, featuring arched slashes that rapidly flash around the player, alongside dark smoke exuding from the player's upper torso, presumably being hazardous chemicals. Purple stars emanate from the player's torso, rising alongside the smoke, with a hazardous symbol situated in the middle of the chest.
Hazard.lore: This is a constant destruction of life

Doodle.description: Doodle is an aura that was added on February 14th, 2026 and can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 7,500.
Doodle.appearance: When the player equips Doodle, a yellow scribbled paper crown on appears on their head. There are also two blue stars near player's right arm, and a face with eyes that look like the symbols "> <". There is also a pink doodle flower on player's left waist, and scribbled sun behind a cloud near player's head.
Doodle.lore: Drawn by an unnamed creator who believed joy was just as powerful as fate. With playful lines and imperfect strokes, this aura was sketched into existence to spread happiness and good cheer. When Doodle appears, the world feels lighter as if the universe itself is smiling.

Rekindle.obtainment: Exclusive to THE RADIANT FOREST (1 in 7,500); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Rekindle.description: Rekindle is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Radiant Forest Update. It can only be rolled inside the The Radiant Forest with a chance of 1 in 7,500.
Rekindle.lore: Candles. A light in the dark, A hope in the shadows. A girl lit these in his name, the versions she had lost, thousands of times over.

Quartz.description: Quartz is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Era 7, and has a base chance of 1 in 8,192 of being rolled.
Quartz.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, with an ominous noise playing in the background, before the edges of the screen glow a light pink from the top, and white from the bottom, revealing .
Quartz.appearance: Quartz has a similar pose to Powered and Hazard : Rays, with the only difference being that Quartz floats slightly, hovering above the ground. A neon pink halo rests above the player's head, and two wings of the same color manifest behind the player’s back. Triangular pink particles, reminiscent of that of Galaxy, but slightly less intense and lighter in color, are emitted from the rear of the player's body. Beneath the player, a pink portal-like effect, similar to that of Exotic and Diaboli : Void spirals, its center glowing intensely.
Quartz.lore: A fascinating mineral that can change into various colors depending on the surrouding environment during mining.

Honey.description: Honey is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-5, and has a base chance of 1 in 8,335 of being rolled.
Honey.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black, with an ominous noise playing in the background, before the edges of the screen glows yellow from the top and orange from the bottom, revealing .
Honey.appearance: When equipped, a beehive is placed on the player's head, with small black particles flying around the hive, representing bees. A trail of honey flowing from the hive can be seen on the player's neck. The player's hands are also covered in honey, and in the right hand there is a catching net made of a wooden stick and a fabric net. A yellow portal also appears beneath the player, pulsing from the inside out, leaving small streaks behind. There are also tiny yellow particles that can be seen floating around the player.
Honey.lore: Sticky honey with a sweet fragrance drenches your body. Be careful not to get stung by bees.

Lost_Soul.description: Lost Soul is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Era 9, and has a base chance of 1 in 9,200 of being rolled.
Lost_Soul.cutscene_note: Lost Soul's opening consists of a black screen that has blue light expanding from the sides with white on the top, revealing Lost Soul.
Lost_Soul.appearance: Lost Soul is a wispy, blue aura with a flame-like effect that emanates from and swirls around the player. Its floor aura is a radiant, bright blue circle, that gradually fades in brightness and intensity as it moves away from the player. The player appears curled up in a ball-like position with a white star briefly flashing above them. Additionally, small white stars are emitted and float around the player.
Lost_Soul.lore: A pitiful soul that has been wandering nearby.

Atomic_Ribonucleic.description: Atomic : Ribonucleic is a Epic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-8. It is a mutation of Atomic and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 9,876.
Atomic_Ribonucleic.appearance: Atomic : Ribonucleic takes appearance similar to DNA. A sphere is formed on the player's torso which also has three neon orbs orbiting it, and the player's hands are also covered in DNA-like effect. Some chemical formulas are appearing around the player. There is also a swirly portal that appears beneath the players feet. The two arms of the player are surrounded by a spring-like coil.
Atomic_Ribonucleic.lore: The chemical compounds of Ribonucleic Acid form a helix around your body.

★.obtainment: Exclusive to DREAMSPACE (1 in 100); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
★.description: ★, also known as LUCIDITY or 1 Star, is an Unique tier aura that was added in Eon 1-2. It can be rolled in the Dreamspace biome with a chance of 1 in 100.
★.appearance: |-|New= ★ gives the player a pink aura rising from a magenta square-shaped portal effect on the floor, which has a rising square effect, very similar to Virtual. There's also a bright pink star glowing in the player's chest, also being similar to Virtual. The player gains a pink halo on top of their head, similar to Quartz, while also having a repeatingly growing magenta star effect behind them. Lastly, ★'s title glow in a pink light, with the word " LUCIDITY " behind the title, similar to Hyper-Volt : Ever-Storm, Morning Star, or the other two star auras (★★ & ★★★). |-|Old= ★ has nothing except for its title, a 5-pointed star on the top of the player. The star radiates a vibrant pink glow with a pink-to-white vertical gradient coloring in the star. The star also has a thick black outline. ★ also does not display its rarity along with its title.
★.lore: I found myself in a [PLACE??] with no beginning or end, a [PLACE??] that exists in nonexistence. Was I lost? Or perhaps it would be fate that would lead me here....

Undead.description: Undead is a Unique tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 12,000 chance of being rolled and 1 in 2,000 chance in the Hell.
Undead.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, dropbeat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a dark green star, that slowly expands before the edges glow dark green, revealing . It' Native rarity will just feature the black screen
Undead.appearance: This aura features a bright green color scheme, and it shows the player holding a crucifix with it’s hand behind it.Additionally, there are green dots floating with a black hole-like circle spreading across the aura.The player also looks like it is sitting with green thick lines in the players arm and feet.The crucifix is also traced light green.

Corrosive.description: Corrosive is a Unique tier aura added in the Era 7 Update. It has a 1 in 12,000 chance of being rolled, and a 1 in 2,400 chance of being rolled in the Corruption biome.
Corrosive.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, drop beat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a purple star, that slowly expands before the edges glow purple revealing . Its native rarity only features the black screen with no sta
Corrosive.appearance: Corrosive features a portal-like circle beneath the player, swirling as its violet center glows intensely. A purple haze envelops the player, as tiny, light-purple particles are released momentarily from the portal, similar to that of Nautilus, but recolored. It has no animation when idle or walking, similar to many other auras.

Kawaii.description: Kawaii is a Unique tier aura that was added on the Eon 1-18. It has a base chance of 1 in 12,300.
Kawaii.appearance: A cute pink floor is below the player. The player has a hair ribbon and a heart on their chest.

Rage_Heated.description: Rage : Heated is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 2, seen after clicking on Rage. It has a 1 in 12,800 chance of being rolled and is a mutation of Rage.
Rage_Heated.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as dropbeat noise plays, extending the entirety of the cutscene. A red star appears in the center, revolving while slowly expanding. The edges of the screen then glow red, revealing .
Rage_Heated.appearance: The player is surrounded by a smoking orange fire, with concentrated fiery energy pulsing from their chest, spinning clockwise, closely resembling the regular Rage's red energy. An orange smoke also comes up from the fire.

Ink_Leak.description: Ink : Leak is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 7, seen after clicking on Ink. It has a 1 in 14,000 chance of being rolled and is a mutation of Ink.
Ink_Leak.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, dropbeat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a dark grey star, that slowly expands before the edges glow black, revealing .
Ink_Leak.appearance: The player is splashed rapidly with ink, so much so that their body is almost entirely obscured by this inky effect, transforming them into what appears to be a formless black blob. Simultaneously, the player's eyes emit an eerie, glowing white light, adding a sort of illumination to their concealed form. Only for a brief moment can the player's actual body be seen.
Ink_Leak.lore: "When you paint it all black , beware of LEAKS ."

Powered.description: Powered is a Unique tier aura that was added in the Era 7, and has a base chance of 1 in 16,384 of being rolled.
Powered.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, drop beat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a white star, that slowly expands before the edges glow white, revealing .
Powered.appearance: Powered creates white, smoke-like effects around the player; both airborne and on the ground, while they extend their arms in an outwards-facing position, leaning back slightly. This is the same pose as Hazard : Rays. The smoke-like effects move at a rapid pace, resembling waves of energy flowing off of the player.
Powered.lore: I feel like I've become more powerful!

Gilded_Crowned.description: Gilded : Crowned is a Unique tier aura that was added in Eon 1-21. It has a base chance of 1 in 20,000, or 1 in 5,000 during Sandstorm.
Gilded_Crowned.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === begins with an orange star as a dropbeat sound plays, with the star similar to that of . As the star expands, the background glows dark orange, before revealing .
Gilded_Crowned.appearance: When equipped, Gilded : Crowned takes the appearance of an aura with a mostly golden color, similar to it's original counterpart, Gilded. The player stands in a bold pose, keeping their arms on their waist. The player also gains a bright, spinning, golden crown on their head, as well as even larger crown around their torso. Finally, the aura's floor consists of golden, almost sand-like particles, with many coin particles rising from the floor, quickly traveling to the aura's top, and then disappearing.
Gilded_Crowned.lore: A shiny crown for someone special!

Marsh.description: Marsh is a Unique tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-21 update, and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 25,000, and 1 in 12,500 in the Lost Forest biome.
Marsh.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A dark green star appears with a drop beat sound, encapsulating the center of the screen. As it expands, the background turns dark green with a slight black blur across the center of the screen, before revealing .
Marsh.appearance: When equipped, Marsh takes appearance of a simple aura, with the player standing in a middle of moving, grass-like effect. A lantern is held in their right hand, which they slowly rock from one side to the other.
Marsh.lore: ‘‘Streams of water will flow through the desert; the burning sand will become a lake, and dry land will be filled with springs. Where jackals used to live, marsh grass and reeds will grow.’’ -『A collection of my Verses』By [???]

Copper.description: Copper is a Unique tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-7, and has a base chance of 1 in 29,000 of being rolled.
Copper.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen suddenly fades to black. An orange, four-pointed star appears, spinning clockwise. As it expands, the edges glow orange, before revealing .
Copper.appearance: When equipped, an orange-red vortex appears beneath the user, rotating from the outside in. Lightning flashes around the user, also orange, appearing and disappearing at short intervals. A light orange mist with small particles can also be seen, slightly enveloping the user. The chemical symbol of copper (Cu) can be seen on the user's torso, along with a solid bar of copper being held in their right hand. A copper coil can be seen floating behind the left shoulder of the user.
Copper.lore: It is the oldest metal ever handled by civilization.

Watt.description: Watt is a Unique tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-5, and has a base chance of 1 in 32,768 of being rolled.
Watt.appearance: When the Watt Aura is equipped, the player is enveloped in lightning that flickers around the player. The player's eyes glow light blue, and two streaks appear, one for each eye. These move from the inside out, emitting a glowing aura.
Watt.lore: You feel a thrilling surge of electric energy coursing through your body.

Aquatic.description: Aquatic is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 1, and has a 1 in 40,000 chance of being rolled.
Aquatic.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a drop beat noise plays, extending the entirety of the cutscene. A light blue star forms in the center, revolving while slowly expanding. The edges then glow light blue, revealing .
Aquatic.appearance: Aquatic surrounds the player with two rotating whirlpools, both in a blue hue, emitting small blue particle effects behind them as they rotate. Beneath the player,a blue portal pulses outward, accompanied by thin blue lines shooting up. Another notable detail of Aquatic is the small "aquatic" star in the middle of the player's torso, surrounded by small rotating lines.
Aquatic.lore: It represents the flow of water

Solar.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Solar.description: Solar is a Unique tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 50,000 chance of being rolled and 1 in 5,000 chance in the Daytime.
Solar.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a light orangish-yellow, revealing . Its breakthrough variant, instead of the glow from the edges, includes an orange and yellow star that will slowly expand before revealing .
Solar.appearance: Solar features a bright symbol above the player, symbolizing the sun, alongside yellow, hazy clouds. It also includes 5 bright yellow, sword-like beams, equally spaced out, that circle around the player’s torso, as well as a swirling pool of fire beneath the player’s feet. In contrast to its "opposite" Lunar, Solar also displays small, spinning fire particles around the player.
Solar.lore: It was made with Sunshine by an Unknown being on a bright day.

Lunar.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Lunar.description: Lunar is a Unique tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 50,000 chance of being rolled and 1 in 5,000 chance in the Nighttime.
Lunar.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a light purple, revealing . Its breakthrough variant, instead of the glow from the edges, includes a light purple star that will slowly expand before revealing .
Lunar.appearance: Lunar features a crescent moon, with purple, hazy clouds floating atop the player's head. It also includes stars, that appear to move from dot to dot around the torso, appearing to be a constellation, with a swirling pool of purple and blue mist beneath the player’s feet.
Lunar.lore: It was made with Moonlight by an Unknown being on a quiet night.

Starlight.description: Starlight is an Unique tier aura that was added in Era 6. It has a base chance of 1 in 50,000 or 1 in 10,000 during Starfall.
Starlight.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a light blue, revealing . Its breakthrough variant, instead of the glow from the edges, includes a light blue star that will slowly expand before revealing .
Starlight.appearance: Starlight has a bluish tint. A portal-like effect swirls beneath the player's feet, emitting two circling, gleaming beams similarly to :Flushed:, but recolored in a light-blue hue. Inside the player, a star pulls bluish strands of light towards it. Particles in the shape of stars and white circles, likely small moons, also fall around the player as they levitate, oscillating with all limbs pointing down, appearing to gaze at the sky.
Starlight.lore: This starlight with mysterious powers infused will follow you persistently, illuminating the path.

StarRider.description: StarRider is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 8.5. It has a base chance of 1 in 50,000, or 1 in 10,000 during Starfall.
StarRider.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a light orange-ish yellow gradient going into the middle, revealing . Its breakthrough variant, includes a yellowish star spinning clockwise that will slowly expand before revealing .
StarRider.appearance: StarRider allows the player to ride atop a star, leaning back slightly in order to maintain their balance. The star glows with a bright yellow hue, leaving behind a trail of the same color as it moves. Additionally, star-like particles are ejected from the star near the player.
StarRider.lore: A little friend who will join you on a wonderful trip

Pleiades.obtainment: Exclusive to SINGULARITY (1 in 65,358); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Pleiades.description: Pleiades is an Unique rarity aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It can only be rolled inside the Singularity biome with a chance of 1 in 65,358.
Pleiades.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A blue star appears in the center of the cutscene. As it expands, the upper half of the background glows blue, before revealing .
Pleiades.appearance: When equipped, Pleiades takes appearance of mostly basic aura, with a light blue color scheme. Around the player, a lot of star-like begin to appear, slowly rotating. All of them are seemingly connected to the player's torso via light blue beams. The aura's floor consists of a lot of light-blue particles, with some of them forming a pool-like flor.
Pleiades.lore: A star cluster which had roomed the universe collecting stars until it was taken by The Singularity.

Flushed_Lobotomy.description: Flushed : Lobotomy is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 2 that apppears after clicking on :Flushed:. It has a 1 in 69,000 (Formerly 1 in 69,740) chance of being rolled. It is a mutation of :Flushed:.
Flushed_Lobotomy.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen will turn black, a drop beat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a golden star, that slowly expands before the edges glow golden, revealing .
Flushed_Lobotomy.appearance: Flushed : Lobotomy modifies the default :Flushed: Emoji that appears on the player's head to the Geometry Dash Normal Difficulty face. It replaces the original spiraling effect with a fire effect emanating from the player's head.

Hazard_Rays.description: Hazard : Rays is a mutation of Hazard. It is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 7, It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 70,000 breakthrough or with a chance of 1 in 1 in 14,000 if Corruption or Glitched.
Hazard_Rays.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a dropbeat noise plays, continuing throughout the cutscene, playing in the background. A purple star in the center of the screen rotates while slowly expanding, as the edges glow purple, revealing .
Hazard_Rays.appearance: Hazard : Rays surrounds the player with blue slashes and creates a hazard symbol in the middle of their torso. The hazard symbol that Hazard : Rays possesses appears to be the same as the one that Hazard has, the only difference being that it is slightly darker and closer to blue than purple. A shadow-like fog steams from the top of the player, and tiny stars and dots are also emitted from their chest. Additionally, a blue circle pulsates underneath the player in an erratic fashion, with periwinkle spikes manifesting on the ground.
Hazard_Rays.lore: This is a constant destruction of life

Nautilus.description: Nautilus is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 1, and has a 1 in 70,000 chance of being rolled.
Nautilus.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, dropbeat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a light bluish purple star, that slowly expands before the edges glow light blue revealing .
Nautilus.appearance: Nautilus gives the player a cobalt/azure-colored chain, extending towards the middle of the player's torso. The player's torso is enveloped by smaller chains in a cross pattern, and similar chains wrap around the player's forehead and neck. Beneath the player, there is a backwards-moving ocean current effect, seemingly held in place by a large chain behind the player. Additionally, the aura creates an oceanic gas-like effect, accompanied by air bubbles and glowing dots, all flowing upward from around the feet of where the player is. Additionally, a cobalt light shines down upon the player from an angle.
Nautilus.lore: A small shout resounding from the depths of the abyss ..

Permafrost.description: Permafrost is a Unique tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 73,500 chance of being rolled and 1 in 24,500 chance in the Snowy.
Permafrost.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, dropbeat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a teal star, that slowly expands before the edges glow light teal, revealing . It still has the same cutscene regardless if it was rolled
Permafrost.appearance: Ice spikes appear below the player's feet which are light blue and white, filled with the Roblox fire asset colored appropriately, creating an icy fog effect around them. A large, yet thin horizontal square, that is colored the same as the ice spikes, rotates around the player as well.
Permafrost.lore: You can find it in the cold lands throughout the year, unaffected by the seasons.

Pulsar.obtainment: Exclusive to SINGULARITY (1 in 83,345); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Pulsar.description: Pulsar is an Unique rarity aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It can only be rolled inside the Singularity biome with a chance of 1 in 83,345.
Pulsar.appearance: When equipped, Pulsar takes appearance of an aura with mostly deep-blue color scheme. The player appears to be floating above the ground, keeping their arms close to a bright star. A small star appears to be slowly spins slightly above the player's head, as well as an identical star spinning close to the aura's floor. Finally, the aura's floor appears to be resembling a whirlpool, with a bright part at the middle.

Constella.obtainment: Exclusive to SINGULARITY (1 in 86,988); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Constella.description: Constella is an Unique rarity aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It can only be rolled inside the Singularity biome with a chance of 1 in 86,988.
Constella.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A purple star similar to appears. As the star expands, the lower half of the background glows purple, before revealing .
Constella.appearance: When equipped, Constella takes appearance of mostly basic aura, with rocks and random purple triangles flying around the player, as well as some purple, star-like particles appearing all around the player. Lastly, the aura's floor is a bright purple color, with some more purple particles rising out from it.
Constella.lore: A space cluster which sits at the edge of the universe, it is discovered when it was taken in by The Singularity.

Flow.description: Flow is a Unique tier aura that was added in Eon 1-7. It has a base chance of 1 in 87,000 or 1 in 29,000 during Windy.
Flow.appearance: The player is slightly floating in the air, with a light blue (with white accents) snowflake is orbiting around them. The player also seems to be holding a gleaming light in their right hand, which they move around every approx. 4 seconds. The aura presents a constant splash effect underneath the player. On top of the player there appear to be 6 floating wiggly lines, which move in a slightly angled manner from the top right to the bottom left, with various dots appearing on the lines. The aura, finally, presents two flowers next to the title, one to the right of it and the other to the left.
Flow.lore: It feels as though a calm and peaceful melody is drifting around you.

Stormal.description: Stormal is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 1. It has a base chance of 1 in 90,000 or 1 in 30,000 during Windy.
Stormal.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, dropbeat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a grey star, that slowly expands before the edges glow grey, revealing . It still has the same cutscene regardless if it was rolled at Na
Stormal.appearance: Stormal surrounds the player with a stormy cloud above their head, with wind particles emitting upwards toward the cloud. A gust of wind swirls around the player, resembling a tornado. Additionally, the player is enveloped by small white snowflakes that move upwards towards the cloud, along with the wind.
Stormal.lore: An enormous storm raging around you.

★★.obtainment: Exclusive to DREAMSPACE (1 in 1,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
★★.description: ★★, also known as ARCADIA or 2 Stars, is a Legendary tier aura that was added in Eon 1-2. It can be rolled in the Dreamspace biome with a chance of 1 in 1,000.
★★.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The opening for is very basic. It starts out with the screen fading to black with foreboding music. Shades of pink vignette slowly fades into screen before ending off with a gradient of pink colored flash.
★★.appearance: |-|New= ★★ has a glowing pink star at the top, with two smaller five-pointed stars connected to the larger one. Under the player, there is a transparent box and a hollow five-pointed star. The player is also floating above the ground, with beams on their arms and legs, and they have the same star from below attached to their back. |-|Old= ★★ has nothing except for two 5-pointed stars on the top of the player. The stars radiate a vibrant pink glow with a pink-to-white vertical gradient coloring in the stars. The stars also have a thick black outline.
★★.lore: I began to feel dazed, as if I wasn't there to begin with, was it all just a [DREAM]? Or is it all real? I was in a trance, an uncertainty...

Fault.obtainment: Exclusive to GLITCHED (1 in 3,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Fault.description: Fault is a Legendary tier aura that was added in Eon 1. It can be rolled in the Glitched biome with a chance of 1 in 3,000.
Fault.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as an ominous noise plays in the background before the edges glow a light green color, revealing .
Fault.appearance: Fault consists of green glitchy particles, somewhat similar to Matrix. Electricity and numbers in the style of a digital analog constantly manifest momentarily around the player. Stretched out glitchy particles appear at the player's torso and near the bottom of the player's feet is a green warning symbol that constantly jitters. In addition to the particles, the player's limbs and torso may randomly vanish in a glitch-like way and reappear in quick succession, as well as shaking slightly every one to two seconds.

Content_Deleted.obtainment: Exclusive to GLITCHED (1 in 4,040); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Content_Deleted.description: Content Deleted is an aura that was added in the Eon 1-17 Update, made obtainable in the Eon 1-29 Update. It can be rolled in the Glitched biome with a chance of 1 in 4,040.
Content_Deleted.appearance: The player's face is obstructed by an inverted version of the roblox Content Deleted image, a white halo can be seen around the head. The left half of the player's body transitions into black and white shapes and noise, a dark fog and long white streaks can be seen coming from the player's back.

Exotic.description: Exotic is a Legendary tier aura that was added with the game, and has a 1 in 99,999 chance of being rolled.
Exotic.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen becomes black and a dropbeat plays, extending the entirety of the cutscene. In the center, there is a greenish blue star that slowly expands before the edges glow rainbow revealing after a white cracking screen sequence.
Exotic.appearance: Exotic comprises multiple thin lines rotating around the player in circular motion, showcasing rainbow colors. Above the player is a giant rainbow portal, with a rainbow beam from the player extending up to it, the beam is also flickering. A rainbow wing is also seen behind the left half of the player's torso. Inside of the player's torso is a bolded question mark, the question mark flashing similarly to the X obscuring the player’s face in Undefined. Another detail of Exotic is under the player that is only able to be seen mid-air is a green, fog-like ball under their feet.
Exotic.lore: Nobody knows where it originates from, and how old it is.

Diaboli_Void.description: Diaboli : Void is a Legendary tier aura that was added in Era 2, seen after clicking on Diaboli, and has a 1 in 100,400 chance of being rolled. It is a mutation of Diaboli.
Diaboli_Void.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, dropbeat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a dark reddish pink star, that slowly expands before the edges glow the same color, revealing after a white cracking screen sequence.
Diaboli_Void.appearance: Diaboli : Void consists of a purple, V-shaped icon in the middle of the player's torso, which pulses its color and shape. The user's right arm is used to cover their face, similarly to that of Stormal : Hurricane. A thick, bright purple mist surrounds the upper half of the player, as a purple-and-black portal revolves about them. The portal also gives off thin, black, white and purple lines, that travel upward. Purple stars also sparkle around the player, flashing for a split second, before disappearing.

Comet.description: Comet is a Legendary tier aura that was added in Era 2. It has a base chance of 1 in 120,000 or 1 in 24,000 during Singularity.
Comet.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a dropbeat noise plays, extending throughout the cutscene. In the center of the screen lies a gray-slate star, which revolves while slowly expanding. The edges of the screen then start to glow the same color, then a white screen cracks, revealing .
Comet.appearance: Comet features a disc-shaped comet that orbits around the player, leaving a white trail in its wake. The player hovers above the ground, a light star partially obscuring their eye in a similar fashion to Diaboli. Additionally, a white, almost fog-like aura, is emitted from the player's body, with small particles also being produced. A monochrome portal appears below the player’s feet, erratically pulsating and emitting white fog.
Comet.lore: People believe that it has the capabilities to make wishes come true .

Divinus_Angel.description: Divinus : Angel is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-7. It is a mutation of Divinus and can be rolled with a breakthrough chance of 1 in 120,000 and a native chance of 1 in 24,000 in the Heaven biome.
Divinus_Angel.appearance: The player has two golden wings flapping simultaneously, similarly to the one in which Archangel possesses, with the difference being the wings are extending towards the sky, instead of covering and uncovering the player. Additionally, they also have a four-pointed star on their end, with a golden trail following each of the aforementioned stars and four-pointed star particles emitting from them. Meanwhile, the player also has an angel crown, very likely be referencing the fact that the aura represents an angel, which is in its name, and two four-pointed stars spinning around the player, also leaving a golden trail. The player also has detailed shield on their torso and particles emitting beneath the player, probably representing a sense of holiness. Also, the player has golden rays emitting from above them, seemingly to represent, yet again, a sense of holiness. Finally, the player has two circles, representing the effect of holy light on the viewer's eyes and has particles, emitting from the ground, adding more to the holy side of the aura.

Jade.description: Jade is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Era 6, and has a base chance of 1 in 125,000 of being rolled, or 1 in 62,500 in The Radiant Forest biome.
Jade.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as dropbeat noise plays, extending the entirety of the cutscene. In the center of the screen lies a green star that revolves while slowly expanding.The edges then glow green, revealing after a white cracking screen sequence.
Jade.appearance: The player is surrounded by a swirling mixture of greenish-black mist, emanating from the ground beneath them. Sparkling green stars and particles, resembling nebulae, radiate from their avatar. Below them, a small, circular ripple emits gentle green waves. Adorned with a wispy green scarf similar to Bloodlust's, the player’s arms extend towards the right, while they float above the ground, bouncing slightly up and down.
Jade.lore: This, is the name of a legendary man who approaches ones lost in the vast forest and gives directions. He is kind, and knows the forest better than anyone else. But one day, he stopped showing himself to people. Where did he go?

Spectre.description: Spectre is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-2, and has a base chance of 1 in 140,000 of being rolled.
Spectre.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === During opening animation, player's screen turns black with grey and dark blue blue star in the middle, slowly rotating and gaining momentum, eventually getting close to player's screen and the corners of the player's screen start to glow a darkish blue color, eventually cutting the screen to wh
Spectre.appearance: Spectre consists of the player holding a dark scythe. The scythe has a center piece that resembles an eye. At the bottom of the player is a whirlpool of dark and light blue smoke that moves in a circular movement. Around the player there are three tiny ghosts that circle around the players torso. The player itself emits a dust-like aura and the left eye of the player shines in a light blue tone. Around both wrists of the player there are rotating chains with ancient symbols on them. When walking the player walks in a way similar to a zombie, while swinging his left arm and moving the scythe in his hand a bit.
Spectre.ability: Upon pressing F, the user raises their scythe, building momentum before spinning while slashing left to right, hitting and dealing damage to anyone in front. When a player gets hit by the scythe slash, they will take 25HP worth of damage. It has a cooldown of 10 seconds and a windup of 1 second.
Spectre.lore: An agressive hunter that goes around collecting weak souls.

Jazz.description: Jazz is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-2 update, and has a base chance of 1 in 160,000 of being rolled.
Jazz.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, dropbeat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a yellow star, that slowly expands before the edges glow in a yellow and orange gradient, revealing after a white cracking screen sequenc
Jazz.appearance: Jazz consists of a player holding a tenor saxophone with a yellow color palette. The saxophone also emits music notes from it. At the bottom of the player there is a golden treble clef accompanied by a yellow glittery stream of light. Around the player circles a golden band that consists of small wavy lines, a staff with multiple music notes, and two yellow orbs that leave behind a wavy, golden trail. A cloud of golden dust particles can be seen around the player and small music note particles are emitted from it. The player also wears a bowtie.
Jazz.lore: Jazz, a romance born in improvisation, where free melodies whisper the language of love.

Aether.description: Aether is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1, and has a base chance of 1 in 180,000 of being rolled.
Aether.cutscene_note: Aether has a very similar cutscene to Exotic. The screen turns black and a star revolves, with the colours being almost identical to Exotic's star, but just slightly less saturated. When the star reaches its maximum size, vignette colours show up. The top being blue and the bottom being green. After, the screen cracks, revealing Aether.
Aether.appearance: Aether manifests in the form of a teal and blue fire that envelops the player's body, a wispy smoke effect also surrounding them. The player hovers above the ground, bobbing up and down as a light-green star rests above their left hand, covered in a layer of dark particles. A dark aura writhes beneath the player, transitioning to a teal color at its edges.
Aether.lore: Mysterious matter believed to act as a medium for transmitting light The exact use is unknown.

Bounded.description: Bounded is a Legendary tier aura that was added before the game was updated, and has a 1 in 200,000 chance of being rolled.
Bounded.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a dropbeat noise plays in the beginning of the cutscene, extending for its entirety, heard in the background. In the center of the screen lies a blue star, which slowly expands, before the edges of the screen start to glow the same color, revealing , after a white crack
Bounded.appearance: Chains manifest through two small blue portals, and restrain the player's arms, while they float in the air. Additionally, a large blue orb floats above the back of the player, showering them with a dark blue light resembling the illumination seen on the ocean floor. White particles also float around the player, and spinning crescents under them evoke the imagery of a whirlpool.
Bounded.lore: It's too dangerous. Although it was sealed by an Ancient Power hundreds of thousands of years ago, its consciousness appears to be alive

Lantern.description: Lantern is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-14, and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 333,333.
Lantern.appearance: Lantern produces a soft emerald green light that surrounds the user. The user stands next to a floating lantern which emits warm golden light to produce a circular area of brightness beneath the player's feet. The aura produces subtle particles which drift outward while light wisps move continuously, creating a peaceful ceremonial atmosphere. The effect produces a constant state which displays a mystical and ancient appearance instead of displaying violent energy.

Celestial.description: Celestial is a Legendary tier aura that was added in Era 1, and has a 1 in 350,000 chance of being rolled.
Celestial.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, drop beat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a very light bluish pink star, that slowly expands before the top edges glow pink and the bottom blue, revealing after a white cracking
Celestial.appearance: Above the player's head are two particle effects that resemble portals; one cyan, and one lavender, connected downward by rays of light into what appear to be shards. A large lavender-colored halo appears behind the player's head as they hover above the ground, looking in front of them, with their right arm placed against their torso, and their left arm placed behind them, holding an object made from pure energy, in a sitting-like pose.
Celestial.lore: An Individual with a sacredness that seems to have descended from heaven is hovering around and delivering words of blessing .

Vortex.description: Vortex is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-21 update and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 399,999 breakthrough or with a chance of 1 in 133,333 during Windy.
Vortex.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a dropbeat noise plays, continuing throughout the entirety of the cutscene. A dark purple star revolves in the center of the screen, while slowly expanding, before the edges glow purple, revealing after a white cracking screen sequence.
Vortex.appearance: When equipped, Vortex takes appearance of an aura with mostly purple-ish color. The player levitates slightly above the ground, keeping their right hand on their waist and left hand close to their head. Around the player, a lot of purple-ish particles appear, with some of them forming something that looks similar to a whirlpool. The player's torso has a similar effect. Finally, the aura's floor consists of all the purple particles rising up from the floor and then disappearing at the aura's top.

Terror.description: Terror is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-7, and has a base chance of 1 in 400,000 of being rolled.
Terror.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a dropbeat noise plays, continuing throughout the entirety of the cutscene. A dark pink star revolves in the center of the screen, while slowly expanding, before the edges glow purple, revealing after a white cracking screen sequence.
Terror.appearance: Terror has a bright pink and red color, with spikes going in the players body, & a glitchy error screen on the player's face, like Undefined. The ground aura is a bright pink and black swirl which gradually with bigger and fades out. The player's limbs have a bright pink streaky aura, with crackling electricity and Japanese Katakana symbols going up and down. The title has a shine on the letters T and E.
Terror.ability: Slash (E) — Upon hitting E, the player swings their spear, which causes a small ripple, dealing 15 damage. | X (X) — Upon hitting X, a 6 pointed star appears over the player, which stays in place. It slowly fades out as a 4 pointed star quickly fades in, and both stars shortly disappear before letting out a spherical scratch attack which resembles Oblivion's, dealing 18 damage. | F (F) — Upon hitting F, 4 rectangles appear in quick succession in front of the player, and disappear. A spike like pattern appears, and then a scratch like pattern then appears as all of it disappears, and deals 20 damage. The ability [F] is very similar to Life Guard's [Heal Pad], except it does damage instead of healing.
Terror.lore: It is spreading a dreadful screams...

Hope.description: Hope is a Legendary tier aura that was added in Eon 1-12. It has a base chance of 1 in 488,725 or 1 in 97,745 during Heaven.
Hope.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen becomes black, with a center gold star spinning in place, slowly expanding and a white screen is seen cracking revealing the aura.
Hope.appearance: Hope has a bottom circule with slashes and fog that looks similar to Archangel but small, and its has a symbol deafened in the torso, similar to Divinus, and a sword handed with 2 glowing eyes and some rotating trails over the player.
Hope.lore: One of heavens guards, let your fate be decided

Raven.obtainment: Exclusive to THE LIMBO (1 in 500,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Raven.description: Raven is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-5. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 500,000 only inside The Limbo.
Raven.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a dropbeat noise plays in the beginning of the cutscene, extending for its entirety, heard in the background. In the center of the screen lies a gray star, which slowly expands, before the edges of the screen start to glow a dark and light gray gradient, revealing , aft
Raven.appearance: Raven is an aura that equips the player with black wings. The player is seen flapping upwards, bobbing in the air, with 2 white dots glowing over their eyes. A smaller raven is seen orbiting the player. Below the player a central, focal point is seen emitting a semi-grainy fog below the rest of the player, which seems to rise up into the rest of the aura over the edges. This aura's walking animation consists of the player simply leaning forwards.
Raven.lore: The raven is known as a harbinger of misfortune or disaster. Its instinct to sense calamity before others and flee, its tendency to travel in flocks, its dark an ominous presence, its habit of feeding on corpses, and its exceptional intelligence all contribute to this image. Some even believe that ravens are evildoers cursed by witches and turned into black birds.

Artifact.description: Artifact is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the radiant forest update, and has a base chance of 1 in 500,000 of being rolled. In the Lost Forest biome, this reduces to a 1 in 250,000.
Artifact.music_file: Far - you've somehow angered a seraphim.mp3
Artifact.cutscene_note: The screen fades to black. A banging sound effect can be heard, while a green, 4-pointed star appears spinning clockwise. After a few seconds, it expands. After a white cracking sequence, Artifact is revealed.
Artifact.appearance: When equipped, Artifact places the player in the air, holding an item similar to a rune. Surrounding the player sits a green aura, with lines similar to Runic. Multiple particles can be seen rising from the ground, while pulses of a rune-like symbol occurs every few seconds.
Artifact.lore: A small yet significant pebble, carrying with it what seems to be remains of Magic.

Veylune.description: Veylune is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the radiant forest update. It has a base chance of 1 in 555,000 or 1 in 277,500 during Lost Forest.
Veylune.music_file: Carolin Petit - Live Piano Stories 11 (Tender & Nostalgic).ogg
Veylune.cutscene_note: The screen fades to black. A banging sound plays, followed by silence. A 4-pointed star appears, enveloped in a gradient of colours such as teal and orange. After a few seconds, the star expands, followed by a white cracking sequence, revealing Veylune.
Veylune.appearance: When equipped, Veylune places the player on a field of luminescent flowers of varying colour. Above, there sits a radiant sun and multiple clouds, similar to Vendor and multiple other summer event auras.
Veylune.lore: Calmly resting in a place anonymously to others, letting your thoughts relax as the day gets brighter.

Warlock.description: Warlock is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-5, and has a base chance of 1 in 666,000 of being rolled.
Warlock.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === During opening animation, the screen turns black, with a dark pink star appearing in the middle, slowly rotating and expanding. By the end of the sequence, edges start to glow the same color before the entire screen turns white and cracks, revealing .
Warlock.appearance: The player levitates above the ground, surrounded by strong magenta lighting and smoke. Behind the player floats an unknown, grinning entity with sharp horns, its hands extending outward, fingers moving in sync with the player's motions. The entity's tail wraps around a large sword that hovers beside the player, with a glowing eye embedded in the center of its hilt, facing outward. From the ground, purple particles and wisps rise and fly upwards in a continuous motion. Below, pink circular energy pulses outward from the player’s position, pink flames emerge around the area, from the player and the entity's head and hands, giving a hellish look.
Warlock.lore: 'Warlock' is actually the name of the sword. Bound to a devious demon familiar, this sword grants immense power but it constantly drags its wielder into terrible incidents and relentlessly seeks to claim their life.

Undead_Devil.description: Undead : Devil is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Era 2. It is a mutation of Undead and can be rolled with a breakthrough chance of 1 in 666,666 and a native chance of 1 in 111,111 in the Hell biome.
Undead_Devil.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, dropbeat noise plays in the beginning, extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. In the center, there is a dark green star, that slowly expands before the edges glow dark green, revealing after a white cracking screen sequence.
Undead_Devil.appearance: Unlike its normal counterpart, this skin doesn't feature a crucifix. Instead, it applies red glowing wings, horns, and a triangle-tipped tail to the player’s avatar as a large red portal swirls beneath them. It also gives off a hex-looking aura that is very faintly seen. Additionally, the player levitates above the ground, oscillating slightly as their wings and tail move in unison.

Kyawthuite.description: Kyawthuite is a Legendary tier aura that was added in the Era 6, and has a base chance of 1 in 850,000 of being rolled, or 1 in 425,000 in The Radiant Forest biome.
Kyawthuite.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a dropbeat noise plays, continuing throughout the entirety of the cutscene. A dark purple star revolves in the center of the screen, while slowly expanding, before the edges glow purple, revealing after a white cracking screen sequence.
Kyawthuite.appearance: Kyawthuite has a look very similar to the old model of Gravitational, alongside Sidereum. Several small rocks float around the central levitating player, however unlike Gravitational, these small rocks do not circle around the player. The player is also accompanied by purple smog, and sparkles branching out from the floor under them. This smog appears to move upwards extremely quickly, like the wind that Powered possesses, but recolored purple. A large galaxy pool underneath the player pulses outwards, accompanied by several cracks. The player seems to be floating due to the purple smog and rocks.
Kyawthuite.lore: Long, long ago, there was a 'boy' who stayed alone in the empty space of a deep cave. He is still waiting for the day when he can sit on the moon together with the girl who suddenly left when he was young, somewhere in the forest and talk again, once in a thousand years, in the deepest part of the forest...

★★★.obtainment: Exclusive to DREAMSPACE (1 in 10,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
★★★.description: ★★★, also known as REVERIE or 3 Stars, is a Mythic tier aura added in the Eon 1-2 Winter Update. It can be rolled in the Dreamspace biome at a chance of 1 in 10,000.
★★★.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== ‘s opening starts with a pink star entering the screen along with a black background fading in to the screen. The star spins slowly with foreboding music to accompany it. The opening ends off with the star suddenly growing bigger until a pink-to-white vertical vignette fades in to the screen befo
★★★.appearance: |-|New= ★★★ gives the player a pink aura rising from a repeatingly rising square portal effect on the floor, similar to ★ or Virtual, with a faint, big pink star below the player, and with rising small stars. There's two opened doors at both sides of the player, with both of the door's entrances being filled with a bright pink glow, similar to the doors that appear during Dreamspace. There's two bright, 8-pointed stars behind the player, with pink fire effects from their poles. The player also gets an faint pink star icon surrounding them, a bright pink star on their chest (similar to Virtual), a pink halo above their head (similar to Quartz) and a fire effect on their limbs (similar to Lotusfall). Additionally, two bright pink stars orbits the player, with two other bright pink stars located behind the player, fittingly similar to Dreammetric. Lastly, text saying " REVERIE " is behind ★★★'s title, similar to the other two star auras (★ & ★★). |-|Old= ★★★ has nothing except for three 5-pointed stars on the top of the player. The stars radiate a vibrant pink glow with a pink-to-white vertical gradient coloring in the stars. The stars also have a thick black outline. This aura doesn't give players visual effects, similar to :smiro:, Deepwoken, Nothing, and all other 5-pointed star auras (★ and ★★).
★★★.lore: The effect grew on me, I Felt something I had never felt before; a presence. But of [WHAT?] Something lays it's eyes upon me

Arcane.description: Arcane is a Mythic tier aura listed in the collection, added in the December 29th In-Dev Update and has a 1 in 1,000,000 chance of being rolled.
Arcane.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, jingle noise plays in the beginning, a wind noise extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. At the bottom is white fog and in the center, there is a light blue eight-pointed star, that slowly expands and rotates quicker before the edges glow
Arcane.appearance: A bright light blue circle revolves around the player while strings of magic course around their body, alongside some crystal-shaped effect(s) rotating around the player, similar to the spinning planet that Gravitational has. A wispy, flame-like effect emanates from above the player, rotating whilst moving toward the player, seemingly providing them with energy. A portal-like effect also swirls beneath the player's feet, glowing in an intense light-blue hue. Tiny blue particles appear constantly around the player as they adopt a relaxed, yet menacing, stance.
Arcane.ability: Arcane allows the player to teleport a small set distance towards the direction the player is facing by pressing 'X'. The teleportation distance is around 28 studs. If you use the ability while jumping, however, you will teleport while also being the number of studs in the air as you were while jumping, with the crystal trails creating a slant-like effect after teleporting.

Starlight_Kunzite.description: Starlight : Kunzite is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-15 Update. It is a mutation of Starlight and can be rolled with a breakthrough chance of 1 in 1,000,000 and a native chance of 1 in 200,000 in the Starfall.
Starlight_Kunzite.appearance: When equipped, Starlight : Kunzite takes appearance of pink-themed aura, with various pink sparkles rising up from the aura's bottom. The player appears to be floating in a pose very similar to Overseer. Around the player, a vertical pink ring appears, which quickly spins and emits pink particles.

Gothic.obtainment: Exclusive to THE LIMBO (1 in 1,000,001); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Gothic.description: Gothic (Also known as or ), is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-17. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 1,000,001 while inside The Limbo.
Gothic.appearance: When equipped, Gothic takes appearance of grey-ish colored aura, being similar to other The Limbo auras. The aura itself looks half image-like and half vfx-like, with fog emitting from the player, and slowly fading away. The player gains a lot of unique accessories, with them being a collar that resembles planet's rings, a grey wing that occasionally sparks, a grey bracelet on the player's right arm, alongside a chain-like accessory on the left arm and a grey, beating heart at the middle of the player's torso.
