Behind the player, a static, png-like glitchy effect appears. Finally, at the aura's bottom, various grey and white spikes appear in a circle, with some of them being larger, while the others are smaller, including a whirlpool-like grey effect.

Magnetic_Reverse_Polarity.description: Magnetic : Reverse Polarity is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Era 6 Update, seen after clicking on Magnetic. It has a 1 in 1,024,000 chance of being rolled, and is a mutation of Magnetic.
Magnetic_Reverse_Polarity.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen blackens, with a jingle noise playing in the beginning and a wind noise that extends the entirety of the cutscene. At the bottom, there is yellow-hued fog, and in the center, there is a yellowish-pink eight-pointed star that slowly expands. The top of the screen glows pink and the bott
Magnetic_Reverse_Polarity.appearance: Magnetic : Reverse Polarity creates a large, orb-like particle aura around the player as they float above the ground, consisting of yellow, purple, and golden particles. Two purple and gold rings — one large, and one small — rotate around the player in a set pattern. Furthermore, two orbs in gold and purple orbit the player opposite from each other, leaving behind thin trails of their respective colors. Additionally, two rings of what appears to be electricity are wrapped around the player's arms, and a yellow star, similar to Sidereum's, is situated in the center of the player’s chest.
Magnetic_Reverse_Polarity.lore: A collection of strong energies with inverted directions of acting polarities, which is not described magnetically.

Undefined.description: Undefined is a Mythic tier aura, added prior to the In-Dev Updates. It has a 1 in 1,111,000 chance of being rolled normally, and a 1 in 1,111 chance of being rolled in Null or being inside The Limbo.
Undefined.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a jingle noise plays, accompanied by wind sounds that continue throughout the cutscene. Grey fog forms at the bottom of the screen, and in the center, a dark grey eight-pointed star revolves while slowly expanding. The edges then glow dark grey, revealing . Its Native ra
Undefined.appearance: A large, black, shaking "X" overlaps the player's face, and a black aura billows out from behind their torso, fading to white as it extends outwards. Below the player, a large, portal-like effect is present, with a white center that gradually transitions to a black effect. Various shapes and sizes of black and white particles fly out of the portal, and white butterfly particles surrounding the player are visible upon closer inspection. Lastly, white lines surround the portal-like effect. Undefined also has a walking and standing animation, leaning forward and assuming a more hunched-back position. When walking, it has a similar animation to Arcane, but instead of leaning back, it is leaning forward. The aura will obscure the player's vision upon viewing in first-person camera.

Rage_Brawler.description: Rage : Brawler is a Mythic tier aura added in the Eon 1 Update, seen after clicking on Rage. It has a 1 in 1,280,000 chance of being rolled, and is a mutation of Rage.
Rage_Brawler.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen will become black, as chiming noises play in the beginning of the cutscene. A windy noise extending the entirety of the cutscene plays in the background. The bottom of the player’s screen will be gray with red particles emerging from it, and the top is black. In the center there is a
Rage_Brawler.appearance: Rage : Brawler positions the player in a crouched, battle-ready stance, their eyes radiating a bright red glow, obscured by a dark aura. A red, flame-like effect is produced within the player's torso as they bob up and down steadily, similar to Rage. Additionally, a red portal-like effect manifests beneath the player, erratically writhing as its edges transition to black. A similar effect can be seen behind the player, albeit rotated in an upright position. The avatar is also equipped with boxing gloves, with sharp wedges on the ends.
Rage_Brawler.ability: The user pulls back their right fist, clenching it before punching and causing a shockwave infront. If a player is in range of the shockwave, they will get hit, getting damaged and losing 30HP. The cooldown is around 13 seconds with a windup of 1.13 seconds.

Symbiosis.description: Symbiosis is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-16 Update and can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 1,331,201 or with a chance of 1 in 266,240 during the presence of the Corruption biome.
Symbiosis.appearance: The player and their eye glows purple, with their right arm being completely covered in a black substance thats spreading to the torso. An armband goes around the arm with Hazard's radioactive symbol on it. There is also a purple floor with circular slashes rising up from the ground. This aura is very similar to Parasite in many ways.

Astral.description: Astral is a Mythic tier aura added in the Era 7 Update. It has a 1 in 1,336,000 chance of being rolled, and a 1 in 267,200 chance of being rolled in the Starfall biome.
Astral.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a quick jingle noise plays; a wind noise extending for the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. At the bottom of the screen is a purple fog, and in the center, there is a purple eight-pointed star, slowly expanding before the edges glow light purple, rev
Astral.appearance: The player floats, wobbling slightly while doing so, with their right hand pointed upwards; black and purple matter billowing out. Surrounding the player is a golden ring connected by purple stars, with a smaller golden circle rotating around their head. Following the player is a black and purple quasar, slowly spinning while emitting a bright purple light, enveloped by a black haze-like effect.
Astral.lore: In the distant expanse of space, tiny stars emitting faint light come together to form a unified existence. These stars, embracing each other as they move in harmony, serve as the final puzzle pieces completing the beauty of the universe.

Cosmos.description: Cosmos is a Mythic tier aura added in the Eon 1-3 Update and has a 1 in 1,520,000 chance of being rolled.
Cosmos.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A pale grey background opens as a very hard to see star like in a very dark navy to purple star opens on the screen. It begins to expand in size while spinning before the background's top is now a dark navy to a lesser dark navy color similar to to then show .
Cosmos.appearance: The player takes a defensive stance holding their right hand below the nape while standing in a firm position. The player has a glowing purple left eye similar to Diaboli that is constant and has a black flame outline. The left arm is engulfed in a bright starry light held by the player in the same purple color as the arm is engulfed with spirals upward flames with some apparent stars. An opaque purple flame rising upward before quickly fading below the player's feet as a purple vortex effect spirals around underneath a bright white flame expanding outwards to purple and black. Small purple particles rise upward around the player. Behind the player are three slash marks in pure black, outlined with a purple glow.
Cosmos.ability: Upon pressing F, the user raises their left arm, perform a forward slash, spin, and follow up with another slash. Next, they do three consecutive sweeping motions with their left hand before charging up and delivering a punch in front.
Cosmos.lore: A galactic warrior who fought in the ancient space war. Countless years have passed since the war, but the scars of war still remains on its body.

Obsidian.description: Obsidian is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-24 and can be obtained with a base chance of 1 in 1,750,000.
Obsidian.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A dark purple and black 8 pointed star appears in the center of the screen rotating slowly on a black background, then purple shine creeps in on the corners revealing .
Obsidian.appearance: The aura utilizes a purple color scheme prevalent through the entirety of it. The floor consists of slow, smooth fog accompanied by neon purple wave-like lines. A slow spiral is located at the center and cracked-floor textures surrond the outer layers. Stones held by chains are afloat next to the player, alongside smaller rocks circling them. A smooth outline covers the players legs, arms, and torso, and the right hand weilds a sword. Said sword has sharp charateristics (such as the hilt), with its tip being illuminated by a smooth purple smoke.
Obsidian.lore: Obsidian. A vitreous material known since earliest civilizations that was among the first materials to be used in the creation of blades. Unlike any other rock or mineral though, obsidian's edges possess an unmatched sharpness, causing the weapons forged with it to have immense value and rarity. It is said that a slash of a sword made of obsidian is as silent as a whisper, making it the greatest weapons for history's most famous assassins; but in the hands of a ruthless, it will only leave behind an unannounced massacre.

Archmage.description: Archmage is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-16 and can be obtained with a base chance of 1 in 1,766,000.
Archmage.appearance: The player bobs from left to right, holding a staff in their right hand and a book in their left hand while being encased by particles that constantly change their color from blue to gold. There is a ring around the player that also consists of blue and gold colors. Both of the player's fists are coated in a yellow light. Beneath the player is a floor of various blue and gold effects and a bright point in the center. Blue and golden particles surrounding the player can also be seen.

Player_Respawn.description: Player : Respawn is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-14 Update. It is a mutation of Player and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 1,999,999 or with a chance of 1 in 999,999 in the Cyberspace biome.
Player_Respawn.music_file: Anthony Lee Phillips - It begins in darkness... (8bit).mp3
Player_Respawn.appearance: Player : Respawn is themed around the Roblox spawn point, The player floats slowly, almost in a laying position, with their arms out. A square-shaped, green and black spawn point floats below the player, underneath it is a calm, green glowing floor, green particles gently drifting away from the aura. Around the player consists of a green, spherical force field, likely referencing the Roblox force field gained after respawning. Around the player are a few phrases in green text, stating: and Tiny sparkles, and text stating appear and disappear around the force field.

Gravitational.description: Gravitational is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Era 1 Update, and has a 1 in 2,000,000 chance of being rolled.
Gravitational.music_file: Jonathan Pilcher, Natalie Barowitz - Gravity Rainbow.mp3
Gravitational.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a quick jingle effect plays, a wind noise also playing in the background. Situated at the screen's center is a violet eight-pointed star, a grey fog at the bottom, that revolves, while slowly expanding, before the edges glow violet, revealing .
Gravitational.appearance: When equipped, Gravitational makes the player floats above a small, purple vortex. They have a small, bright black hole placed in the center of their torso, pulling in purple fog around the player. multiple tiny rocks swirl around the player, along with a much bigger asteroid circling them as well, highlighted with a circular, purple glow. The player also gains a few triangles spinning around their neck, forming a star shape. Finally, another black hole, identical to the one in the player's torso, floats above their head, warping the letters in the aura's title.
Gravitational.lore: The irregularities of gravity incomprehensible to humans. It is thought to stem from the same material comprising the mysterious Great Attractor .

Bounded_Unbound.description: Bounded : Unbound is a Mythic tier aura added in the Era 6 Update. It can be viewed after clicking on Bounded and has a 1 in 2,000,000 chance of being rolled. It is a mutation of Bounded.
Bounded_Unbound.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle effect plays, accompanied by a wind noise that continues throughout the cutscenes. White fog forms at the bottom of the screen, as a blue-purple eight-pointed star situated in the center revolves while slowly expanding. The edges then glow blueish, eventua
Bounded_Unbound.appearance: Bounded : Unbound features a bright, glowing purple color scheme, similar to Gravitational and Impeached. The aura consists of six stars, three on either side of the player, resembling the sparks of embers emitted by candles, and a larger star that sits above the player and is enveloped by a fluctuating black aura. Neon-pink cubes of varying sizes rotate around the top star at differing speeds, and perfectly vertical laser bolts strike the ground with an audible impact every few seconds. Additionally, a black and purple portal swirls beneath the player's feet as their body agitates and shakes.
Bounded_Unbound.lore: When news spread that this being had awoken, people trembled in fear. However, something was odd; the creature had awoken but showed no signs of activity. Yet, it was too early for assumptions. It could be just recovering its strength...

Flutter_Buggify.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Flutter_Buggify.description: Flutter : Buggify is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Boss Raid Chapter 2 update. It is a mutation of Flutter and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 2,000,000, or 1 in 1,000,000 in the Lost Forest biome.
Flutter_Buggify.appearance: The player is seen riding a big bug, the bug has 2 wings on its back, 2 antennas on its head and a sphere shaped head. The players effects are very similar to the bug, having the same antennas and wings but with a light green glow on their torso. The bug is being circled by 3 of the same bugs but tiny. Below the player is a light green mist.

Flowed.description: Flowed is a Mythic tier aura added in the Eon 1-14 Update, and has a 1 in 2,121,121 chance of being rolled, or a 1 in 2,121 chance during Null or inside The Limbo.
Flowed.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns gray, as a quick jingle noise plays. Tiny white particles, like sparks, come up from the bottom of the screen. A quiet wind noise plays for the entirety of the cutscene. A white, eight-pointed star revolves in the center of the screen. After a few seconds, the star's rotation spe
Flowed.appearance: Flowed has the player float just above the ground, with their arms out. There is a white glow that clings to the body, with small, white rings rotating around the hands. Around the player rotate six black and white orbs, each with their own symbol. The symbols are a plus, an x, a star, a triangle, a square, and a shape with three separate arrows pointing away, in a triangular shape. Each orb leaves a white, rectangular trail, that is almost long enough for the orbs to form a full circle with the trails. There is a white, detailed ring around the player closer to the ground. The ring slowly undulates up and down as is rotates. On the ground, there is a small, black and white effect that pulses outward from the center. At the center of the effect, there is a bright white light that shines strands of light upwards and around the player.
Flowed.lore: And in a gentle, harmonious rhythm, everything flowed as one.

Virtual.description: Virtual is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Era 2, and has a 1 in 2,500,000 chance of being rolled.
Virtual.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a jingle noise plays, accompanied by a wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. Grey fog forms at the bottom of the screen, and a cyan eight-pointed star appears at the center, revolving, while slowly expanding. Subsequently, the edges of the screen glow a lig
Virtual.appearance: Virtual has a light, sky-blue color palette. A light blue holographic cube spins above the player's head, containing a bright glowing sphere in its center. The cube is surrounded by an atom-like shape, and a light blue orb orbits around it, connected by its beams. Surrounding the player are 3 holographic interfaces, each displaying something unique, with another holographic interface placed behind the cube. The player's left hand is raised in front of their face as they strike a menacing pose, a white star also pulsating on their torso. A ring encircles the player, and below, a wireframe-like structure emits square particles, which fade out quickly.
Virtual.lore: An advanced hologram device created by an unnamed civilization.

Vega.obtainment: Exclusive to SINGULARITY (1 in 2,580,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Vega.description: Vega is a Mythic rarity aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It can only be rolled inside the Singularity biome with a chance of 1 in 2,580,000.
Vega.appearance: When equipped, Vega takes appearance of cyan-ish aura, a large blue star appears behind the player, as well as particles that look similar to the ones Hyper-Volt has. The player appears to be floating slightly above the ground, with a bright-cyan, pulsing heart at their torso, similar to the one Gothic has.
Vega.lore: This is a celestial miracle that restores hope to the weary. Every time its beam of light angles toward Earth, one lost soul is freed. Each pulse is dimmer than the last. The star gives up its light to let them go.

Parasite.description: Parasite is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-7. It has a base chance of 1 in 3,000,000 or 1 in 600,000 during Corruption.
Parasite.appearance: When the player equips the aura, Violet flames begin rising from the ground along with faint blue flames on the edges along with different particles. From the player, faint black smoke can be seen around the player. The floor of the aura consists of a violet portal-like effect that expands from the player. On the Right arm, what appears to be a blob envelops the player's arm. The player seems to be covering its face and is shaking. From the face, what appears to be 5 purple and black tendrils are protruding from the player's face. As the player walks, the "blob" goes into a lower stance than in the idle. The "blob" appears to be getting dragged though there is no contact with the "blob" and the floor.

Orion.description: Orion is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-17. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 3,000,000 breakthrough or with a chance of 1 in 600,000 during Starfall.
Orion.appearance: The player features a yellow star printed onto its chest. They are surrounded by a navy blue, nebula-like fog, with bright star-like points of light of blue and yellow hues slowly flowing through it. They hold a blue bow & arrow, which is shaped by an asterism of stars with bright neon lines connecting to each of them.

Apatite.description: Apatite is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-16, and has a base chance of 1 in 3,133,133 of being rolled.
Apatite.appearance: The player is seen laying on a glowing levitating cyan gemstone as cyan particles move up and come from the center of the floor along with six pointy cyan gemstones coming from the ground of the sides of the aura.
Apatite.lore: It was a conduit; knowledgeable and guiding. A flicker in the marrow of an age broken for centuries. It was long ago. So long ago that the elders argue if it was memory or dream, but there was to be light. Violet and powerful. For decades it shone on the townsfolk and each time it did, they turned their ways of evil away. But that was long ago. The townsfolk did not speak of the night the violet failed; yet they felt it. In the weeks that followed, their rage did not exhaust itself. It rooted. Rooted in the grief that did not soften. It sharpened. It sharpened in the air itself for it seemed tighter, as though the world had inhaled and forgotten how to breathe out. The girl did not return. Some say she tried to climb again. Some whisper she could not bear to do it without him. They were all wrong for the monolith, it stood. It stood in silence, a place no longer of mercy but of witness. They were all wrong for on the night that has swollen with something beyond evil, a figure arrived. That conduit. And so, he climbed. His footsteps did not shimmer as they once had. they pressed into the soil like anyone else's. The forest did not hush for him this time. The wind did not turn inward. The path felt itself steeper, as though the mountain remembered his absence. as though it was screaming to him that he had been forsaken for far too long. At the peak, beneath a sky thick with unspent darkness, he did not wait for evil to swell. He let it. He let the vilest midnight reach its fullest breath. He let the town below churn with unchecked anger, with years of unpurified grief. Knives were drawn. Curses spat. Doors slammed harder than they had in decades past. But then, he pushed his face to the pitch black sky, and a light poured from the tears that left his eyes. Not violet. Blue. And it was so, so, cold.

Savior.description: Savior is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Era 9 update. It can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 3,200,000.
Savior.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== An eight-pointed reddish-pink star appears on-screen, while a jingle effect and wind noise play in the background. The background is also covered in a gray fog from the bottom of the screen, whilst small red particles slowly float upwards. The star then slowly expands, before its edges shine a re
Savior.appearance: Savior creates a reddish-pink puddle that emits the same reddish-pink flames beneath the player as they float in midair, enveloped by a pink aura as they reach out with their right arm. A black, humanoid figure, with a pair of horns and a glowing, star-like eye akin to that of a demon, manifests behind the player, appearing to latch onto their back. Additionally, a halo-like sigil rests above the demonic entity, similar to the one featured in Red Full Moon.
Savior.lore: It is a wonderful partner that appears at the very last moment, reaching out to offer you a hand of salvation.

Shiftlock.description: Shiftlock is a Mythic tier aura added in the Eon 1-8 Update, and has a 1 in 3,325,000 chance of being rolled, or a 1 in 3,325 chance during Null or inside The Limbo.
Shiftlock.appearance: When Shiftlock is equipped, the user holds a sniper rifle. A scope-like effect is formed at the ground, with a big and small one on the barrel of the sniper rifle. The [ Shiftlock symbol] appears on both of the user's wrists, the user's left eye, and on top of their head as a halo. White hexagon-like particles rise up from the scope effect on the ground.
Shiftlock.lore: Hey, trying to run? Go ahead. If you think you can.

Evanescent.description: Evanescent is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-16. It has a base chance of 1 in 3,360,000 or 1 in 840,000 during Rainy.
Evanescent.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A blue and black star appears as a quiet wind sound affect plays, after a few seconds a blue and black screen effect fades in as the cutscene ends and is revealed to be .
Evanescent.appearance: Evanescent appears as a dark blue aura, below the player is a ripple effect. The player has a wristband with a anchor tied onto it, the player has a light blue effect on their arms and legs. Similar to Breakthrough, a dark blue shattered pillar is seen behind the player.
Evanescent.lore: The light shimmered in his eye. Born to swim, and yet all he could do is watch as the sea passed him by. There he sat, alone but not afraid; for time has rusted his fear. It was a shadow, a figure drifting through the seas. And there, his arms threw themselves out. They lunged towards that shadow, a figure drifting through the waters. He held, oh he held. A tight grip, a firm clutch. He watched as the light shone on the figure, a lifeless body yet still so warm. He held that body in his arms and there he closed his eyes, his soul reaching for the remnants of what was once a life once broken.

Cosmos_Alice.description: Cosmos : Alice is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-6. It is a mutation of Cosmos and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 3,500,000.
Cosmos_Alice.appearance: Cosmos : Alice appears as a blue variant of Cosmos, except it lacks the effects coming off from the player's left eye, the claw marks on the player's back and the special effects on the player's left arm. Instead, there is a halo floating right behind the player's head and the player holds the [ Mythic Sword of the Tides] gear in their right arm.
Cosmos_Alice.ability: Tidal Rush — [F] Tidal Rush : A small delay passes, before the player's model is subtly highlighted for a split second as it winds up, before dashing forward while slashing with their sword at the same time; before slashing once again after a delay, dealing two instances of damage, the first removing 10HP, the second removing 20HP, for a total of 30HP lost. | Vertical Waves — [C] Vertical Waves : A small delay passes, before the player's model is subtly highlighted for a split second as the player jumps up into the air, before almost instantly slashing when the player is rotated 90 degrees to their left 2 times, and then stabbing their sword into the ground as the player lands on the ground, causing a small shockwave, dealing four instances of damage, the first, second and third removing 7HP, the fourth removing 20HP, for a total of 41HP lost.
Cosmos_Alice.lore: A galactic warrior who fought in the ancient space war. Countless years have passed since the war, but the scars of war still remains on its body.

Crystallized_Bejeweled.description: Crystallized : Bejeweled is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-15. It is a mutation of Crystallized and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 3,600,000.
Crystallized_Bejeweled.appearance: Crystallized : Bejeweled is an aura with a pink-purple theme. When equipped, the player seems to be weighed down and standing in a tired pose. A fog effect swirls around the player, with jewels on the player's shoulders, face, and hands, glowing white. A faint rainbow can also be seen on top of the player. A pink fire is underneath the player, slowly extending outwards, tinting more purple. There are also small glowing particles floating upwards from the ground.
Crystallized_Bejeweled.lore: As the crystals grow more and more, it weakens the victim, spreading like an infection, weighing down on the victim until it's hard to even breath, however █████ had discovered something powerful within these crystals...

Aquatic_Flame.description: Aquatic is a Unique tier aura that was added in Era 1, and has a 1 in 40,000 chance of being rolled.
Aquatic_Flame.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a drop beat noise plays, extending the entirety of the cutscene. A light blue star forms in the center, revolving while slowly expanding. The edges then glow light blue, revealing .
Aquatic_Flame.appearance: Aquatic surrounds the player with two rotating whirlpools, both in a blue hue, emitting small blue particle effects behind them as they rotate. Beneath the player,a blue portal pulses outward, accompanied by thin blue lines shooting up. Another notable detail of Aquatic is the small "aquatic" star in the middle of the player's torso, surrounded by small rotating lines.
Aquatic_Flame.lore: It represents the flow of water

Poseidon.description: Poseidon is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Era 5. It has a 1 in 4,000,000 chance of being rolled normally, and a 1 in 1,000,000 chance of being rolled in Rainy.
Poseidon.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen will become black, jingle noise plays in the beginning, a wind noise extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. At the bottom is grey fog and, in the center, there is a dark blue eight-pointed star, that slowly expands before the edges glow light teal on the b
Poseidon.appearance: Poseidon is water-themed, and resembles Poseidon, the god of the sea in ancient Greek mythology. While equipped, the player appears to be holding a trident that emits a bluish glow. Below the player, a portal-like circle with a fast-moving ripple effect emits blue, water-like particles that flow inwards. Additionally, the player is enveloped in an azure, almost flame-like aura, and releases water-like particles that float upwards before fading away. Transparent particles shaped like small waves revolve around the player in an opposite direction.
Poseidon.lore: It has been shaped as a creature that once ruled the ocean long ago. It always maintains its posture, and all sea creatures are loyal to it. Except, one .

Metabytes.description: Metabytes is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-15. It has a 1 in 4,000,000 chance of being rolled normally and a 1 in 2,000,000 chance to be rolled during the Cyberspace biome.
Metabytes.appearance: Metabytes Consists of a square-shaped floor, similar to Virtual. The player stands in the middle of the square, moving left and right with their fists up, their arms are covered by blue, metallic bands and gloves. Their torso is covered by a similar piece of blue metal. Next to the player are two, cube-like creatures with glowing teeth, and eyes. Small cube-shaped debris float up from the floor, similar to Aegis. Lastly, a visor is on the player's face, being a similar color to the rest of the aura, and having the same design as the floor.
Metabytes.lore: Metabytes. Mainly known for being the most important engineer for during the creation of Aegis, the 'Shield of the Sky'. He always moved around accompanied by his own cybernetic cubes, challenging any wizard that he stumbled upon during his path.

Wraith.description: Wraith is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-17 and can be obtained with a base chance of 1 in 4,100,000.
Wraith.music_file: Heaven Pierce Her - Dead Heat Pulse (A Heart of Cold).mp3
Wraith.appearance: When equipped, Wraith takes appearance of a teal colored aura, with various particles circulating around the user, forming something like a whirlpool. The user gains a unique accessory, with it being a hood. The user also gets a lantern in ther left arm. The lantern seemingly emits a teal-ish colored light, similar to . Finally, the aura's bottom consists a lot of teal particles, with them spreading away from the user.

Zeus.description: Zeus is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Era 7. It has a rarity of 1 in 4,500,000, and has a rarity of 1 in 900,000 during Heaven.
Zeus.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, jingle noise plays in the beginning, a wind noise extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. At the bottom is grey fog and in the center, there is a light yellow eight-pointed star, that slowly expands before the left edges glow light yellow a
Zeus.appearance: When equipped, Zeus takes appearance of a golden-colored aura, with the player standing in a menacing pose, holding their weapon and hand up to the sky. The player also gets orange-glowing eyes, as well as a lot of lighting-like particles swarming the player. Finally, the aura's floor consists a lot of yellow lighting particles.
Zeus.ability: [F] : When activated, the player teleports a high distance into the air, before throwing the lightning bolt they are holding straight into ground, wherever the player's cursor is pointing, creating a small explosion, and making the screen flash black when it lands. After this, the player teleports back to the ground, creating a small smoke effect where the bolt lands. Any player caught in the hitbox will deal 15 HP in damage to them. This move can hit up to around 118 studs away from the user, and has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
Zeus.lore: It has the image of a creature that once ruled the sky. . It threatened its adversary by blowing thunder and lightning .

Solar_Solstice.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Solar_Solstice.description: Solar is a Unique tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 50,000 chance of being rolled and 1 in 5,000 chance in the Daytime.
Solar_Solstice.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a light orangish-yellow, revealing . Its breakthrough variant, instead of the glow from the edges, includes an orange and yellow star that will slowly expand before revealing .
Solar_Solstice.appearance: Solar features a bright symbol above the player, symbolizing the sun, alongside yellow, hazy clouds. It also includes 5 bright yellow, sword-like beams, equally spaced out, that circle around the player’s torso, as well as a swirling pool of fire beneath the player’s feet. In contrast to its "opposite" Lunar, Solar also displays small, spinning fire particles around the player.
Solar_Solstice.lore: It was made with Sunshine by an Unknown being on a bright day.

Galaxy.description: Galaxy is a Mythic tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 5,000,000 chance of being rolled and 1 in 1,000,000 chance in the Singularity biome.
Galaxy.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, and a quick jingle effect plays. A wind noise is also present for the entirety of the cutscene. At the bottom of the screen is a grey and in the center, a purplish blue eight-pointed star revolves while slowly expanding, before the edges glow light blue, revealing . -
Galaxy.appearance: Galaxy features a bright, white-purple, spiral-shaped galaxy, providing the player with a star-like circular halo above their head. White-purple fiery effect trailing from the player's body, with a small semi-transparent portal on the ground below. The player floats in a horizontally sideways-facing position, similar to the animation that Gargantua has.
Galaxy.lore: It comes from an unbelievably vast space itself.

Lunar_Full_Moon.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Lunar_Full_Moon.description: Lunar is a Unique tier aura added prior to the Main Update, and has a 1 in 50,000 chance of being rolled and 1 in 5,000 chance in the Nighttime.
Lunar_Full_Moon.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow a light purple, revealing . Its breakthrough variant, instead of the glow from the edges, includes a light purple star that will slowly expand before revealing .
Lunar_Full_Moon.appearance: Lunar features a crescent moon, with purple, hazy clouds floating atop the player's head. It also includes stars, that appear to move from dot to dot around the torso, appearing to be a constellation, with a swirling pool of purple and blue mist beneath the player’s feet.
Lunar_Full_Moon.lore: It was made with Moonlight by an Unknown being on a quiet night.

Moonchild.obtainment: Exclusive to THE RADIANT FOREST (1 in 5,000,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Moonchild.description: Moonchild is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Radiant Forest Update. It can only be rolled inside the The Radiant Forest with a chance of 1 in 5,000,000.
Moonchild.lore: For a time, those it chose became its co-protectors. Guardians of memory. Vessels of stillness. Children of the moon. But one by one, they faded. Until only a girl remained - the youngest of them all.

Anima.obtainment: Exclusive to THE LIMBO (1 in 5,730,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Anima.description: Anima is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-5. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 5,730,000 only inside The Limbo.
Anima.appearance: A meadow of gray grass appears beneath the player, with the grass moving slightly in the wind and is more or less visible in some places. Next to the gray meadow, neon-white glowing flowers can be seen. They appear with an animation and begin to bloom before disappearing back into the ground a short time later to appear in another place. A kind of gray mist can also be seen and gray-white butterflies fly around the player, appearing and disappearing again at short intervals. On the player's head, a black net is depicted. White petals fall down onto the player from above, combined with small white particles and a large ray of sunlight shining on the player.
Anima.lore: Someone's memory or sense of self, now without even a trace of form continues to be inherited, endlessly reborn through the flowers that bloom and wither, and the butterflies drawn to them, all in a effort to not be forgotten. All in hope that a destined moment of light will someday arrive...

Twilight.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Twilight.description: Twilight is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Era 5. It has a base chance of 1 in 6,000,000 or 1 in 600,000 during Nighttime.
Twilight.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns gray as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a quiet wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. There are tiny purple particles floating up from the bottom of the screen, similar to sparks. A purple, eight-pointed star appears in the center, revolving while slowly expandi
Twilight.appearance: Twilight provides the player with a crescent moon to rest on, along with a unique pose, featuring the player resting on the moon with one leg up. Additionally, there appears to be a spinning star orbiting around the player. The aura also gives the player a large, spinning halo, floating above. Below the player, there is a purple portal effect. The effects emitting from the player and the orbiting star also react to the aura's beat; for example, when the music is quiet, the speed is slower, and when there is a faster beat in the music, it increases the speed of the effects. If there is no music, some effects will freeze in place. There is also a purple constellation effect that occasionally spawns around the player, resembling the ones that Lunar also spawns in.
Twilight.lore: A jewel that shines brightly once every thousand years in the deepest part of the forest. No one has ever seen how bright that light is. According to rumors, the moon gives gifts to those who look at the gem with a pure heart without any evil...

Astronaut.obtainment: Exclusive to SINGULARITY (1 in 6,117,186); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Astronaut.description: Astronaut is an Mythic rarity aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It can only be rolled inside the Singularity biome with a chance of 1 in 6,117,196.
Astronaut.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === An 8 pointed star with 3 dark blue points, 2 light blue points, 2 points with an orange-black gradient and 1 fully orange point appears. As the star expands, the upper half of the cutscene turns into a blue-black gradient while the lower half becomes a red-orange-yellow like gradient, before re
Astronaut.appearance: When equipped, Astronaut takes appearance of a cosmos-related aura, with the player floating slightly above the ground and gaining a space helmet. A rocketship orbits around the player, as well as space-like particles appear around the player, similar to the ones Orion has. The sun appears behind the player, as well a planet with an alien spaceship next to the player.

Origin.description: Origin is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Era 9, and has a base chance of 1 in 6,500,000 of being rolled.
Origin.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by wind noises that continue throughout the cutscene. Blue fog forms at the bottom of the screen, and in the center, a navy eight-pointed star revolves while slowly expanding, blue particles rising from the bottom. The edges then glow bl
Origin.appearance: A blue and black ring revolves around the player, as a light-blue, portal-like aura glows intensely beneath their feet. Black and blue slash-like effects constantly form around the player as they float in midair, accompanied by occasional arcs of lightning that envelop their torso. Additionally, dark smoke exudes from the player's body, as their right arm is positioned behind their back. The overall visual effects of this aura are similar in appearance to Arcane, Hallucination and Stardust.

Hades.description: Hades is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Era 2. It has a base chance of 1 in 6,666,666 or 1 in 1,111,111 during Hell.
Hades.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a wind noise continuing throughout the cutscene in the background. At the bottom of the screen lies a grey fog, and a dark orange eight-pointed star rotates while slowly expanding in the center. Subsequently, the edges glow orange, re
Hades.appearance: Hades closely resembles Hades, the god of the underworld in ancient Greek mythology. The player levitates menacingly above a structure that emits fire and smoke effects, resembling a portal. The player is depicted as wearing an orange fiery crown and carrying a slightly gray skull in their right hand. Additionally, the player receives a black "pitchfork" on their back, and a small orange chain creates a cross pattern on their torso, similar to Nautilus (albeit with a different color). A pentagram also manifests behind the player, enveloped in black and orange flames.
Hades.ability: Upon pressing F, the user pulls their head back before spewing flames from their mouth, hitting and damaging anyone in front. This lasts for 2 seconds. If a player is hit by the flames, they will take 5 ticks dealing 7 damage each, totaling to 35HP damage dealt. The amount of ticks that the player will be hit by depends on how long they have been exposed to the flames. The cooldown is 10 seconds with a windup of 1 second.
Hades.lore: It has been shaped as the ruler of hell , a long time ago. Though not replicated perfectly, it still remains cruel and callous.

Celestial_Divine.description: Celestial : Divine is a Mythic tier aura added in Era 8, it has a 1 in 7,000,000 chance of being rolled. It is a mutation of Celestial.
Celestial_Divine.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a quick jingle noise plays; a wind noise extending for the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. A purple fog forms at the bottom of the screen, and in the center, a light-purplish blue eight-pointed star revolves while slowly expanding. Subsequently, the
Celestial_Divine.appearance: Celestial : Divine consists of 2 gems, connected by pillars, or 'arms' of light, on each side of the player; a halo with a sigil on it, and the same sigil on the torso of the player. In addition to this, pastel-colored flat 'waves' pulsate out as the ground aura, along with faint rising stars, butterflies, and sparks. The player's aura has faint, fire-like effects engulfing the limbs and torso, as well as some faint sparks. The player sits on a Zweihänder, and floats in the air in a similar fashion to that of the ability of Abyssal Hunter. This aura does not have a walking animation.
Celestial_Divine.ability: The user pulls their sword back, which after a short pause swings the sword from the top to bottom, releasing a projectile that travels in a straight line. After the first sword swing, the sword is then swung from right to left, releasing another projectile that closely follows behind the first one. If a player is in the path of the projectiles, they will get hit and take 3HP 4 times per projectile, for a total of 24HP in damage. Moving away from the Celestial : Divine user as they are using their ability will cause the player to take even more damage as the player is moving alongside the projectiles. Doing this will cause a maximum of 15 ticks of damage, which totals to 45HP in damage while moving at the default speed (No VIP, No Abyssal Hunter's mode). The cooldown is 10 seconds with a windup of 1 second.
Celestial_Divine.lore: A holy sword that seems to have descended from the heavens. A powerful will and peace-granting force pour from its radiant blade, shining brilliantly.

Anubis.description: Anubis is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-4. It has a base chance of 1 in 7,200,000 or 1 in 1,800,000 during Sandstorm.
Anubis.music_file: The Silver Field - Slow Swimmers Shimmer.mp3
Anubis.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a wind noise extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. White fog forms at the bottom of the screen, and in the center, a dark maroon eight-pointed star rotates while slowly expanding. The edges then glow dar
Anubis.appearance: Anubis is a unique aura, as it looks similar to Diaboli with an orange, fiery glow beneath the player, flowing outwards. The aura has three mini, fiery auroras surrounding it, similar to that Aquatic : Flame, yet of a much smaller scale. The character is holding a glowing staff in their right arm, in which is known as the [ Was-sceptre]. The player also holds the [ Ankh]. There is a symbol located in the characters chest depicted from Celestial : Divine, and there are also particles of sand flowing through the aura, as the aura depicts the Egyptian god Anubis (Egypt is located in a desert).
Anubis.lore: The one who guides the dead to the afterlife... more precisely, this is only his copy. The complete form can indeed be unleashed.

Refraction.description: Refraction is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-15. It has 1 in 7,242,000 chance of being rolled.
Refraction.music_file: The Silver Field - Slow Swimmers Shimmer.mp3
Refraction.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A quick jingle plays as a white 8-pointed star appears in the center of the screen, with light gray fog behind it. White particles rise from the bottom as the star slowly spins, gradually spinning faster. As the star spins faster, the fog turns white and reveals .
Refraction.appearance: Refraction features bright white-purple galaxy like particles that spread out around the ground, white-purple beams trail up the players body in a triangle like formation, giving the player a white-purple star in the middle of their torso, small shards of glass float up from the ground, and behind the player are two hovering mirrors that reflect the players avatar and animation.

Faith.description: Faith is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-12. It has a base chance of 1 in 7,250,000 or 1 in 1,450,000 during Heaven.
Faith.appearance: Faith Consists of the player standing with one arm near their face, and another arm behind their back, below them, a yellowish symbol glows, along with a swarm of butterflies constantly swirling around the player. Some bigger, animated butterflies rest on the player’s body, flapping their wings constantly. Above the player, yellowish petals elegantly fall to the ground.
Faith.lore: Even after losing everything, I can say it's okay. Because I still have your heart.

Hyper-Volt.description: Hyper-Volt is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Era 2, and has a 1 in 7,500,000 chance of being rolled.
Hyper-Volt.music_file: Two Steps From Hell - Titan Dune (Archangel).ogg
Hyper-Volt.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a wind noise extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. Grey fog forms at the bottom of the screen, and in the center, a purple eight-pointed star rotates while slowly expanding. The edges then glow purple, r
Hyper-Volt.appearance: Hyper-Volt is very similar in design to Sol. Hyper-Volt is composed of six purple electricity orbs that rotate around the player; three inner-layer orbs, and three outer-layer orbs. A clockwise-spinning sigil is included behind the player’s back. The three inner-layer orbs are connected via thick light purple beams, as they rotate counter-clockwise, forming a triangular formation around the player. The three outer-layer orbs are elevated from the inner-layer orbs and bonded with the outer layer, as they rotate clockwise. The purple sigil on the back of the player features a lightning bolt symbol in its center that doesn't spin, and some other minor details. Additionally, the aura has a unique pose, which makes the player hover above the ground with an aura below.
Hyper-Volt.lore: A phenomenon witnessed many times, yet still doubted by science. Believed to be the clusters of low-temperature plasma forming sudden flashes mid-air. Those clustered energies create Hyper Volt—so powerful it can be mistaken for a natural disaster. It releases chaotic electric currents and circles unpredictably around its surroundings.

Velocity.description: Velocity is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-3, and has a base chance of 1 in 7,630,000 of being rolled.
Velocity.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The cutscene stars with an eight-sided, orange reddish star, a grey background, a jingle effect and a wind noise. Small orange reddish particles float from the bottom to the top of the screen. At the end of the cutscene the star expands with a orange reddish vignette which is brighter in the ce
Velocity.appearance: Velocity features 4 loops of orange arrows along with lightning particles spawning in random locations near the player in the colors of orange or black. There is a fire effect coming from the player on the ground, reaching a circle of lighting that surrounds the player. In the middle of the aura, the player has orange flare in their eyes, similar to Rage : Brawler, along with their entire body constantly teleporting from side to side before recentering.
Velocity.lore: This power continuously accelerates objects until they burn up from friction.

Nautilus_Lost.description: Nautilus : Lost is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-6, seen after clicking on Nautilus. It has a 1 in 7,700,000 chance of being rolled, and is a mutation of Nautilus.
Nautilus_Lost.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen will become black, jingle noise plays in the beginning, a wind noise extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. At the bottom is white fog and in the center. Indigo-ish colored particles slowly rise out from the bottom of the screen. There is an indigo-ish eig
Nautilus_Lost.appearance: Nautilus : Lost is somewhat similar to Nautilus, having a cobalt/azure-colored chain, extending towards the middle of the player's torso. The player's torso is enveloped by smaller chains in a cross pattern, as a bright glow radiates from the player's forehead, adding a mystical focal point. The player's hands are held by what appears to be more chains, and at the top of the player, there seems to be some sort of light beam, having 3 beams of light pointing towards the ground. Said light beams also seem to emit bubble particles around the player. Below the player, there is a puddle-like particle, which seems to be in a similar fashion to Abyssal Hunter, but with the exception of black puddles. Additionally, the walking animation makes the player look like they are swimming.
Nautilus_Lost.lore: A small shout resounding from the depths of the abyss ..

Divinus_Guardian.description: Divinus : Guardian is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-12. It is a mutation of Divinus and can be rolled with a breakthrough chance of 1 in 7,777,777 and a native chance of 1 in 1,555,555 in the Heaven biome.
Divinus_Guardian.music_file: Spade - the fear of losing you.mp3
Divinus_Guardian.appearance: Divinus : Guardian turns the player into a guardian angel. The aura has smoke surrounding it, spawning in and out with a sigil surrounding the player. It has the same symbol that Divinus has on the players chest, with stars floating around the player in a circular motion.
Divinus_Guardian.lore: "I will protect you" it says as it stands in front of you, something about its presence makes you feel safe.

Outlaw.description: Outlaw is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-15. It has a 1 in 8,000,000 chance of being rolled breakthrough or can be rolled with a 1 in 2,000,000 chance during Sandstorm biome.
Outlaw.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen suddenly fades to black. A light-brown star can be seen spinning clockwise. Below, a few white particles rise from the bottom of the screen. The star slowly grows in size, until the edges start glowing light-brown, revealing .
Outlaw.appearance: When equipped, Outlaw takes appearance of a desert-themed aura, being similar to Carriage. The player appears to be standing out with a revolver in their right arm, and their right arm at the back. Around the player, a harsh sandstorm appears, which slowly rises up to the aura's top. The aura also grants a player unique accessory, being a cowboy hat.

Spectre_Requiem.description: Spectre : Requiem is a Mythic tier aura added in the Eon 1-25. It can be obtained with a chance of 1 in 8,222,000. It is a mutation of Spectre.
Spectre_Requiem.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== starts with a dark purple 8-pointed star in the centre, slowly encapsulating the center of the cutscene before slowly expanding and a dark purple background appears, revealing .
Spectre_Requiem.appearance: When equipped, Spectre : Requiem grants the player two scythes, with one being yielded by their right hand, and the other one with their left hand. The player also gains a unique accessory at their back, with it being dark-blue tentacles. Around the player, there are 3 light blue particles that quickly spin and go in circles. Finally, the aura's floor has two rings, with them having unknown symbols, similar to the ring that Oppression has.
Spectre_Requiem.ability: Soul Cutting Slash [F] — Upon pressing [F], the user winds up and slashes twice. This deals 24 (12*2) damage total and has notably less range. | Slam of Death [E] — Upon pressing [E], the user winds up and slams the ground. This deals 20 damage.
Spectre_Requiem.lore: The hallow face of a reaper, a ' blackened ' heart within-unwavering. You were made not of flesh, nor light; but anguish, and a heart that does not beat. A Lost Soul ; doomed to finality : And as you drew the scythe that scarred souls to silence, the voice of a hopeless being before you silences. And a head lowers itself. A silence not of acceptance, but grief, for a soul wouldn't traverse upwards here. "The melody cannot soothe a lost soul ." "Then why wait?" Another hallow body falls, with a soul not guided; but torn from it's bearer. "Requiem aeternam dona eis, Domine."

Soultorn.description: Soultorn is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-23 and can be obtained with a base chance of 1 in 8,333,333.
Soultorn.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === begins its cutscene with a half black half dark green 8-pointed star in the center, slowly spinning as it expands, before a lighter green/black background unveils, revealing .
Soultorn.appearance: When equipped, Soultorn makes the player levitate above the ground, whilst also spawning a shadow figure above them, representing their soul (as the name suggests), that mimic the player's animation. The player also gains an effect on their eyes, with it making the eyes look dark. Around the player, 6 black and green spikes appear, with some of them being bigger, whilst other being smaller. One of the spikes also has a lantern that emits green light. Finally, sometimes text "REC" and timer flashes for a second, before becoming transparent.

Harnessed.description: Harnessed is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-4.5, and has a base chance of 1 in 8,500,000 of being rolled.
Harnessed.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A chime with a blue star similar to 's old star opens, with a pale gray background behind the star. The star begins to spin also. The star then starts to spin faster and expands as a gradient black and blue background opens it, rapidly spinning with the star before showing .
Harnessed.appearance: The player shakes rapidly, wielding a blue orb similar to Bounded's, raging with electricity and a blue core. Round blue slashes constantly go around the player with a thin blue and black fog effect partially obscuring the aura. A thin dark blue flame effect expands below the player. Three orbs forming an electric triangle outline floats behind the layers back as a backpiece.
Harnessed.lore: A supernatural force. Its principles are unknown, but it is believed to draw from various natural energies, converting them into immense power.

Nihility.description: Nihility is a Mythic tier aura added in the Era 9 Update and has a 1 in 9,000,000 chance of being rolled or a 1 in 9,000 chance during Null or inside The Limbo biome.
Nihility.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== An eight-pointed white star appears with white partials. and stats rotating at the center of the player's screen. The star slowly expands, and the background is covered with white color all around the border of the screen before revealing .
Nihility.appearance: Nihility is a Null exclusive aura, bearing a similar appearance to Oppression, but on a smaller scale. Nihility causes the player to float around in a similar position to Galaxy, facing towards the sky but not upside down, a monochromatic star is located near the user's right arm. A circle of dark, smoke-like effects dances beneath the player's feet, reminiscent of Undefined. Additionally, a black and white quasar-like disc rests above the player, resembling a monochromatic version of Galaxy's, enveloped in a layer of darkness as it revolves. Instead of the generic way of the rarity being shown, Nihility's rarity title doesn't display its normal rarity and instead is shown as , which is similar to Undefined with frequent font changes.
Nihility.lore: A being that has lost its color—as if its memories of the past have long been erased.

Helios.description: Helios is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-3 update, and has a base chance of 1 in 9,000,000 of being rolled.
Helios.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A jingle plays, as a dark, orange eight-spiked star appears. Tiny particles rise from the bottom. The star rotates faster as the cutscene begins to end, and a white and orange glow covers the screen, as it reveals the aura.
Helios.appearance: The player floats above the ground in a golden chariot with two golden wheels, the front having a solar symbol, which it bobs up and down calmly. Using their right hand, the player strikes a golden beam like a rope downward upon the ground, while in the other, their hand sways openly, holding a spear tinted with a golden shining glow. Behind the cart are three golden, aligned beams, reminiscent of old version Starscourge, near a radiant gold star, emitting a large amount of flame. Below the player, where they float, a barrage of golden flames expand outward, its center glowing a bright white, as it darkens outward before fading. A large amount of small, wispy golden particles rise upward from all around, before quickly fading afterwards.
Helios.lore: In the mythology, A shining god of the sun. They rode their chariot to pull the Sun from the east to the west, making the cycle of day and night

Stargazer.description: Stargazer is a Mythic tier aura that was added in Eon 1-4.5. It has a base chance of 1 in 9,200,000 or 1 in 1,840,000 during Starfall.
Stargazer.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns gray, as a quick jingle noise plays, followed by tiny pink spark-like particles coming up from the bottom of the screen, while quiet wind noises play for the entirety of the cutscene. A black and a pink colored eight-pointed star then revolves in the center of the screen. After a
Stargazer.appearance: The player floats in a transcended pose, similar to Chromatic. A small pink star glows in the middle of their chest. There an expanding, flame-like effect that rests below, starting from a bright pink and fading into a darker pink. There is another flame-like effect underneath the pink one that stays a consistent dark purple color. A galaxy floats to the right of the player with a glowing core similar to Galaxy, and seemingly a nebula to the left of them. A small star orbits around the player, leaving behind a thin pink trail.
Stargazer.lore: The one who watches the cosmos, reporting all the data to the brightest starlights..

Jade_Purity.description: Jade : Purity is a Mythic tier aura added in the Eon 1-24 Update. It can be obtained with a chance of 1 in 9,250,000, or 1 in 4,625,000 in The Radiant Forest biome. It is a mutation of Jade.
Jade_Purity.music_file: DM DOKURO - Blessing of the Moon.mp3
Jade_Purity.lore: This, is the name of a legendary man who approaches ones lost in the vast forest and gives directions. He is kind, and knows the forest better than anyone else. But one day, he stopped showing himself to people. Where did he go?

Amethyst.description: Amethyst is a Mythic tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-16 Update. It can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 9,333,700.
Amethyst.appearance: The user is floating while surrounded by 5 light pink cubes, similar to Kyawthuite, purple smog is around the player. Below the player is a purple ripple/portal like effect. A purple aurora like effect can also be seen around the player.
Amethyst.lore: It was a light; inexhaustible, unending. A power that shined all those years ago in an era dark and demonic all those centuries ago. Each decade from the top of the mountain, that young and energetic girl would bring that timid but knowledgeable boy to the entrance of the hiking trail. Their footsteps shimmering as they climbed to the very top of that monolith, that quiet mountain in the distance. At the peak, where the rocky cliffs towered above all and when evil swelled to it's fullest breath, at the height of the vilest midnight, a gentle violet radiance spilled throughout the streets. The screams of agony and depression quelled. The people looked to the skies and smiled. And so the blackest night split open. A brilliance in the vantablack; Doors creaked. Windows glowed. Those med who held knives in fists full of rage and fury dropped them to wipe the tears form their faces. Women who screamed curses and whispered witchcraft looked up and wept instead. Something within the townsfolk changed on those night, for that light did not burn; it forgave. Until one decade, the girl showed alone. Up at that hiking trail, without that boy; the conduit, he did not follow. Still, she climbed, still, she peaked. But as the vilest, most demonic pitch of midnight deepened into darkness, there was no violet. The monolith remained quiet. The screams in the town did not stop. All to remain was the feeling of your skin crawling in a void, alive, aphotic and terrifying.

Starscourge.description: Starscourge is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 4. It has a 1 in 10,000,000 chance of being rolled via breakthrough, and a 1 in 2,000,000 chance of being rolled in the Starfall biome.
Starscourge.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, jingle noise plays in the beginning, a wind noise extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. At the bottom is white fog and, in the center, there is a reddish white eight-pointed star, that slowly expands before the top edges glow red and the
Starscourge.appearance: Starscourge appears as a red, crackling electricity-like glow, closely around the player. Three crimson stars, with the size of which decreasing as they go lower in height are positioned above the player head — the two smaller stars floating on either side of the player, with the one in the center resting slightly behind them. The stars emit a radiant, almost orb-shaped glow, and are interconnected by a red, flowing beam. Three similar beams join the player's torso to the large star situated at their center. Beneath the player's feet, a glimmering red swirl spirals, enveloped by small red particles that float upwards. Starscourge's idle animation causes the player to slightly stick out their hand and lean back as they hover above the ground, gently rocking back and forth. Additionally, 2 long red-white arcs encircle the player, steadily moving, never fading out.
Starscourge.ability: New — Ability: Starfall (F) Upon using, the player will call three star-shaped projectiles down from the sky, showing where they will land with a one second windup, before landing and dealing fifteen damage for each star to anyone in radius. In total, if all three stars hit, it will deal 45 damage. Starscourge's bullets only shoot in front of the player, and they don't shoot all at once nor are they permanently locked into position during the first couple seconds of the ability, so it is possible to move the camera around to redirect the bullets into different directions. | Old — Ability: Starburst Starscourge had an ability where the player would spin around, then points their arm to the direction they are facing to, then the player shoots an red beam of stars out of their arms, dealing twenty damage to players close to the beam with a one second windup and an eight second cooldown. The move can hit up to 25 studs in front of the player and four studs to the player's side.
Starscourge.lore: When the stars aligned.. the brightest starlights gathered to form this .

Sharkyn.description: Sharkyn is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-14. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 10,000,000. and a native chance of 1 in 2,500,000 in the Rainy biome.
Sharkyn.music_file: DM DOKURO - Siren's Call & Forbidden Lullaby.mp3
Sharkyn.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a hoarse wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene while blue particles float up the screen. The screen also has a navy-blue gradient, accompanied by an 8-pointed blue star, spinning slowly and accelerating near the end, revea
Sharkyn.appearance: Sharkyn is a deep ocean-themed aura that shows a lot of light blue and white colors. The theme centralizes about a shark with the fins on the head, arms, and a shark tail that swivels on the back. Around the player are numerous fish that move very fast in a counterclockwise direction. Three rocks around the player form a triangular formation, creating ripples around them. Sharkyn also has bubbles that appear around the player and more fishes swimming toward the title.
Sharkyn.lore: The poor servant of a ruthless tyrant, forced to show only love and praise upon them.

Guardian.description: Guardian is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-15 update. It can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 10,000,000.
Guardian.music_file: Spade - the fear of losing you.mp3
Guardian.appearance: Guardian 's appearance is blue with some sort of portal behind, having 2 spiky swords on each side, and having rune-like letters coming out from the portal.
Guardian.lore: In an age before reckoning, when the skies burned with endless starlight, there flourished an ancient civilization. They were keepers of knowledge. At the heart of their greatness stood a divine sentinel, the Guardian. Crafted by celestial hands and bound to the will of Sol, the Guardian was more than a protector, it was the embodiment of duty. Ever watchful, it held back the tide of chaos, preserving an ancient spell and acting as its rightful protector from malice The Guardian alone protected the civilization. Wherever its light fell, order reigned. That is until a force emerged from the darkness...

Empty.obtainment: Exclusive to NULL OR THE LIMBO (1 in 11,111,111); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Empty.description: Empty is an Exalted tier aura. It was added in Eon 1-23 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 11,111,111 only during Null, The Limbo, or Glitched.
Empty.appearance: When equipped, Empty makes the player float in an imaginary ball, while having a laggy animation, similar to what Player has. The said ball quickly changes between light-blue and black, depending on the time. Inside this ball are multiple layers spinning at different speeds, a rotating wind that spins around the player, and occasional icons that appear, such as a crown, gear, and an X. The player also gains a unique accessory, with it being a spiky collar around the user's neck.

Melodic.description: Melodic is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-14 update, and can be rolled with a native chance of 1 in 11,300,000.
Melodic.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== Currently, 's cutscene is a placeholder, AKA the normal white eight-pointed star, which is similar to .
Melodic.appearance: When equipped, Melodic takes appearance of a golden color themed aura, with the aura's main aspect being the harp that the player holds. The player is positioned at the aura's center, slightly floating above the ground and playing a white harp. Around the player, a lot of golden-colored musical notes appear, being very similar to the ones Jazz has. At the bottom, a golden pool of particles appear, slowly going in circles. Finally, the harp itself emits golden trail of musical notes.

Sailor.description: Sailor is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 5. It has a 1 in 12,000,000 chance of being rolled normally, and a 1 in 3,000,000 chance of being rolled during Rainy.
Sailor.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a faint wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. A white fog appears at the bottom of the screen, and in the center, a light blue eight-pointed star revolves and slowly expands. Subsequently, the screen's edges glow light bl
Sailor.appearance: Sailor provides the player with a motorized fishing boat, which they ride atop whilst looking into the distance, appearing to brush the rain off their face occasionally. The front of the vessel boat is covered with 4 lights, which provide the player with an increased ability to see in dark places such as caves, due to the intensity of their glow. Additionally, rain particles fall around the player wherever they go, even outside of Rainy weather, and a pool of water ripples beneath the boat as it gently rocks from side to side.
Sailor.lore: No one knows when this rusted fishing boat started its sail all that is known is that it is continuously advancing towards vast, rough waters .

Graffiti.description: Graffiti is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-25 update, and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 12,000,000.
Graffiti.appearance: When equipped. Graffiti gives the player a rainbow outline, alongside giving them a spray can sporting the Sol's RNG logo in their left hand, and a skateboard in their right hand. A wall with large text saying "Sol's" appears behind the player. The wall also has a graffiti, Roll button graffiti and a Lucky Clover graffiti. On the left of the player, a small wall with Abyssal Hunter's anchor graffiti appears, alongside Chromatic : Genesis's graffiti wall on the player's right. Finally, the aura's floor resembles a road that the player stands on.

Imaginary.obtainment: Exclusive to THE LIMBO (1 in 12,200,200); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Imaginary.description: Imaginary is an Exalted tier aura. It was added in Eon 1-23 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 12,200,200 only inside of The Limbo.
Imaginary.appearance: If a player equipped the aura, "i" (imaginary number) appears on the player's torso. On the player's left hand, there is a circle and a point that have a number. The point is directly above with the circle middle point, some straight lines connect the point with the circle middle point and two point from the circle circumference that making a right angle. Rectangles with various different size have a random number below them, appear and disappear around the player. Mist come out from the ground and player's body, pointing to the left. Numbers, π (Pi), and some formulas, also appear from the ground going up and slowly fade away.

Stormal_Hurricane.description: Stormal : Hurricane is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 8. In collection it appears after clicking on Stormal. It has a 1 in 13,500,000 chance of being rolled, or 1 in 4,500,000 during Windy weather or during Glitched, or using . It is a mutation of Stormal.
Stormal_Hurricane.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen fades to black as a short jingle and wind sound play. A black fog appears at the bottom, and in the center, a grey eight-pointed star slowly expands, glowing light grey at the edges to reveal .
Stormal_Hurricane.appearance: Stormal : Hurricane appears as a large, grey storm-like effect, with powerful gusts of wind circling around the player. The player is shrouded in fog, using their right hand to shield themselves from the storm.

Sirius.description: Sirius is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1, and has a 1 in 14,000,000 chance of being rolled.
Sirius.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A jingle plays as an orange and white eight-spiked star forms. Particles rise from the bottom. The star rotates faster as the cutscene begins to end, and a yellow and orange mist covers the screen as it reveals the .
Sirius.appearance: A large, yellow light shines from the player's body, as they are enveloped by a wispy flare of colors. The player floats midair in a pose similar to Origin, occasionally reaching their out with their left hand. Two glowing orbs, one yellow, and one pink, orbit the player, leaving trails of light in their wake. Gusts of yellow wind-like particles are emitted beneath the player, similar to Powered and Archangel and curved light-brown slashes surround them, pulsing outward, in a similar way to Natural.
Sirius.lore: A beautiful star that always faces you when I look at the night sky A special star that shines the brightest in the sky filled with stars The star says to you, "Those who have shone in their life... become stars in the future... and shine on others with their own light..." The stars were always shining on you in their position.

Arcane_Legacy.description: Arcane : Legacy is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 2. It is a mutation of Arcane and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 15,000,000.
Arcane_Legacy.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays in the beginning, accompanied by a wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene in the background. A light-blue fog forms at the bottom of the screen, and in the center, a light blue eight-pointed star revolves while slowly expanding. Subsequent
Arcane_Legacy.appearance: Arcane : Legacy shares many similarities with Arcane, with both having the same walking and idle animation, the same ability, and the same general blue theme. Instead of light blue circles around the player, however, Arcane : Legacy has a larger, singular blue ring. Behind the player floats a large, pulsing off-sync sigil, similar to Hyper-Volt's, following the player on their back, while light blue electricity engulfs the player’s torso.
Arcane_Legacy.ability: Arcane : Legacy shares the same ability as its counterpart, Arcane, but has slightly more teleportation distance (around 5 more studs).
Arcane_Legacy.lore: A powerful spell created by an ancient civilization, it was originally invented as a means of salvation in war, but instead the spell drived out of control and wiped out their entire civilization from the world. Maybe it was... too powerful.

Icarus.description: Icarus is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-12. It has a base chance of 1 in 15,660,000 or 1 in 3,132,000 during Heaven or Glitched, or using .
Icarus.music_file: Aakairo - THE ONE WHO TRIED TO KISS THE SUN.mp3
Icarus.appearance: The player is seen floating above ground, reaching out for a sparkling shiny orb, with golden crystals acting like wings floating behind the player. A yellow flame-like aura and black particles can be seen below the player, as well as yellow fog spinning around the player counterclockwise. The player remains in a floating position as they slowly move up and down, alongside with the crystal wings.
Icarus.lore: He smiled as he fell back toward the earth. He had seen a brilliant light; gleaming, impossible, everyone said. Yet he knew that glow could be reached. And so he soared, higher and higher, reaching out for the celestial nobody could have. As he climbed into uncharted skies, the heat sharpened, the light blazed him. Yet he pushed upward, wings trembling, the shards melting under the sun’s relentless gaze. At last, he touched that shining surface; just as his wings gave way, melting against his skin. His body failed him, and he began his long descent. But he was content. For he had been the one who dared to kiss the sun.

Lullaby.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Lullaby.description: Lullaby is a Exalted tier aura added in the Eon 1-7 Update. It has a 1 in 17,000,000 chance of being rolled, and a 1 in 1,700,000 chance of being rolled in the Nighttime.
Lullaby.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A jingle plays as an 8-pointed black star spinning clockwise appears on screen, nearly invisible due to the background. After a few seconds, the star expands while the edges glow dark blue, revealing .
Lullaby.appearance: The player levitates while holding what seems to be a wooden staff, with a blue star at the tip. A hollow star located at the torso constantly pulses. The player's right eye has a glint, with their neck wrapped in a scarf made of musical notes on a stave moving towards the player. The stave is connected to a big Clef sign, with the musical notes coming from it. An eighth note and two quarter notes connected can be seen floating beside the player. Three clouds float behind the player, near the clef sign, with a crescent moon behind two of the three clouds. Blue particles that include lines, dots, and stars fall from the sky. The floor appears to be a blue themed galaxy, flowing outwards starting from the middle.
Lullaby.lore: As the down falls and the night comes, A graceful and peaceful lullaby comes to SOL's island, A light in the darkest of night, Guiding lost souls with its gentle hum.

Chromatic.description: Chromatic is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 1, and has a 1 in 20,000,000 chance of being rolled.
Chromatic.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns into a black to bright rainbow gradient, an accompanying wind noise extending the entirety of the cutscene playing in the background. Rising rainbow debris forms at the bottom of the screen, and in the centre, a rainbow eight-pointed star revolves while slowly expanding. Subseq
Chromatic.appearance: Chromatic gives the player two color-changing stars that spin around them in a counterclockwise pattern, forming a thin ring of light. Each star has a pulse behind them as they revolve around the player. The title above the player seems to pulse as well. At the outermost part, the aura gives the player a ring of spikes that act like an audio visualizer. The player also gets a unique “transcending“ idle floating pose, similar to that which Galaxy possesses. Beams of light and sparkles seem to materialize around the player, drifting outwards quickly or slowly with the music. Behind the player is 3 rainbow fans/wings spinning clockwise.
