Everything about the aura revolves around the music played, as the colors, sound waves, light rays, rotating stars, trail effects, and the aura tag all correspond with the music.

Plasma.description: Plasma ‎is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-17 (The Boss Raid Chapter 2 Update), and can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 20,600,000.
Plasma.appearance: When equipped, Plasma takes appearance of an aura with a lot of purple and crimson-ish particles and beams. The user floats above the ground in a pose similar to Starscourge : Radiant with their left hand extended to the front. At the user's torso, there are a lot of lightning-like beams, which are connected to the player's torso. The said lightings are quickly tracing the ground, disappearing after. Finally, from the aura's bottom, there are a lot of star-like particles rising up, and then quickly disappearing at the aura's top.

Oculus.description: Oculus is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It has a base chance of 1 in 23,233,340 or 1 in 4,646,668 during Heaven.
Oculus.appearance: Bright fog surrounds the player, who is levitating and has a set of 6 wings, 3 on each side with flower-like petals surrounding a image of an eye, while holding out a circle with a four legged star points surrounded by large circles and 4 small circles at each end of the points and an extra one on one side rotating clockwise.
Oculus.lore: A being that has been granted the gift of ████'█ sight, and watched over other beings; divine significance or not, that have reached heaven, who are unable do ill under its gaze. Its body is made of pure light, making its true form incomprehensable and, a mere glimpse of it would blind a normal person. It roams the skies above to this day, leading the dead to their final resting place. However, its eye is forced shut while in places of evil, for as an angel of its kind is not allowed to see such sights.

Aviator.description: Aviator is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1 with a rarity of 1/24,000,000 or 1/8,000,000 with the equipped, in Windy or Glitched.
Aviator.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a hoarse wind noise. A gold star manifests at the screen's center, rotating whilst slowly expanding. As a fog rolls in, three bronze rectangles obscure the cutscene before revealing .
Aviator.appearance: Aviator creates a small plane beneath the player that hovers above the ground as they sit atop its wings. The aircraft resembles a red biplane, with a prominent rotor situated at its yellow-rimmed tip and a set of wings attached by metal rods in its center. Additionally, a wind-like effect blows against the plane, with white particles floating midair. A yellow aura is emitted from beneath the plane, swirling whilst glowing faintly. Additionally, several constellations manifest around the player, along with a star that sits in front of the plane, pulsing occasionally. The aura also provides the player with a flight cap and a pair of aviation goggles.

Ruby_Brimstone.description: Ruby : Brimstone ‎is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-17 (The Boss Raid Chapter 2 Update), and can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 24,000,000.
Ruby_Brimstone.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A red-black gradient eight-pointed star appears along with a hoarse wind noise. As the star expands, a red-black gradient background fills the screen, before revealing .
Ruby_Brimstone.appearance: When equipped, Ruby : Brimstone takes appearance of a red-themed aura, with various red beams and particles. At the aura's top, a big red star appears, and a smaller red star appears nearby. A lot of rocks, scaling from big to smaller ones circulate around the player, slowly disappearing. Alongside rocks, a lot of red, whirlpool-like particles also circulate around the player, creating an illusion of a whirlpool. The player gets two unique accesories, with them being a pair of horns and a symbol, being a reference to Ruby. Finally, at the aura's bottom, a red floor appears, which emits burning particles.

Apotheosis.description: Apotheosis is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-14. It can be rolled with a native chance of 1 in 24,691,356.
Apotheosis.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black with a purple bar at the bottom as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a wind sound that continues throughout the cutscene. Purple fog with numerous black horizontal stripes appears in the center of the screen as purple particles rise up. A purple star with 2 black strip
Apotheosis.appearance: When equipped, Apotheosis takes appearance of a purple colored aura, with the player levitating in the middle above a wide bright purple sigil. The player's limbs have an ascending bright white-purple aura to them, appearing like gloves. A white-purple star is located in the center of the player's torso, and their left eye glows the same color. Behind the player, a huge golden spear resides, floating by itself. Lastly, from the aura's floor to the aura's top, a whirlpool of purple particles slowly rises up and then disappears at the aura's top, akin to sparkles.
Apotheosis.lore: Of imperial violets and royal golds, a being so pure, manifesting only where divinity is strongest... This is the living embodiment of ascension; the moment where existence transcends itself. In its presence, the boundary between mortal and divine erodes, and all that is finite begins to fall away. Fear and fate dissolve beneath its gaze, leaving only the essence of what could be.

Centurion.obtainment: Exclusive to SINGULARITY (1 in 25,000,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Centurion.description: Centurion is an Exalted rarity aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It can only be rolled inside the Singularity biome with a chance of 1 in 25,000,000.
Centurion.appearance: When equipped, Centurion takes appearance of a purple-colored aura, with the player standing in circle of dark and purple spaceships, commanding them. All the spaceships appear next to the player, floating. Around the aura, a lot of purple, cosmos-like smoke appear, as well as some particles that look like stars. The player also gains four unique accessories - a necklace, a purple visor, a crown, and a cape. Finally, the aura's floor looks like a purple, cosmic pool.
Centurion.lore: Centurion himself. A cosmic warlord of starlight who once commanded endless armadas of starships, bending fleets and the void itself to his unstoppable will. Though his celestial empire fell long ago, and his form was shattered across the stars, his very essence filled with power still radiates and manifests itself through the cosmos.

Blizzard.description: Blizzard is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Easter update and has a 1 in 27,315,000 chance of being rolled breakthrough or a 1 in 9,105,000 chance being rolled in its native biome, the Snowy Biome.
Blizzard.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The opening starts up with the screen mostly with a black background with only a blue 8 pointed star in the middle, which slowly spins and expands and the background's corners start turning blue, and then revealing the aura. This cutscene is extremely similar to 's Era 7 cutscene.
Blizzard.appearance: Blizzard appears to be a very similar version of Stormal : Hurricane. The player holds their hand on their temples with their left-hand swaying backwards violently, the entire body bobbing a lot also. Above the player is a shard crown, each shard spilt apart far from the glowing star in the center of them, reminiscent of Symphony. Further above the player is a large array of shards that look like Frigid's, instead that are constantly spinning, with the ring being extremely large. Surrounding the player like Aquatic is a dual pair of small, white tornadoes, like a snow tornado, each on opposite sides of each other and leaving behind a small trail. White and blue flame-like effects spray on the floor below the aura, with a minty slashing like ring orbits the player quickly akin to Origin. A major part of the aura, a blizzard is highlighted with two, large gusts of snow blowing on different directions, inwards to the player seemingly. Opaque mint blue slashes cover the center of the aura, creating an effect of a wedge tornado while shadowing the player.

Arcane_Dark.description: Arcane : Dark is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 2, which appears after clicking on Arcane. It has a 1 in 30,000,000 chance of being rolled and is a mutation of Arcane.
Arcane_Dark.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a quick jingle effect plays, a wind noise also playing in the background. At the bottom is purplish fog and, situated at the screen's center is a dark purple eight-pointed star, revolving, while slowly expanding, before the edges glow dark-purple, revealing .
Arcane_Dark.appearance: Arcane : Dark consists of several black and purple rings surrounding the player, with crystal-shaped effects of a similar hue traveling along said rings, revolving both clockwise and counterclockwise. A wispy, flame-like effect emanates from above the player, creating two paths of spiraling black line effects. A purple portal pulses outward from beneath the player, sharing a very similar color scheme with Bounded : Unbound. Additionally, arcs of purple lightning momentarily envelop the player.as they adopt a relaxed, yet menacing, stance.
Arcane_Dark.ability: Arcane : Dark shares the same ability as its counterpart, Arcane, but the ability texture color is black and purple and has more teleportation distance (around 10 more studs).
Arcane_Dark.lore: This is the result of intervening darkness into a powerful spell capable of bringing destruction that could devastate civilizations in an instant. This dreadful entity, no longer a mere spell, now is a sentient being Destined to bring down destruction and chaos upon the world according to its own will

Flora_Florest.description: Flora : Florest is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-14 update. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 32,800,000, and 1 in 16,400,000 in the Lost Forest biome.
Flora_Florest.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A quick jingle plays as a 8-pointed gray star appears in the center of the screen, accompanied by black fog that fades to a lighter gray at the bottom. The star spins slowly, gaining speed as gray particles rise from the bottom of the screen. As the star spins faster, the fog becomes more pronoun
Flora_Florest.appearance: Flora : Florest consists of a vibrant, bright pink and yellow aura, featuring small pink flowers and grass below the player, and similarly colored butterflies orbiting the player. Behind the player, and to their left and right, two large pink and yellow flowers sway side to side, spewing shjining yellow beams of light out of the top of the flowers, behind the player is a floating symbol that rocks back and forth. the symbol being identical to one of the symbols used in Oblivion's cutscene. The player stands with their arms behind their back, looking forward, rocking side to side cheerfully, similar to the idle animation on Flora . On the player's chest is a pink heart shape that pulsates quickly. Finally, below the player consists of a very bright yellow light, filling up most of the bottom of the aura.

Ethereal.description: Ethereal is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 6, and has a 1 in 35,000,000 chance of being rolled.
Ethereal.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a faint wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. A purple-white fog appears at the bottom of the screen, and in the center, a light-purple eight-pointed star revolves and slowly expands. Subsequently, the top edges of the sc
Ethereal.appearance: Ethereal has a light-pink and black color scheme, with the player standing on the ground in an idle stance. A medium-sized, rotating ring appears around the player, which is slightly tilted, vaguely resembling the rings of Saturn. Small flames flutter around the player's head, and below them is a circular, hex-like symbol, similar to the one featured on the back of Arcane : Legacy. A flash of light is featured on the player's face. At a point in the song, a star, coming from above, falls onto the player, creating a massive burst of pink and black energy, similar to the color scheme of Impeached: i'm peach, while also completely transforming the aura. After the transformation, the player levitates above the ground. Similar to Impeached, during the transformation, the player also gains a ring of 5 glowing orbs that revolve around them in a ring. The stars of these orbs are white, with a light pink aura surrounding them, and a black aura enclosing them further. Additionally, there are four chains noticeably leading into a small flame of light, high above the player. The flame has a white color, and distorts the area around it by a small amount.
Ethereal.lore: In a country where the vast majority of people attend church, there is a deep-rooted belief in powers, either from 『 God 』 or from the ‘ dark side ’. Their god, is believed a spirit or being that has great power, strength, knowledge, etc., and that can affect nature and the lives of people. Someone will get this, and be an absolute and powerful being ...

Virtual_Fatal_Error.description: Virtual : Fatal Error is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-4.5. It is a mutation of Virtual and can be obtained via rolling with a chance of 1 in 40,413,000.
Virtual_Fatal_Error.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === 's cutscene has the screen fade to black, with a white, eight-pointed star similar to . A few seconds after, the star will begin flashing colors then turning into a dark blue eight-pointed star, then the background and star will begin flashing colors again into green, with it being almost ident
Virtual_Fatal_Error.appearance: The player rests in a pose similar to Origin holding one hand behind their back while floating a bit over the ground. In their right hand extended outward, a laptop that has all of the creator's names on the screen. The player is surrounded by glitches rapidly alongside a flashing glaring warning sign on their chest similar to Matrix : Overdrive. The player also glitches around occasionally. Below the player is a stationary grid with an intercepting pair of ovals below the center of the player which expands outward to a complex structure focused on the corners. Outside of this square is a larger square, showing a more prominent grid effect. Additionally, the grid turns dark to lighter repeatedly while emitting a thin and short fog effect at the edges of this square. The outline is a bright color as on each corner of the larger square expands upward two triangles, at the tip where they both meet have a flat triangle symbol glitching a bit. There is also a thin effect rising upward from the outline, showing lines of code. At three corners (excluding the top left), three outlines of boxes shake rapidly and glitch a bit like Matrix : Overdrive's cube, emitting electric effects and spinning. To the far right and left of the player is a hologram bobbing up and down while showcasing an eye symbol in the middle of the screen, as the hologram is highlighted by a gridded light. Ahead of these upward are two more screens floating higher, to the right of the player being a skull symbol flashing in and out while on the right showcasing a screen saying many phrases including: "Uploading... (below it flashes percents)," "Rebooting... (numbers and protocol below it.)" Behind the player rested on the outline of the square is a large rectangular hologram featuring a large warning sign constantly warping shapes alongside glitches plastered behind it, on the screen showing unique symbols and statistics. Below it on the triangles aforementioned beforehand are 4 squares, two built up on each side going upward as they flash a circular symbol. Everything in Virtual : Fatal Error features a constantly color changing color scheme everywhere from red to blue and green, sometimes flashing quickly while sometimes flashing for a long time before swapping.
Virtual_Fatal_Error.lore: System Logs· [@43_Connection·_from_XXX.XXX.XXX.XXX] [@53_FileRemoved·_by_XXX.XXX.XXX.XXX_-_file·core-virtual.sys] [@132_CRASH__REPORT·KernelPanic_--_Fatal_Trap] -- Booting Error -- ERROR· /sys/core-virtual.sys not found. Warning· Consider examining reports in ~/log/ for problem cause and source A planned downfall has come to a brilliant civilization . They did not trust eachother, and this was the starting point of downfall.

Juxtaposition.obtainment: Exclusive to THE LIMBO (1 in 40,440,400); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Juxtaposition.description: Juxtaposition is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-5, and has a 1 in 40,440,400 chance of being rolled in The Limbo.
Juxtaposition.appearance: Juxtaposition consists of three staticky televisions. There are 6 dark, stringy bands chaining inwards into the TVs from the floor, 2 per TV respectively. They appear to be "VTECH" televisions, displayed above the dials on the right top corners of each screen. On the side of each television is a "WARNING" label. There is a DVD player console below the left TV. The player is seen reaching outwards from the central, largest television, with a hand extended and their legs still within the screen (partially). A 2D eye also covers the player's face. A gentle fog surrounds the player's limbs. These effects simulate the player as a supernatural entity exiting the television screen. Below the aura is a banding circular pattern expanding outwards below the rest of the aura. From it rises patterns over the rest of the aura. Beams of light are seen shining outwards from each television, excluding the central one, from which the player appears to be reaching outwards from.
Juxtaposition.lore: "In my world, there are nothing but lies. But in your world, you can feel trust... You have emotions, senses, and thoughts in your paradise... But all left from my world is { V O I D } and darkness. I wish to experience these... [god] has bypassed me from getting these privileges that you have. I don't think you deserve these gifts... The weight of your sins has already been judged for what you have done." s̵͓̽o̸̠̎ ̶͚̿r̵̯͛e̷̠̿l̸͋ͅe̴̙̋ase me ....

Overseer.description: Overseer is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 9. It has a 1 in 45,000,000 chance of being rolled.
Overseer.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns a light grey, as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a wind sound that plays throughout the cutscene. Debris emanates from the bottom of the screen, and at its center lies an eight-pointed star that revolves, while slowly expanding. The edges of the screen then progressively bec
Overseer.appearance: The player's arms are crossed, while levitating, moving upwards and downwards, with their left foot being lifted higher than their right. Two large rings hover slightly below the player’s feet, rotating, as a purple-white circle of fire below them swirls intensely, exuding flame-like effects that envelop the player. Four massive swords hover around the player on all four sides, covered in a flame-like effect, as they sway slightly, pointing towards a black, eye-like orb, radiating with a white glow, similar to Ethereal.

Exotic_Apex.description: Exotic is a Legendary tier aura that was added with the game, and has a 1 in 99,999 chance of being rolled.
Exotic_Apex.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen becomes black and a dropbeat plays, extending the entirety of the cutscene. In the center, there is a greenish blue star that slowly expands before the edges glow rainbow revealing after a white cracking screen sequence.
Exotic_Apex.appearance: Exotic comprises multiple thin lines rotating around the player in circular motion, showcasing rainbow colors. Above the player is a giant rainbow portal, with a rainbow beam from the player extending up to it, the beam is also flickering. A rainbow wing is also seen behind the left half of the player's torso. Inside of the player's torso is a bolded question mark, the question mark flashing similarly to the X obscuring the player’s face in Undefined. Another detail of Exotic is under the player that is only able to be seen mid-air is a green, fog-like ball under their feet.
Exotic_Apex.lore: Nobody knows where it originates from, and how old it is.

Matrix.description: Matrix is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the In-Dev, and has a base chance of 1 in 50,000,000 of being rolled.
Matrix.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. A greenish fog forms at the bottom of the screen, and a green, eight-pointed star appears in the center, revolving, while slowly expanding. Subsequently, the edges of the screen glo
Matrix.appearance: Neon, mint-colored, spinning cogs float above the ground, gently swaying, with brightly glowing triangular prisms beneath them. Several cube-shaped outlines also levitate around the player, their centers glowing intensely, with an almost flame-like effect. One block resembles a Tetris piece, with a single block protruding from the top right. A mint green-colored cog sits atop the player's head, with a ghostly outline of another cog moving inside it. The player floats in a menacing position, similar to the pre-rework Matrix. A swirling effect appears below the player’s feet, and a diamond-shaped particle is visible below the player’s torso, with binary numbers emanating from the base. A transparent green mist envelops the scene, filled with particles of gears, lines, and other effects.
Matrix.lore: No one can see, hear or touch this; perhaps, it might not even be real .

Runic.description: Runic is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-5, and has a base chance of 1 in 50,000,000 of being rolled, or 1 in 25,000,000 in the Lost Forest biome.
Runic.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A dark green star appears, similar to , which slowly spins throughout the cutscene. Eventually, the star slowly expands and the edges turn green, revealing .
Runic.appearance: Runic is vivid green and heavily stylized with a runic, magical theme. The player is hovering mid-air, legs slightly apart and arms down by their sides, indicating a levitating or empowered state. Three glowing obelisks or rune-stones form a triangular formation around the player, each etched with a glowing rune. Energy beams and swirling green particles connect the obelisks and form an energetic vortex or shield around the player.
Runic.ability: Ancient Pillars (E) — The player slams their legs onto the ground, creating three pillars from the ground facing outwards. Ability deals 25 damage and has a cooldown of 13 seconds. | Runic Burst (F) — The player charges up, then a small green explosion occurs, with runic symbols spreading out. Ability deals 12 damage and has a cooldown of 10 seconds.

Cor_Lunae.obtainment: Exclusive to THE RADIANT FOREST (1 in 50,000,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Cor_Lunae.description: Cor Lunae is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Radiant Forest Update. It is rollable with a 1 in 50,000,000 chance only in the The Radiant Forest.
Cor_Lunae.lore: Long ago, there was a jewel born of moonlight, fated to guard the forests below. It wept for the withering of the world... and so, it gave peace. To the sick. To the broken. To those who wandered in despair.

Sentinel.description: Sentinel is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-5, and has a base chance of 1 in 60,000,000 of being rolled.
Sentinel.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === 's cutscene starts out with a dark blue star in the center of the screen, slowly spinning and increasing in size, before revealing .
Sentinel.appearance: When Sentinel is equipped, there is a blue star appearing on the player’s face. The player’s left arm raises and holds a blue energy spear/sword-like energy beam, while the right hand is holding a shield next to the player’s waist, similarly to Solar : Solstice. The player is surrounded by blue energy and has a blue energy ball behind similar to Harnessed. Sentinel is quite similar to Exotic : Void in appearance.
Sentinel.lore: The most common military unit guarding a magically infused city. Countless replicas follow their assigned orders, endlessly patrolling the same routes. Even after a thousand years, their duty remains unchanged.

Twilight_Iridescent_Memory.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Twilight_Iridescent_Memory.description: Twilight : Withering Grace is a Glorious tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-8 mini-update and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 422,656,000 breakthrough or 1 in 42,265,600 during Nighttime.
Twilight_Iridescent_Memory.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a jingle plays, and the sound of fog is heard. A number/counter is shown on the screen which increases very fast as the cutscene moves. None is shown until seconds pass, and a white star with small pulsing rings appears. 2 trees (only showing their branches) are seen o
Twilight_Iridescent_Memory.appearance: The aura shares many similarities with Kyawthuite : Remembrance, since they are also connected auras. It glows with white light. At the top of the aura is a night staff, with large white beams coming from it and spreading outward. Black branches with translucent leaves float beside the player. On the floor, there are black candles floating around giving a small light. A black base rests at the bottom of the player. The player is levitating with a crescent moon behind them. The player is crying, similar to Kyawthuite : Remembrance , who also cries in the aura. Tiny stars and sparkles float around the whole aura. Additionally, there is also a number that increases over time similarly to the one in its opening cutscene. That number rises up to 8127.
Twilight_Iridescent_Memory.lore: [Cycle 8,127] "Promise me you'll never forget me?" he asked—always at the end. She kept that promise, everytime. Close to her heart, Like heartbeat. Like breath. Until the next, and the next. Each time, he looked at her like moonlight on water. Each time, there was less of her left to meet his eyes. She did not cry. The jewel wouldn't know what to do with her tears. And so, to the forest, it turned back its stars—to begin eternity anew. It forgot every step. It forgot every vow. It forgot every name. It forgot what made her happy. "I've told you this story, thousands of times," she said to a wind that never answered. "You never remember how it ends." She remembered the warmth he never got to keep. Waited in the clearing where time never looked. "If love isn't enough to break the cycle..." She watched him fade, again and again, his memory erased, over and over— "...then let my memory be yours to bear."

Antivirus.description: Antivirus is an Exalted rarity aura and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 62,000,000.
Antivirus.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A quick jingle plays as a white star appears in the center of the screen, accompanied by gray fog that fades to white at the bottom of the screen. The star slowly spins, gaining speed as white particles rise from the bottom of the fog. As the star spins faster, the fog becomes more pronounced and
Antivirus.appearance: When equipped, Antivirus takes appearance of a blue aura, the player seems to be floating, and wields a glowing blue bow. Words "Observe" and "Distance" circulate around the aura, alongside whirlpool-like blue particles swarm the player and the aura itself. A blue portal appears behind the player. Portal's and player's animation seem to be syncing. Blue holograms are appearing at both sides of the aura. A light blue object, most likely a mini stealth plane (similar to the ones Atlas : A.T.L.A.S. has) is circling around the aura, sometimes rising up and then descending down. Lastly, blue and light blue hexagons are appearing on the aura's floor, and seem to stay within it.
Antivirus.lore: A golden age rose from a brilliant civilization. They placed their trust in one another, and this was the spark of their ascension.

Dominion.description: Dominion is an Exalted aura that was added in the Eon 1-15. It has a 1 in 70,000,000 chance of being rolled, and a chance of 1 in 14,000,000 of being rolled during Heaven biome.
Dominion.cutscene_note: === Opening cutscene=== A quick jingle plays as a multi-barred light yellow and red 8-pointed star appears in the center of the screen, with similarly colored fog in the background. Yellow particles rise from the bottom of the screen as the star rotates, slowly spinning faster. As the star spins faster, the fog behind
Dominion.appearance: The player floats moderately off the ground, bobbing up and down as 2 golden wings on their back flap. The player holds a gold-tinted bow in their right hand and a similarly colored arrow in their left hand, their eyes also having a golden glow. The player's waist now wearing holy rag swinging smoothly while floating. Below the player, a white and yellow 4-pointed star stretches across the ground as a vortex of gold particles with swirls, with runic texts arranged in circles swirl simultaneously, fading in and out. In the center of the vortex, a bright yellow sigil resembling a more detailed version of the standard Heaven sigil spins counter-clockwise as 2 rings of runic texts spin the opposite direction above the sigil, the same sigil appearing on the player's torso but larger and less prominent. Streams of particles spin around the player, appearing in the shape of a double helix as numerous bright particles resembling stars spin alongside the helix and similar particles rain down like snow around the player. In the aura's title, 3 different rings rotate around a smaller version of the 4-pointed star on the aura's floor, with the outer two spinning clockwise and the center ring spinning counter-clockwise, increasing speed the closer the rings are to the star.
Dominion.lore: An angel drifts through the heaven's light, bow in hand, loosing quiet arrows of grace as they glide between the clouds.

Starborn.description: Starborn is an Exalted tier aura that was added in the 2026 Easter Part 1 Update and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 72,000,000 or with a chance of 1 in 14,400,000 in the Starfall biome.
Starborn.appearance: The player floats above the ground beneath a rounded purple star that the player seems to be reaching for. Surrounding them are giant flower petals that form the shape of a star spin around them, while a ring also rotates around the player. Below the player is a floor that emits tiny stars. Around the larger floating star above the player, two smaller stars revolve around it. Additionally, two flowers with star-like petals spin their petals, with small butterflies flying around it.

Melodic_Serenade.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Melodic_Serenade.description: Melodic : Serenade was added in the Easter Part 2 update. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 77,000,000 breakthrough or with a chance of 1 in 7,700,000 during Nighttime.
Melodic_Serenade.appearance: The player floats above a calm, purple floor, holding a black harp, with purple strips of sheet music flowing on the harp, and next to the player, above the player is purple crescent moon design, casting some gentle purple light down onto the player. Additionally, two stage lights float on either side of the player, shining more light on them. Finally, small music notes float up from the floor, slowly rising to the top of the aura.
Melodic_Serenade.lore: A calming night serenade flows gently through the atmosphere, it's soft melody wrapping around you like a quiet embrance. The moonlight drifts above, shining a shooting glowas the world seems to slow to a peaceful stillness. Despite any worries you once carried, they begin to fade into serenity, leaving your mind clear and your heart at ease. In this moment, you feel completely at peace with yourself, as if nothing else in the world truely matters.

Sailor_Flying_Dutchman.description: Sailor : Flying Dutchman is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Era 8. In collection it appears after clicking on Sailor. It has a 1 in 80,000,000 chance of being rolled via Breakthrough and a 1 in 20,000,000 chance of being rolled during Rainy. It is a mutation of Sailor.
Sailor_Flying_Dutchman.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. At the bottom of the screen, black fog appears, with dark green fog in the middle, and in the center, a faded green eight-pointed star revolves, while slowly expanding. As the fog b
Sailor_Flying_Dutchman.appearance: Sailor : Flying Dutchman manifests as a large boat, also known as a galleon, enveloped in a murky green mist. The player stands on the bow of the vessel, using their right arm to shield themselves against the violent winds blowing against them, their face partially obscured by a green star, similar to Diaboli. The ship also rocks from side to side, leaving small neon green waves in its wake, as if moving through a strong current. Under the boat, is a large, uneven, patch of darkness, which occasionally writhes in an odd manner. Glowing green particles, presumably the souls mentioned in the description, emerge from the dark patch and move upwards before dissipating. Additionally, light-green lightning also strikes the vicinity of the player occasionally.
Sailor_Flying_Dutchman.lore: The Flying Dutchman . The same terrible vessel whose very timbers are cut from the bodies and souls of doomed seamen.

Carriage.description: Carriage is an Exalted aura add in Eon 1-5, it has a 1 in 80,000,000 chance of being rolled.
Carriage.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, a light orange eight-pointed star similar to and manifests at the screen's center, rotating whilst slowly expanding. As a fog rolls in, dark orange and brown colors appear on the left and right sides of the screen before revealing .
Carriage.appearance: Carriage manifests as a small carriage that constantly moving. The player is holding on to the carriage with his left hand, and their right arm holding the cowboy hat, also covering himself from sand particles, this pose is similar to Sailor : Flying Dutchman. There is a small skull on the front of the hat, a single star next to each side, and horns with a mount on the crown of the hat. Yellow and white particles that are most likely sand fly quickly in front of the carriage. Underneath the carriage is a constantly moving trail of the same color as the rest of the particles. There is an yellow and white orb flying overhead in front of the carriage, which is probably the sun. The tumbleweeds roll across the ground past the carriage and disappear after a while. Inside the carriage there is an open two-tiered safe in which there are coins similar to those that are spawned on the map. There are coin-shaped particles coming out of the safe, like they're flying across the road as the carriage drives off.

Aquaria.description: Aquaria was added in the Easter Part 2 update. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 80,000,000 breakthrough or with a chance of 1 in 20,000,000 during Rainy.
Aquaria.appearance: The player floats sideways, positioned above a small patch of a vibrant, blue and purple coral, and aquatic plants. They player holds a shell, gently swinging it side to side, as if using it as a fan. Below the player, are brightly colored grass, plants, and coral, the title of the aura floating off to the side, with a blue-purple animated bubble pulsing behind it. The player’s limbs are covered in a similarly colored fish scales design. Finally, small, colorful fish swim across the aura, before fading out, along with bright purple jellyfish swimming in random directions.
Aquaria.lore: Gardens that grow from the shortest to the tallest buildings of Atlantis , carrying an unexplainable beauty across them though doomed to wither.

Virtual_Full_Control.description: Virtual : Full Control is an Exalted tier aura added in the Eon 1-15 update. It is a mutation of Virtual and has a breakthrough rarity of 1 in 80,000,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 40,000,000 during Cyberspace biome.
Virtual_Full_Control.appearance: Virtual : Full Control is a light shade of green, and features a large cube with 8 prisms hovering and rotating above the player. The tips of the prisms around the cube leave thin green trails. Around the player, there are multiple holograms depicting screens and prisms, including a cube and pyramid resembling the Matrix : Overdrive but without shaking. The player takes a laid back stance with arms hugged to their torso, while floating in the air. There is no walk animation. Below the player is a square, which has a smaller square with a thicker outline inscribed in it.
Virtual_Full_Control.lore: An advanced hologram device created by an unnamed civilization.

Virtual_Ultimate.description: Virtual : Ultimate is an Exalted tier aura added in the Eon 1-28 update. It is a mutation of Virtual and has a breakthrough rarity of 1 in 80,000,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 40,000,000 during Cyberspace.
Virtual_Ultimate.cutscene_note: The screen fades to black, as a ringing sound plays followed by a wind sound effect throughout the entire cutscene. An eight-pointed, orange star can be seen with a hint of white situated on a few of its corners, spinning clockwise. The background is a gradient of dark orange, grey and black, while orange particles rise from the ground. After a few seconds, the wind sound effect becomes louder whi
Virtual_Ultimate.appearance: When equipped, Virtual : Ultimate places the player in-between multiple, light orange holograms. The player is given multiple wings, and a long, extending tail. Multiple particles of code can be seen falling from the top, while multiple effects related to technology surround the player, similarly to Virtual and its other mutations. On the very top, a light orange, glowing ball can be seen, surrounded by multiple hologramic lines.
Virtual_Ultimate.lore: An advanced exoskeleton engineered by an advanced civilization that refuses to accept the concept of "too much." Every piece of tech and engineering has been pushed beyond its limits.

Harnessed_Elements.description: Good is a Basic tier aura added prior to the Main Update and has a 1 in 5 chance of being rolled.
Harnessed_Elements.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The cutscene is very similar to , but now both the star and the background are a deep, dark brown. The background actually has color this time, since is an aura.
Harnessed_Elements.appearance: Good creates white particles at the player's feet, floating upward and surrounding the player until they eventually fade away.

Hellbound.description: Hellbound is an Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-23 Update. It has a 1 in 85,000,000 chance of being rolled breakthrough or can be rolled with a 1 in 14,166,666 chance during Hell.

Runic_Wilt.description: Runic : Wilt is a Exalted tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-24 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 87,388,744, or 1 in 43,694,372 in the Lost Forest biome.
Runic_Wilt.music_file: Spade - to be in love again.mp3
Runic_Wilt.appearance: When equipped, Runic : Wilt makes the player levitate above the ground in a pose identical to the one that Runic has, whilst also giving them the same triangle, except it's closer to dark-green color now. Behind the player, a large, dark-green portal made out of rocks floats, while also showing a lot of different symbols. From the player's left and right, two empty, dark green cages appear, they freely float, whilst also emitting a bit of green, smoke-like particles. Finally, the aura's floor contains a bright particle at the center, and a lot of dark-green particles form something that looks like a lake.
Runic_Wilt.lore: Decades after the downfall of the Ancient Civilization, the magical rune kept pushing, using every last drop of energy it had left. What was once a Rune used for empowering and energizing was now using it's power to hold onto what hope it had left... All just to see the sanctuary... One. Last. Time.

Virtual_WorldWide.description: Virtual : WorldWide is an Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-8. It is a mutation of Virtual and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 87,500,000 and native chance of 1 in 43,750,000 in Cyberspace.
Virtual_WorldWide.appearance: Virtual : WorldWide takes appearance of an advanced version of Virtual, having a monotone color scheme. The user holds a pose that is similar to the one that Virtual has, holding a mouse cursor in their right hand. A globe, similar to Atlas, floats above the user. Two dots of light float around the globe, and have text above them that changes every five seconds.
Virtual_WorldWide.ability: Access — After clicking on [P], a random social media icon and the previous icons of Sol's RNG will appear on the user's body. This ability is purely cosmetic. | SkyBreaker — After clicking on [F], a radar-like zone appears, marking every player caught in it. Afterwards, they will take 10 damage. This ability also has the capability to bypass PvP, meaning this will still deal damage to marked players with their PvP off, if the user has theirs on.
Virtual_WorldWide.lore: An advanced hologram device created by an unnamed civilization.

Atomic_Nucleus.description: Atomic : Nucleus is an Exalted tier aura added in the Eon 1-15 update. It is a mutation of Atomic and can be rolled with a rarity of 1 in 92,118,000.
Atomic_Nucleus.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A quick jingle plays as a red and blue star sinks into a red background, with pink particles rising up from the screen. As time progresses, a wind noise gets significantly louder as the star gets closer. As a red-pink-blue gradient fades in, the star disappears and the cutscene ends, revealing
Atomic_Nucleus.appearance: Atomic : Nucleus takes the appearance of a giant, floating atom, with the player in the center, their limbs covered in crosses. Blue and red protons and neutrons surround the player, making the player represent the Nucleus, while electrons of the same color scheme circle around the electron clouds. Below, a giant red and blue colored neon cloud rapidly keeps expanding, most likely representing a galaxy.
Atomic_Nucleus.lore: [The Core] of the atom, where most of the it's mass is concentrated. It is the heart of all matter, holding together the forces that define existence itself. Radiating with immense subatomic energy, it binds protons and neutrons through an invisible yet unstoppable force. Within its depths, energy and stability co-exist in perfect tension, capable of both creation and destruction. It is the point where matter becomes power, the unseen engine that fuels every atom in existence;

Quartz_Rose.description: Quartz : Rose is a Exalted tier aura that was added in Eon 1-23 and can be obtained with a base chance of 1 in 97,500,000.
Quartz_Rose.appearance: When equipped, Quartz : Rose takes appearance of a pink aura, very similar to Symphony : Bloomed. The player floats in a pose similar to Prologue, floating while keeping their arms close to their torso. Around the player, two bright, pink star-like objects float. Above the player, a lot of bright, pink flowers appear, slowly floating from one side to other. There are also a lot of flowers at the both sides from the player. Finally, at the bottom, a lot of pink, aurora-like particles appear.

Chromatic_Genesis.description: Chromatic : Genesis is a Glorious tier aura that was added as a replacement for Chromatic : Exotic in Era 6, and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 99,999,999.
Chromatic_Genesis.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen becomes black as a jingle noise plays accompanied by hoarse wind sounds extending the entirety of the cutscene, playing in the background. The screen is covered in light blue fog and in the center, with half stars on top and bottom of the screen that acts like an audio visualizer, an
Chromatic_Genesis.appearance: The player floats above an audio visualizer with 75 shards that plays its music with a luminous ring behind the audio visualizer. Four squares of varying sizes expand by following the beat of the music. Three orbs with a star in the middle spins around the player's torso, following the speed of the music. Behind the player floats a large diamond with wind currents spinning around it. Snow particles can be seen falling down onto the player. The words: WAKE , FROM , STAY , AWAY , KEEP , THERE , THAT , HERE and WORRY emanate from the player as it hovers around and disappears later. At certain beats the music plays, the diamond behind the player will expand for a short moment, releasing an explosion on the diamond, the wind currents becomes more apparent with more circling around the diamond, the snow falls faster, triangles and straight lines emanate from the ground as it goes upwards, a shockwave going outwards in a large radius, multiple square particles appear on the player as it shrinks before disappearing. Though faint, the color of the entire aura barely changes constantly from the base periwinkle to a light cyan, like Overture : History but the change from cyan is extremely short before it fades back into the original color. (When the music of the aura supposed to play does not load, it only shows your character flying like how it is, but in a lower position while the ground shoots up bluish white and or purplish white particles, extending like rain, and disappear just above the player. A circle is shown under the player, faintly pulsing. Three orbs are shown around the player, stationary. The cubes, the audio visualizer, the large diamond, and the snow particles are not present.)
Chromatic_Genesis.ability: When X is pressed/clicked, every player within the radius of the ability has their screen turn cinematic; at the same time, the user raises their right hand and glows. After a short wind-up, it releases a shockwave that cracks the ground and sends out multiple sixteenths and eighth notes along with a giant force beamed sixteenth note on top while putting a white screen on the player and user that slowly fades.

Starscourge_Radiant.description: Starscourge : Radiant is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Era 7. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 100,000,000 breakthrough or with a chance of 1 in 20,000,000 if you're in Starfall or Glitched.
Starscourge_Radiant.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. Blue fog enveloped the screen and an eight-pointed star, that takes the form of star before transitioning to a light-blue color is situated at its center, revolving while slowly e
Starscourge_Radiant.appearance: Starscourge : Radiant features six unique crystals, arranged in three clusters with one at the left side of the player, two at the right side of the player, and three above the other clusters, with darker-tinted pastel blue beams connecting each group of shards. All of these gems, along with the player, have unique light prismatic-like glare effects. Its idle animation is similar to that of Galaxy or Chromatic : Genesis. The groups of crystals emit particles and various other effects around themselves, and below the player, a large zone of particles manifests, with smoke-like effects moving inwards toward them.
Starscourge_Radiant.ability: New — Ability: Starfall • Crystal (F) Similar from Starscourge, upon using, the player will call three crystal projectiles down from the sky, showing where they will land with a one second windup, before landing and dealing seventeen damage for each star to anyone in radius. In total, if all three crystals hit, it will deal 51 damage. Starscourge : Radiant's crystals only shoot in front of the player, and they don't shoot all at once nor are they permanently locked into position when beginning using the ability, so it is possible to move the camera around to redirect the bullets into different directions. | Old — Ability: Starburst Starscourge : Radiant had an ability where the player would spin around, then points their arm to the direction they are facing to, then shoot an white beam of stars out of their arms, dealing 40 damage to players close to the beam with a one second windup. The move can hit up to 25 studs in front of the player and four studs to the player's side.
Starscourge_Radiant.lore: When the stars aligned.. the brightest starlights gathered to form this .

Spectraflow.description: Spectraflow is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Eon 1-15 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 100,000,000.
Spectraflow.appearance: When equipped, Spectraflow places the player slightly floating off the ground with their their left arm next to their torso and right arm raised, as if trying to shield their face. There are four glowing orbs, two inner smaller ones that spin clockwise and two outside bigger ones spin counterclockwise, of which all of them pulse in sync to the track, like Equinox and Chromatic : Genesis (including the floor particle).
Spectraflow.lore: Gems that gathered up farming a pulsing rhythm; creating a powerful beat forged by the beauty of magic.

Lily.description: Lily is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Boss Raid Chapter 2 update, and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 112,000,000, and 1 in 56,000,000 in the Lost Forest biome.
Lily.appearance: The player takes a floating stance over a patch of field. The patch features two sliver flowers, one open on the right of the player and one closed to the left of the player, facing towards the center. Blades of grass array the floor below the aura, slowly swaying. The main piece of the aura is held in a green vine outlining the floor in a circle. The large vine has occasionally flowers lined across it additionally. The nature atmosphere of the aura is highlighted by a green haze, with below a minty ripple effect coming out of the aura and extending in a opaque green fog outside of the vine's circle. Additionally, small traces of bright green flowers appear on the ground before fading quickly. Golden particles sparkle around the aura, and golden lights circle the inner structure of the aura with long golden trails. The player itself has a glow around their torso, making the player contrast with the green aura, and they hold a petal wand, grasping it with both their hands to their chest (being the wand's grip as a vine, extending downwards to below the leg,) and the petal wand facing backwards of the player as if the player is floating downward.

Sharkyn_HammerHead.obtainment: Obtainment details unavailable in cached index
Sharkyn_HammerHead.description: Sharkyn : HammerHead is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Eon 1-25 Update. It is a mutation of Sharkyn, and has a 1 in 120,000,000 chance of being rolled, and a 1 in 30,000,000 chance of being rolled during Rainy.
Sharkyn_HammerHead.appearance: When equipped, Sharkyn : HammerHead places the player on top of a large, blue Hammerhead Shark. The player stands slightly behind the shark's fin, controlling it with blue chains, similar to the ones Nautilus has. The player also gains few unique accessories, with them being a shark fin on both hands, and a shark tail on the player's back. Around the shark, a lot of blue particles and fishes appear, resembling movement underwater. Finally, the player also has a blue trail behind them, similar to the one Abyssal Hunter has.
Sharkyn_HammerHead.ability: |-| Abyssal Scream [R]= |-| Abyssal Bite [F]= |-| Anchor Crush [X]= |-| Tail Spin Slap [E]=
Sharkyn_HammerHead.lore: The poor servant of a ruthless tyrant, forced to show only love and praise upon them.

Overture.description: Overture is a Glorious tier aura that was added in the Era 7 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 150,000,000.
Overture.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== has a special opening effect. The screen turns black as a low-pitched ticking noises play, along with a gong, slowing down by every tick. Three clock hands move across the screen, with each moving slower, followed by a clock shown behind star that rapidly shows time while spinning clockwise slowl
Overture.appearance: Overture is an aura with a deep blue color palette, transitioning from light to light, embodied themes of time and clocks. The player's stance is distinctive, with one hand placed behind their back and the other resting over their torso. A blue watch with Roman numerals is visible, and a blue light surrounds them. The aura features a spiral of three flat clock layers, centered around a gear that rotates at a steady pace. The clocks are arranged concentrically, with their colors shifting from bright blue to deep blue and their faces marked by Roman numerals. A soft blue fog extends outward from these layers before fading. Small blue particles float slowly and fade over time before being replaced by four blue stars, leaving behind subtle trails and emitting gentle flame-like effects. Behind the player are three clocks, with whirlpool-like effects and additional layers, including a deep blue rotating sigil and a smaller circle inscribed with runic symbols. Two hourglasses suspended by chains are also present, with their sand chambers replaced by a glowing blue light.
Overture.ability: Overture has an ability where the player snaps their fingers. When this animation is completed, a blue ball indicator will mark where the target should be to anchor the players from the user. When the requirements are met, all nearby players are frozen in time for 3 seconds. When used, players that are affected by the ability will not be able to move, and all colors become inverted for 3 seconds. However, players can still reset their character, even if they are affected by Overture. This has a cooldown of 30 seconds, a windup of around 0,2 seconds and a range of 25 studs away from the user in every direction.
Overture.lore: Inexorably, time flows forward cruelly. It cannot be stopped, or changed in direction. Perhaps time is a concept that exists in a dimension higher than the one we live in?

Bounded_Aichmalotos.description: Bounded : Aichmalotos is a Glorious tier aura added in the Eon 1-24 Update. It can be obtained with a chance of 1 in 170,000,000. It is a mutation of Bounded.
Bounded_Aichmalotos.appearance: Bounded : Aichmalotos consists of 4 pillars and 3 lanterns that are bound by a chain that faces upwards. The players hands are bound by chains that are wrapped around his palms. Additionally, the player holds a claymore in his left hand. The floor of Bounded : Aichmalotosis dark blue with a light blue glow in the middle, and has many chains coming out of it in different directions. The player is lit up by a light coming from an unknown source, and has his legs glowing with blue light. The pillars are slowly drifting around and are bound by a chain each, having a blue light glowing underneath them. The lanterns have candles inside of them and the lanterns don't move by themselves whatsoever.
Bounded_Aichmalotos.lore: He was a known wizard during the great war against the technicians, holding a sword infused with magic, and... when the war seemed close to be lost, he attempted the unthinkable: he walked to the forbidden prison and unbound the being of darkness, thinking it would help them defeat the technicians despite the disadvantage. When the news spread that he was the cause of this disaster, he got locked in the same spell the being had been imprisoned in for ages, ultimately breaking a prison to become a prisoner.

Symphony.description: Symphony is a Glorious tier aura that was added in the Era 8 update and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 175,000,000.
Symphony.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a hoarse wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. The fire-fog appears behind the star, and a bluish white eight-pointed star appears in the center, revolving while slowly expanding. Multiple smaller, tilted white stars fl
Symphony.appearance: The Symphony aura features a color theme of white and lighter shades of blue, with wings that emit baby blue edges for design. The player is situated 2-3 meters above ground, strumming a violin with bright periwinkle and four-star emblems. On their right leg is a sword in baby blue, with a leathered darker baby blue handle. A Valkyrie hat in baby blue with a glowing white wings section is on their head. Above the player is a large crown-like structure with 10 shards, each split in half with a glowing thin white line. In the center of the hollow structure, a bright glowing white star emits blue fog and flame-like effects slowly. Below the player, similar to Apostolos, there is a layer of flame-like effects spread on the ground, with the top layer being a bright baby blue, followed by a dark navy-blue underneath. A bright light in a plus shape shines under these flames, and a light blue fog effect covers Symphony. Around the player are small VFX similar to Matrix, with singular or double musical notes, small white dots, and feathers falling down from above, possibly from the player's flapping wings.
Symphony.ability: Resonate (F) — The user slowly puts their hand on their sword, before spinning and slashing in front, dealing 20 damage on the process. | Deferred Melody (E) — The user dashes forward which deals 10 damage, then releases an AOE at the end which deals 15 damage. In total, this move deals 25 damage if both hits landed. | Reverberation (T) — The user does a quick hand wave in front of them, summoning an area that heals players inside by 5 HPs every second, for a total of 25 HP. This area lasts for 5 seconds. All Symphony's attack abilities will granted 10% damage while in the area (these effect will last until the user leave the zone). In the boss raid, all the players that participate also get 10% damage boost and healing from this ability. This is also a follow-up ability, meaning it will not activate unless used directly after another skill.
Symphony.lore: "What.. have I done..." In his final moments, a sorrow-filled string melody reaches the sinner's ears. As he reflects upon his actions, he finally realizes his own ignorance. He laments his foolishness—but it is already far too late. The past cannot be undone. The sinner senses the end drawing near, and he accepts it. At that moment, the music stops. And with tears in her eyes, the angel draws her blade toward the sinner.

Felled.description: Felled is a Glorious tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-10 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 180,000,000 breakthrough or with a chance of 1 in 30,000,000 during Hell.
Felled.music_file: Devel Sullivan — Ser Yorick, The Forsaken Bloodborne inspired tragic boss theme.mp3
Felled.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === starts with a bright red 8-pointed star that takes the center, with what looks like a slight sight of blood flowing. As the seconds pass, blood appears to flow from the bottom to the top, before pulsating twice, with each pulse flashing a pentagram, before revealing .
Felled.appearance: This aura appears to have a black crown over the player and a spear in the middle. Its color palette consists of black and red, but you can observe white in the middle of a few particles. Behind and to the sides of the player are two thorn-like symbols which glow red. It has a red and black ropes going up, as if the wind is pushing it (similar to Sirius's colorful ropes), and, if you look at the edge of the aura, you will see red bolts that go outward at high speeds, and at the bottom of this aura, there is is a black symbol that looks similar to the ring Memory has and spins in a counterclockwise direction. The title is placed just right over the player's head, and over the title, you can see Japanese characters (見捨てられた者), which are the secondary title of this aura. If you look even closer on the torso of your avatar while this aura is equipped, you will see the Sovereign auras sigil/logo there, possibly referencing the aura.
Felled.lore: Like a moth drawn to a flame, I continue to return to the very thing that destroys me. Their judgement bearing over my life like a raging storm, their gaze burns through my thoughts like acid. WHY WONT IT END. Their eyes ever upon me, piercing my veins, peeling away at my humanity until nothing is left. And when their hunger is sated, they will strip me of everything I have ever known. Draining the last drops of joy from my soul, robbing me of the life I once clung onto, and leaving me to wander aimlessly. Hollow. Unrecognizable. A Husk of my former self. Only my soul will remain, foul, fettered, and forgotten. Only bound by my sins that bleed through time. Their weight dragging me under the surface, where light dares not enter. No peace. No silence. No end. Only the ceaseless ache of what once was, and the eternal screams of what can never be. To beg is pointless. No god listens here. I no longer pray for salvation, no longer hoping to be liberated from this hell. I only pray to be free, from this curse, from myself.

Impeached.description: Impeached is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Era 4. It has a base rarity of 1 in 200,000,000 and has a native rarity of 1 in 40,000,000 to be rolled during the Corruption or Glitched, under the effects of the or under the effects of the .
Impeached.music_file: Terraria Calamity Mod Scrap - Threats of The Ocean Floor .ogg
Impeached.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A quick jingle plays as a purple star appears in the middle accompanied by a hoarse wind noise that plays throughout the cutscene, a purple swirl effect appears behind the star along with patterns moving from the left to the right of the screen. Multiple small black squares with purple outlines f
Impeached.appearance: Impeached is a royal-themed aura, primarily a color of purple and violet. It shares appearances with auras such as Harvester, Oblivion, and Exotic : Apex. The player is seen bobbing up and down above the ground, with their right arm in their face and their left arm slumped downward. The player is impaled with a smaller scale of the sword used in Impeached's ability, and there is black smog between the puncture entry and exit of the sword. The player's torso is also surrounded by a long singular black chain, equal to the color of the sword. Surrounding the player are three orbs, each with a unique design. The outer layer of the orb is black fuzzy, while the inner circle is violet with a bright white light shining. A vortex-like effect occurs in the outer layer, with a mixed black and violet color. The larger orb behind the player is behind the player, around 5-7 meters back and 3-5 meters ascended above ground. The larger orb shares a similar appearance to the smaller orbs, but with a spiky black effect and a bright star light shining. It also has an appearance similar to Exotic : Apex with purple, black, and violet rays constantly releasing. Crackles of electricity in large blacks and violets spark around constantly, and tiny sparkling effects in violet slowly appear and flash as they move downward.
Impeached.ability: Impeached has an ability that raises the player's right hand while releasing purple particles that disappear right after a quarter of a second and spawns a large 8-pointed star on the ground to mark where the giant black sword will fall. After a few seconds, the sword descends and creates a shockwave, spreading a crack and releasing purple and black lightning on the floor of the aura along the sword with a sigil like the one on the aura itself manifest around the sword. This ability deals 30 damage and has a cooldown of 30 seconds and a windup of 1.75-1.6 seconds. The move can hit up to 15 studs behind the user and 95 studs in front of the user, or just a 50 studs impact radius from the sword.

Raven_Plague.obtainment: Exclusive to THE LIMBO (1 in 200,000,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
Raven_Plague.description: Raven : Plague ‎is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Eon 1-17 (The Boss Raid Chapter 2 Update). It can only be rolled in The Limbo with a chance of 1 in 200,000,000.
Raven_Plague.appearance: When equipped, Raven : Plague takes appearance of a huge raven with bones protruding from its body. The player appears to be standing on the raven's back, in a pose similar to Northern. The player also holding a giant medieval syringe, with it being [ Plague Doctor's mask]. Around the player and the entity, appears a black fog, creating an illusion of them moving. Finally, aura's floor now looks like a dark lake, with many white particles appearing and rising up underneath the raven.
Raven_Plague.lore: The raven is known as a harbinger of misfortune or disaster. Its instinct to sense calamity before others and flee, its tendency to travel in flocks, its dark an ominous presence, its habit of feeding on corpses, and its exceptional intelligence all contribute to this image. Some even believe that ravens are evildoers cursed by witches and turned into black birds.

Lumenpool.description: Lumenpool is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Eon 1-15. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 220,000,000 breakthrough or 1 in 55,000,000 during Rainy biome.
Lumenpool.appearance: When equipped, Lumenpool appears as a primarily green-tealish aura, encased by a large circle. The player seems to be standing in a lake, with many flowers placed around the aura, with said flowers looking similar to the flower the player holds in Lotusfall. There is a ring that circles the floor or aura, as well as another inner whirlpool inside of the circle. Green particle effects also flow around the player. Finally, an outer ring is present around the large circle.
Lumenpool.ability: Yield My Flesh... [V] — Upon pressing [V], the user will enter a defensive stance that lasts for 0.8 seconds. If the user is not hit during this window, they will be vulnerable and be slowed for 1 second. If the user is hit during this window, the damage taken will be reduced by 50% and the user will slash two times in front as a counter attack. The slashes deal 25 damage each. Yield My Flesh... has a windup of 2 seconds and in Boss Raids has a cooldown of 28 seconds. | Ripple Step [F] — Upon pressing [F], the user slides forwards a long distance granting 0.2 seconds of invincibility. The user then does a wide slash after sliding that deals 30 damage. Ripple Step has a windup of 0.6 seconds and in Boss Raids has a cooldown of 11 seconds. Previously, if the user used Blooming Lotus before using Ripple Step, the user would teleport to the lotus while it was active. This feature got removed due to players being able to teleport out of bounds. | Blooming Lotus [T] — Upon pressing [T], the user will throw a Lotus Flower forward. The lotus then activates after 2 seconds, pulsing every second while also healing allies by 7 HP in the lotus's range. The lotus will disappear after pulsing 5 times, resulting in 35 HP being healed. Blooming Lotus has a windup of 0.9 seconds and in Boss Raids has a cooldown of 28 seconds.
Lumenpool.lore: "A guardian of Atlantis, protecting those lesser than itself from the hunter that roams the deep."

Hyper-Volt_Ever-Storm.description: Hyper-Volt : Ever-Storm is a Glorious tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-8. It is a mutation of Hyper-Volt and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 225,000,000.
Hyper-Volt_Ever-Storm.appearance: Hyper-Volt : Ever-Storm looks similar to its original form, Hyper-Volt, but slightly more blue and violent. The user bobs left and right quickly, and are (presumably) holding up their fists, similar to Rage : Brawler. The general structure of the aura resembles its original form, having 3 orbs spinning with trail connected to each other, making a center triangle spinning counter-clockwise, along with 3 outer orbs connected to the center orbs, each emitting a beam going straight to the ground while spinning clockwise. When an orb gets farther away from an orb from the triangle then closer to another orb, the beam connecting them will move to the nearest orb. This is very similar to it's original form Hyper-Volt, but unlike Hyper-Volt, a crown floats up above the user, resembling Memory's halo, but much smaller. There is a sphere orb inside the crown, which is connected to the orbs beaming to the ground. At the back of the user, there is a symbol similar to Hyper-Volt's, but larger and with a different texture. Many small rocks orbit the aura. Occasionally, there will be a large burst of particles, similar to Glitch, but with the color-scheme Hyper-Volt : Ever-Storm uses. There are also portal-esque effects that appear from the ground below the user, and some particles that resemble winds hitting the ground.
Hyper-Volt_Ever-Storm.lore: A never ending and ravaging storm... What was once hyper-volt is now a mindless, powerful catastrophe with destruction in every step it takes. No one can understand how it got to this state, theories spread of it accumulating too much energy overtime, and that energy converted to a whole new power beyond anything, overtaking it.

Virtual_Memory.description: Virtual Memory is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It has a Breakthrough chance of 1 in 232,232,232 and a native chance of 1 in 116,116,116 during Cyberspace.
Virtual_Memory.appearance: Virtual Memory consists of the player floating above the middle of a huge CD. The player is floating, looking upwards, holding their arms out, and their face is censored with a small black and white image. Below the player, multiple headless fragments of the user’s avatar run or walk in a circle, all moving at the same speed. The disc is surrounded by brightly colored swirling particles, along with a ring around the disc, with being repeated constantly. Finally, a beam of light shines up from the hole in the center of the disc, surrounding where the user is floating.
Virtual_Memory.lore: Think of a god that never finished being made. Not glowing with anything holy, just buzzing with this unease you can't quite place, like a signal that never fully tunes in. It drifts and it has no say in that. No hunger, no fear, no direction it chose. It occupies a body the way a guest occupies a room they weren't invited into, present but not quite in possession of anything. And the way it comes into being is the cruelest part. It loops. You don't arrive somewhere new, you just resurface in the same place you left, holding time that doesn't belong to the moment you woke up in. Stuck in an era that kept moving without you. The universe is so precise it almost feels personal, everything slotting into place with this quiet confidence. And then there's this. Sitting inside all that order like a word written in the wrong language. Not broken, not dangerous, just fundamentally out of place in a way that nobody around it seems to notice or care about. Nothing moves through it by its own choosing. It doesn't get to feel its own existence from the inside. It just persists in a body, in a timeline, in a life that keeps happening whether it's ready or not, whether it's even there or not. End log.

Astral_Zodiac.description: Astral : Zodiac is a Glorious tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-6. It is a mutation of Astral, it serves as a replacement for Astral : Legendarium, and can be rolled with a breakthrough chance of 1 in 267,200,000 and a native chance of 1 in 53,440,000 in the Starfall.
Astral_Zodiac.music_file: The Tale of a Cruel World.mp3
Astral_Zodiac.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen darkness and shows an orange star with a fire-like effect coming from behind it, ashes and rays coming from the bottom. A spinning crown-like figure similar to the one in the player's head appears behind the star. After that, a pentagram-like figure pops two times, before ending the
Astral_Zodiac.appearance: Astral : Zodiac has a color scheme of neon-bubble gum pink, with the floor being composed of fog and groups of stars going inwards from a neon pink hue into a slightly peachy-orange color (and vise-versa), with the fog fading into black as it gets closer to the center, creating a black hole effect. Furthermore, beneath the fog-like floor comes a sigil with four defined star-like shapes (one being on each side), with the sigil starting off as a dark pink color, then lightening to a neon pink color, and becomes a shade of peach orange as it shrinks. The aura also is composed of a group of constellations hovering over the fog-like floor (some even coming from underneath). These constellations seem to orbit the player (similar to Lunar). The player is also surrounded by colorful, bright neon-pink beams coming out of the floor with more yet less prominent stars rising from the ground, and this aura also contains small, transparent stars that move around the player leaving trails behind them. The player holds , a pink staff with a baby pink and gold as its main color schemes with a pair of wings coming out of a side, as well as three small gold stars in between the wings of the staff. The player also appears to be wearing a cape made of beams neon-peach orange and neon pink in color. The aura makes a lip-stick pink star-shaped crown appear on the player's head. The player’s pose appears to be reaching for something whilst holding the staff. The more prominent features of Astral : Zodiac are the zodiac sign ring around the player, a large pink black hole behind the player, and a large constellation on the right of the player. This large constellation changes periodically.
Astral_Zodiac.ability: Balance [R] — Upon pressing [R], the user raises their staff marking the area in front of them. After a few moments, a beam will strike the area dealing massive damage. The first instance will deal 10 damage and the continuous damage will deal 1.5 damage per tick resulting in a max damage of 55. | Sanctum [T] — Upon pressing [T], the user raises their left hand and creates a massive zone in front of them. This zone will continuously heal allies before disappearing after ~10 seconds. The healing provides 2 HP every 0.5 seconds up to 30 HP. | Disorder [F] — Upon pressing [F], the user spins their staff as an area in front of them is marked. After a few seconds, an explosion will occur in the marked area dealing 20 damage.
Astral_Zodiac.lore: Stars of every nature line up to form a beautiful constellation. A ritual that imitates the 12 strongest patterns drawn from that mysterious astral energy— It is said that one can read the future with such precision that it feels as though the world itself moves along its flow.

Prophecy.description: Prophecy is a Glorious aura added in Eon 1-14. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 275,649,430, or 1 in 55,129,886 in the Heaven biome.
Prophecy.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, followed by wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. Dark gold fog with a black striped gradient appears in the center of the screen with a dark gold 8 pointed star that slowly revolves and gradually spins faster. As the star spins faste
Prophecy.appearance: Upon equipping Prophecy, the player levitates a moderate distance above the ground, seemingly leaning back to their left side and bobbing their head as they levitate. Under the player is a vast golden cyclone that shines and swirls beneath them, some particles spiraling upwards before fading away. Gold streams similar to the ones found in the Heaven biome rise upwards before fading as well. A section of a large holy golden gate floats behind the player, while the broken base of a pillar floats to the right of the player, while the top half of the same pillar floats to their upper left. Above the player, a large white orb shines, continuously producing rays of light.
Prophecy.lore: The gates, open for any who seek knowledge, gleam bright once more. As The Prophet makes his stand again. Multitudes of beings gather around the sanctuary to listen to him speak. Many walk away from the temple enlightened, and full of more knowledge than they walked in with. With words so full of life, so pristine and ripe like freshly grown fruits and berries, The King wishes to send guards to patrol the temple of The Prophet. The prophet however, humbly declines. Little did he know, that would be a terrible mistake on his behalf..

Exotic_Void.description: Exotic : Void is an Glorious mutation of Exotic that was added in the Eon 1-2 (2025/2/16 Update) and can be obtained with a chance 1 in 299,999,999.
Exotic_Void.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A quick jingle plays as a pink star appears in the middle accompanied by a hoarse wind noise that plays throughout the cutscene, a pink whirlwind like effect appears behind the star along with patterns moving randomly from the left or the right of the screen, fire-fog like effect appears behind
Exotic_Void.appearance: When equipped, The user floats in the air, wielding a huge sword with purple aura emitting on it. A purplish-pink black hole with a star on it is floating beside the user to the right, three beams of light behind the user resembling wings. Below the player, there are particles of different colors that create a portal-like image together. The outer part of the circle has cracks spread around it similar to Sidereum, except the cracks are static. The inner part of the circle is glowing brighter than the other parts, and on the extreme border of the circle, there is a pink-purple aura similar to Ethereal.
Exotic_Void.lore: Nobody knows where it originates from, and how old it is.

Overture_History.description: Overture : History is a mutation of Overture. It is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Era 7 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 300,000,000.
Overture_History.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a low pitched ticking noises play, accompanied by a low-pitched bell, slowing down by every tick. Three blue hour hands move across the screen, with each moving slower, followed by clock shown behind star with spinning arms. It is also accompanied by hoarse wind that c
Overture_History.appearance: The player holds a black cane with a bright green glow at the top, whilst having a theme of time, reminiscent of Overture, but instead in a green color scheme. A bright green star at the center emits green and dark green effects with a long horizontal glare. Four smaller stars orbit tightly around the player, spiraling upward and downward during a monochrome phase that occurs every 6-12 seconds. Two lanterns float to the player's sides, their black frames housing luminous green lights that produce horizontal glares. Two hourglasses dangle from chains about four meters high, with glowing green sand chambers emitting long horizontal glares and green flame-like effects. Beneath the player lies a green star that expands outward to form a clock outline with roman numerals, rotating counterclockwise with occasional speed boosts, symbolizing time manipulation. An outer clock layer, larger and rotating clockwise, adds depth. Surrounding the aura is a fog of black and dark green hues, with roman numerals from 20 to 1 emerging from the ground in green before fading away. Rising particles in green and dark green drift outward, behaving similarly to Overture's particles.
