A unique feature of Overture : History is its saturation shift into a monochrome noir palette every six seconds, enhancing the aura's dynamic and timeless aesthetic. Additionally, the top of pillars on its sides occassionaly switch from I, V and X, symbolizing the numbers 1, 5 and 10.
Overture_History.ability: Overture : History's ability is a near-duplicate of , as it also has an ability where all players within the ability radius are frozen in time. When used, it inverts the colors of the map for any player inside and freezes all players in the ability's radius, except for the player. Unlike Overture, Overture : History's ability lasts 6 seconds instead of 3 (doubled), freezes players regardless if they have or have not enabled the PvP mechanic in their settings, and is colored green instead of blue. This has a cooldown of 30 seconds, a windup of around 0.2 seconds and a range of 25 studs away from the player in every direction. |-|Eon 1= |-|Era 7=
Overture_History.lore: Tick* Tick* Tick* Tick* When the clock hand started to move for the first time , was when everything started to move for the first time .....

Bloodlust.description: Bloodlust is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Era 7 and can be obtained with a chance of 1 in 300,000,000 breakthrough or 1 in 50,000,000 during Hell or Glitched.
Bloodlust.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a faint wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. The screen is covered in red fog, and in the center, a red eight-pointed star appears, revolving while slowly expanding. Three blood splatter appear on the screen, making an "
Bloodlust.appearance: Bloodlust is an aura with a reddish pink color scheme, similar to Soul Hunter or Harvester. The player wields a long, sharp fleshy scythe in their right hand, the tip of it from the sharpest end glowing a bright red light. Like Celestial, the player has a large back piece with a pentagram on it and a red outline, constantly emitting a black and red flame with power. It connects with two strings in a thick, red and black mix leading to two rotating structures. They have a stable form, with their center being a bright red and an inward thin disk of red and black swirling inward, emitting a light red trail at the same time. They also have a long, red beam like Astral's orb. Occasionally, they cause an explosion of blood most likely, and it sprays outward and drips downward before it fades with triangles spraying out at the same time, alongside the star glowing vibrantly. The player's form is shrouded with a black fog and red star covering their face, and a constantly small sparkle effect spraying around them but also around the aura. As the player covers their face, their head twitches around every 0.5-0.75 seconds. The player also bobs up and down while an upward stream like Arcane with black and red engulfs the player. Below the player is two red bright rings constantly spinning, the center ring having the same pentagram symbol like on the player's back. This also glows a bright red while when the spinning disks explode, it releases a large maroon ring outward akin to Chromatic : Genesis's ring explosions. The ring of the aura has wavy translucent red spiral structures, alike to the thing that covers the player that fade in and quickly fade occasionally. Lastly, a small similarity to Abyssal Hunter is presented with a light black smog covering the entire aura.
Bloodlust.ability: Bloodlust has an ability where the player swings their scythe around, dealing 35 damage to whatever people is in its range. The cooldown for this is 10 seconds and the windup being 1 second. This move can hit up to 28 studs in every direction. Additionally, if the user were been hit or damaged by the other players, this ability will leech the opponents' health. The Leech amount will hover between 4-6 HP depends on their current Health Bars. This attack can only leech from a random single target, making the amount of hp recovered limited. In Boss Raids, this ability deals 450 damage and has a shorter cooldown of 6 seconds.
Bloodlust.lore: This doesn't represent anything inferior like a vampire or something, but rather never-ending thirst for blood itself. As the sentence depicts, it shows obsession-almost to the point of insanity, for blood ...

Maelstrom.description: Maelstrom is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Eon 1-7 and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 309,999,999 breakthrough or 1 in 103,333,333 during Windy or Glitched.
Maelstrom.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The cutscene begins with a dark teal star, with with a wind-like particle behind it, followed with a symbol that looks like the one in the players back. The symbol is reminiscent of the one that appears similarly in 's cutscene. After this another symbol pops 2 times, before revealing .
Maelstrom.appearance: When the player equips the Maelstrom aura, a vortex-like effect begins to stir, in which the player floats in and out of. Two large orbs rotate around the entire aura, with a chaotic teal on the outside and a deep black on the inside. Behind the player, a giant shield-like sigil spins rapidly. Said sigil contains symmetrical patterns, along with what looks like a gem in the center. The name and rarity of Maelstrom, unlike most other auras, is not above all of the other effects, but rather, floats up and down at an angle with the player.
Maelstrom.lore: This strong gale have caused chaos throughout the world. The titans have tried to detain it, unfortunately its power is too much to handle without mass destruction, it still roams the world of Sol still to this day.

Finally, the very top of the aura has many clouds, resembling a sky.

Near the portal, a small structure appears, which seems to be resembling a fence of some sort. Finally, the aura's floor looks very similar to a spider web, having a lime-ish colors.

Lotusfall.description: Lotusfall is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Eon 1-7 update and can be obtain with a chance of 1 in 320,000,000.

After a short period, an image of a lotus flower appears spinning slowly behind the star. Afterwards, a
Lotusfall.appearance: The character stands atop a Shining Lotus, which keeps them floating above it. The character holds a lotus, and at their sides is a cyan-blue mist, while several lotus petals fall from the sky and glowing magical balls surround them.

Cytokinesis.description: Cytokinesis is a Glorious tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-21. It has a 1 in 330,400,472 chance of being rolled normally and a 1 in 165,200,236 chance to be rolled during the Cyberspace biome.
Cytokinesis.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === starts off with an 8-pointed star in the center of the cutscene, along with the wind noise. The background mostly consists of dark green/light green and dark green auroras and shapes rising from the bottom as the star expands. Two spirals of DNA strips can be seen at the top left and bottom rig
Cytokinesis.appearance: Cytokinesis Sets the player floating high in the air, they have a massive, green strand of DNA coming out of their torso, and it connects to a green outlined, semi-transparent rig. Below the player is a large, green-blue, circular floor. in the middle of the floor is a dark green orb, with a bright star inside of it. many rings with futuristic designs float above the aura's floor. along with the floor of the aura itself having futuristic, tech-themed designs. Finally, four hologram screens surround the aura casting a soft glow into the center of the aura.
Cytokinesis.lore: A system capable of disassembling DNA while the organism is still alive. It was initially developed by the technicians with the intent of making something able to fully clone armies, but they failed, as it is unable to create numerous clones in a quick succession. This however, did not end in it being scrapped entirely.

Jazz_Orchestra.description: Jazz : Orchestra is a Glorious tier aura that is a mutation of Jazz. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 336,870,912.

A music staff appears and scrolls to the right while musical notes and little stars appear similar to the , and cutscenes. Mini stars come from the bottom
Jazz_Orchestra.appearance: The aura is quite alike to Apostolos : Veil with its scenery and Atlas's golden colors. The player is afloat the ground, raising their right hand upward and looking to the side. They glow a bright golden light from their chest and bob up and down. Infront of the player more downward and also floating is a music stand, slowly moving side to side. Below the player is a golden ring of effects like Apostolos, the center a bright golden vortex as two golden orbs orbit above the ring from the outline, each opposite side from each other and leaving behind a long golden trail. Sparkles rise from the vortex then quickly fade, alongside opaque musical notes to fit the theme of the aura. Behind the player is a large, golden orb glowing brightly, the center of it having a large musical note. Two tiny orbs orbit around the larger orb also like a tilted ring, leaving behind short trails, similar to Sovereign. Similarly to Apostolos : Veil, the sides of the aura have many musical instruments that are present in orchestras. Two stage lights glow a bright golden light towards the player as they float above everything to the far right and left. A euphonium is also next to one of them, facing the player also, releasing musical lines out of it before fading at a point. As if connected to the orb, down below the orb is two sets of golden musical lines like from the trumpet connect to latch upon 4 different instruments, a harp, a piano, a cello, and a trombone, the trombone having the same effects of the trumpet. They all are connected to these two beams of musical lights, the piano and harp on the right of the player and the cello and trombone to the left of the player. The harp is also surrounded by a musical line like a ring. All of these instruments and the stage lights are alive, moving slowly and glowing a dim, golden glow. Lastly, like a sparkling show of snow, small white dots drop from above in large bulk at the same time, enchanting the aura's golden appearance.

Archangel.description: Archangel is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Era 5. It has a rarity of 1 in 350,000,000, and a 1 in 70,000,000 chance in Heaven or The Citadel Of Orders.
Archangel.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as an angelic noise plays, accompanied by a hoarse wind noise and Golden Rain that continues throughout the cutscene. The screen is covered in golden fog in layers, and in the center, a golden eight-pointed star appears, revolving while slowly expanding. The first text ap
Archangel.appearance: Archangel is a striking visual display, characterized by a golden and bright white color scheme. The player appears to float slightly, holding an extraordinary sword with a silver blade and a glowing feathered wing. The feathers transition from a golden hue at the top to beige near the base, creating a striking gradient. Surrounding the blade are golden swirling effects and a vortex of peach and golden rings that emit a bright glow. Above the player, a golden sigil split diagonally, emitting golden, flame-like effects that fade into rainbow-like glimmers. Behind the player, another intricate sigil connects to ethereal wings, each consisting of long feathers, similar to Symphony, and estimated to total 180 across the full wingspan. The aura extends its influence into the surrounding area, where swords fall randomly from above, releasing bursts of golden particles. Beneath the player, golden flame-like effects spread outward before fading. A secondary layer of darker golden flames follows, covering a slightly larger radius. A smaller, subtler circle of golden flames rises to about half a meter to a meter in height, encircling the player. The player also emits a massive glow radius estimated to span 12 to 18 meters in diameter, blending seamlessly with the other effects.
Archangel.ability: Archangel's greatsword is slammed down by the player, causing two layers of explosives to form in a straight line. On the first layer of the explosion, 3 explosions move upwards. On the second layer, the explosives increase in size and extend much higher, creating a firestorm-like effect around the explosives. In the latest rework, the effects would only show after the player's great sword was slammed to the floor, just like before Eon 1. When Eon 1 got released, if you used the ability, it would immediately show the explosions before the great sword's animation hits the ground. Before Eon 1, the effects would only show after the players great sword was slammed to the floor. The ability deals 10 damage for each starting explosion and 12 extra damage at the end, this allows the player to do up to 32 damage if they manage to hit their enemy with two of the starting explosions. This move has a windup for 1.5 seconds for the full move to go off (all 3 starting explosions and the final explosion) or 1 second for the cooldown to run and a cooldown of 35 seconds. Last starting explosion can hit up to 133 studs away from the player and the final explosion can hit up to 149 studs away from the player. In Boss Raids, Holy slash has a wind up of 1 second, and has a cooldown of 8 seconds. The 3 starting explosions and the second layer deal 312 damage each, have a shorter cooldown of 8 seconds, and will immediately show before the great sword's animation hits the ground. This ability most of the time deals 624 damage towards , and up to 1,216 towards if positioned correctly. |-|New= |-|Previous= |-|Old=
Archangel.lore: The most pure, beautiful, and holy being, in the mythology

Atlas.description: Atlas is a Glorious tier aura added in the Era 9 update. The aura has a base rarity of 1 in 360,000,000 chance to be rolled, and a native rarity of 1 in 90,000,000 to be rolled during Sandstorm, under the effects of the or under the effects of the .
Atlas.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a dull-orange, eight-pointed star appears in the center of the screen, accompanied by a fire-like effect emanating from the star and from the top and bottom of the screen. Stars blink throughout the cutscene and coming out from the bottom of the screen, and an invisible
Atlas.appearance: Atlas is an aura with an antique theme, featuring a golden and brown color scheme, similar to Prophecy. The player is seen holding the Celestial Sphere, a globe featuring select parts of Earth, with the continent's outlines in a golden glow. The inside is a rough brown, with the oceans being a bronze metal. The sphere is surrounded by a bronze circular outline and an eight-pointed star highlighted in golden color. The sphere is surrounded by a slightly tilted ring of dust, releasing a bright shining effect similar to Sirius. Two golden balls rotate around the sphere, resembling a golden bright eight-pointed star with a long lasting golden foggy trail. The Celestial Sphere's circumference is estimated to be 25.192m. Above the sphere is a constellation likely representing the Big Dipper, with each star highlighted in a golden glow connected by a soft peach outline. The sphere is surrounded by stars flaking around in a golden bright color, flashing in and out as colors of golden rain or comet rain. A large, flat, bronze-plated compass is below the player's feet, representing all major cardinal directions. A faint golden star can be seen in the large area of dust, which has a diameter of 50.384m.
Atlas.lore: The Titan Who Guards the Celestial Sphere Titan are not merely oversized humans. They surpass modern humanity in every aspect science, magic, society to a degree that the term ancient does them no justice. They built a history deeper and more brilliant than any other civilization. But on the day the [red moon] rose, everything turned to ashes . It is said that in their final moments, the last remaining Titan stood alone, upholding the celestial sphere.

Flora_Evergreen.description: Flora : Evergreen is a Glorious tier aura listed in the collection, seen after clicking on Flora. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 370,073,730, and 1 in 185,036,865 in the Lost Forest biome.
Flora_Evergreen.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The cutscene features a light-green background with a white horizontal line in the middle, a light-green star, has dust like particles moving from all directions all over the screen, and effects similar to the one in the cutscene. Afterwards, an image that looks similar to the shards behind of pu
Flora_Evergreen.appearance: Flora : Evergreen has a very similar appearance to Ruins and Runic, due to nature themed and appears quite magical. However, unlike Ruins and Runic, the aura also uses pink, which is a complementary color to green. At the base of the aura, we see a pink neon flower, centered directly below the player. The flower being sorrounded by grass. Next to the big flower we see two rune-like structures covered with flowers with big holes that are not centered in the middle of the runes. Inside of these holes, we can find orbs. One being green and the other being pink. Aside from the big flower, the other focal point of the aura are the 3 trees. On the branches of these trees, we see a multitude of flowers blooming. Some pink, and others purple. There are also two letters pinned to the left and middle trees. The 1st one has a beautiful statement written on it: "You always have a place in my heart.", While the other one Asks: "When will you come back home?". The player floats above the center flower and in front of the trees. They wear a crown made of vines and flowers and hold a butterfly in their hand, while also being covered by flowers. The title of this aura is very similar to the one from the old version, the difference being that it is adjusted to fit the new color scheme.

Chillsear.description: Chillsear is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Eon 1-8. It has a base chance of 1 in 375,000,000 or 1 in 125,000,000 during Snowy.
Chillsear.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The cutscene starts off with an ice sound effect similar to the purple slashes at the end of 's cutscene and a black and light blue gradient with particles and flames at the top and bottom that are similar to the ones in 's cutscene and a star with white/cyan circular flames around it then a sn
Chillsear.appearance: Chillsear's appearance consists of a radiant, blizzard-like base, with mystic ice spikes generating from the floor. Strong icy winds are visible throughout and seemingly surround the player. The Player floats above the ground in a stance similar to Archangel or Astral : Zodiac while wielding a glowing scythe made out of pure ice, carried over the shoulder, similar to . Snow particles are emitted from the floor and are dispersed into the atmosphere. Lastly, a faint, blizzard-like fog engulfs the center of the aura.
Chillsear.ability: Permafrost [R] — Upon pressing [R], the user prepares to attack and holds the scythe with both hands. After a few moments, the scythe is swung in a circle slashing around the user followed up by a larger slash. The first slash causes 15 ice spikes to erupt from the ground around the user while the second slash causes 10 more ice spikes to erupt. The first slash deals 20 damage and the second deals 25. Permafrost has a windup of 2.3 seconds and in Boss Raids has a cooldown of 30 seconds. | Icicle [E] — Upon pressing [E], the user brandishes their scythe and swings forward creating 9 ice spikes in a fan-shaped pattern. Chillsear.lore: The titans called these monstrous beings "Dreadnoughts." They wreak havoc around civilizations all over the overworld, granting no mercy to anything. Chillsear is among one of those Dreadnoughts, a blizzard formed from a forgotten artifact. That scythe was once wielded by a great king of the frozen kingdom, powerful enough to freeze concepts, a gift from the gods for the king's contribution. Witnesses reports seeing a frozen hell aftermath of Chillsear's wrath. Everything turns to ice sculptures, from living beings, to infrastructures and the landscapes.

Celestial_Eclipse.lore: When the stars converged one last time. And the heavens whispered once more. I finally understood, That sacred light had never left. And I listened

Abyssal_Hunter.description: Abyssal Hunter is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Era 5. It can be obtained via rolling with a chance of 1 in 400,000,000 and 1 in 100,000,000 during the Rainy biome.
Abyssal_Hunter.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscenes=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a hoarse wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. The screen is covered in blue fog, and in the center, a blue eight-pointed star revolves while slowly expanding. Multiple small bubbles float up from the bottom of the scree
Abyssal_Hunter.appearance: Abyssal Hunter is a deep ocean-themed aura that features numerous blues and dark colors, symbolizing the mysterious depths of the ocean. The player wields a smaller-sized anchor in full black, with its bottom tip glowing a shining blue. A lush blue scarf flows loftily in the air, being similar in appearance to Bloodlust . The player's body is engulfed in dark navy and blue flames, covering them entirely, with a radiant blue glare emanating from their figure. Behind the player is a three-bladed propeller rotating clockwise. Each of the propeller's three blades emits a trail of flashy blue light, which fades when another blade intersects with it. The center of the propeller is an orb that glows brightly in a shiny blue glare, connecting the blades and allowing them to spin. The aura's floor effects resemble a flame-like pattern. The top layer is a spread-out black flame that fades instantly, while below it is a bright blue ocean-themed flame that behaves similarly. Bubbles, spheres, and fish of varying sizes—some glowing bright blue and others glowing black—float around the player in unison, the spheres ranging from the size of an apple to a few times larger than a grain of rice. Abyssal Hunter also features a black fog enveloping the entire aura, reminiscent of its earlier version. Blue particles rapidly rise upward or downward, complemented by black sparkles flashing intermittently across the aura. Transparent blue bubbles rise from the aura.

Twilight_Withering_Grace.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black as a jingle plays, and the sound of fog is heard. A number/counter is shown on the screen which increases very fast as the cutscene moves. None is shown until seconds pass, and a white star with small pulsing rings appears. 2 trees (only showing their branches) are seen o
Twilight_Withering_Grace.appearance: The aura shares many similarities with Kyawthuite : Remembrance, since they are also connected auras. It glows with white light. At the top of the aura is a night staff, with large white beams coming from it and spreading outward. Black branches with translucent leaves float beside the player. On the floor, there are black candles floating around giving a small light. A black base rests at the bottom of the player. The player is levitating with a crescent moon behind them. The player is crying, similar to Kyawthuite : Remembrance , who also cries in the aura. Tiny stars and sparkles float around the whole aura. Additionally, there is also a number that increases over time similarly to the one in its opening cutscene. That number rises up to 8127.
Twilight_Withering_Grace.lore: [Cycle 8,127] "Promise me you'll never forget me?" he asked—always at the end. She kept that promise, everytime. Close to her heart, Like heartbeat. Like breath. Until the next, and the next. Each time, he looked at her like moonlight on water. Each time, there was less of her left to meet his eyes. She did not cry. The jewel wouldn't know what to do with her tears. And so, to the forest, it turned back its stars—to begin eternity anew. It forgot every step. It forgot every vow. It forgot every name. It forgot what made her happy. "I've told you this story, thousands of times," she said to a wind that never answered. "You never remember how it ends." She remembered the warmth he never got to keep. Waited in the clearing where time never looked. "If love isn't enough to break the cycle..." She watched him fade, again and again, his memory erased, over and over— "...then let my memory be yours to bear."

Gargantua.appearance: Gargantua is an aura focusing on a celestial body, specifically a supermassive black hole. The player's appearance is a massive shining blue star on their chest, emitting effects similar to Sirius and Arcane. The player floats sideways, moving their body upward to the massive black hole. Below the player is an appearance of a spiral galaxy, composed of purple and blue gas effects. Around the galaxy are constellations like Sagittarius, fading stars, and bright 4-pointed stars in a light orange. Above the player is the main part of Gargantua, where a big black void constantly spikes in and out with a large white spikey layer. Inside the black inner layer, a supermassive black hole with a black sphere and star matter surrounding it in bright orange and yellow creates a thin accretion disk. Small white effects spike out below the black hole, while stars spike occasionally before fading and a new one appears.
Gargantua.lore: Black-Hole The endless craving and void. This colossal predator's size is so immense that it's immeasurable, capable of swallowing even galaxies and there is nothing in physics stronger than it. It has existed since the beginning of the universe even now, it continues to devour everything that enters its domain, relentlessly moving forward.

Apostolos.description: Apostolos is an Glorious tier aura that was added in the Era 9 update, it can be obtained as 1 in 444,000,000, or a 1 in 222,000,000 during The Citadel Of Orders.
Apostolos.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== 's opening cutscene contains the 1M+ star, colored a light grey, red mixture, similar to , with a light amount of fog at the bottom of the screen. Around every second or so, the colors of the cutscene transition from red to blue, with a runic star symbol/sigil from 's floor aura featured, as well
Apostolos.appearance: Apostolos embodies duality—chaos (red) and order (blue),based on the Sol's RNG lore—envelops the player, who wields a bright red spear in their right hand while their left holds a golden orb emitting effects akin to Archangel. Floating above the ground with a long blood-red scarf reminiscent of Bloodlust, their posture exhibits a slight forward lean with a bobbing motion. On the right side (Chaos), a large star with a crimson core and bright red electric outlines emits maroon flames, linked by chains to the golden orb held in their left hand. Nearby is a four-pointed star with a crimson core and rotating shards encircled by a reddish-pink ring, alongside a massive black sword outlined in red, emitting blood-colored flames, connected by a glowing red orb at its cross-guard. Black crosses with bright red outlines and glowing red orbs at intersections radiate blood-like flames. Mirrored on the left side (Order) are stars with navy cores and electric blue outlines, emitting radiant light blue flames, accompanied by a bright white sword glowing with fading light blue effects. Silver crosses with dim light blue outlines, glowing blue orbs, and fading flame effects complete the symmetry. Beneath the player lies a golden sigil, an 8-pointed star with pentagram-like symbols and a square overlay, with each corner holding an orb containing a star. Inscribed within the sigil, the inner text reads, "An immortal being which appears before those who have reached the end of their destiny," while the outer text states, "The chaotic cross destroys everything, and the brilliant divine judgment reveals the truth of destiny." Surrounding the sigil are effects of expanding golden flames, a golden fog, and two rotating stars leaving glowing trails, with small golden particles rising and fading abruptly.
Apostolos.lore: Apostolos . order and chaos are diametrically opposed concepts that can never coexist. However, there exists an exceptional being that embodies both order and chaos. In mythological depictions, Apostolos represents the intersection of order and chaos. In his right hand rests the curse of chaos, and in his left hand, the blessing of order. This powerful being roams the fates, delivering their judgement .

Volcanic.description: Volcanic is a Glorious tier Aura that was added in Eon 1-28. It has a base chance of 1 in 480,000,000 or 80,000,000 during Hell.
Volcanic.appearance: When equipped, Volcanic places the player on a small, volcanic rock that has yet to cool down. Above, multiple more rocks can be seen floating, with the utmost one holding a small volcano that is erupting. Below, a river of lava, (or magma), can be seen, with multiple orange particles coming out of it, representing heat.
Volcanic.lore: Hell isn't Chaos. It is Order without mercy. Deep beneath the skies lie vast and neverending wounds that carve into countless shapes of stone and a darkness no inexperienced eye can see through. Cliffs rise like walls around rivers of endlessly hot magma that act as the sole light source apart from the tall burning flames that seem to never go out. Everywhere there are screams, sometimes far, other times terribly close as each section is designated for a specific someone. At the center of it all, there laid a ruler that lived in harmony as holder of the trident, now dethroned with kindness.

Hasuen.description: Hasuen‎‎ is a Glorious tier aura that was added in the radiant forest update, and has a base chance of 1 in 485,000,000 of being rolled, and 1 in 242,500,000 in Lost Forest.
Hasuen.lore: Bound to the chains of grief, listen to the ones whom the bells toll for. The Heart of Earthsong, The Melody of Forevemore "A life is given for each world it isn't." I heard that tale a million times, and yet a million times it has stayed unheard in the ears of the deaf. I feel sorry for the happy, for those who cannot see and the ones who cannoth fathom such words, such a sight. Pink and green, the song of bloom and the bells of heaven. I held in my arms the heavy weight of a thousand suns, not physically but metaphorically. The likes to which I had never felt; the excruciating pain it was to bear witness to the tragedies that befall me over and over again. Time after time I waste away in the coffin of greed, watching the stars shoot like a timelapse. Recalling the sight of that woman, pink and green was all that I could make out during the fire. I held open my hand and was led to the back of an ambulance, red and white. I wore a weary smile on my face, despite the sight of horror and loss of others that had just transpired in my weakness. I wear that same smile on the day of my graduation, on the day of my wedding and on the day that I lost everything pertaining to these events. I yielded long ago to the wheel of fortune and fate, to which I was given the latter and only the latter. I spent my life reclaiming what was taken from me, and in return I get more removed from the vision so dimly operating. As I close my eyes, a feeling of regret washed over me like high tide on the sands of the beach. I woke up in a forest green and teeming with life. A heaven of sorts, but not unlike hell. I closed my eyes yet again and felt only regret, only shame and guilt for what could amount to sneaking a piece of candy from a grocery store. I mashed my hands unto my head, bashing it against the grass that laid unmoving on the ground. As I lifted my eyelids, I saw the vision of pink and green, the light of an unmoving star. The bells of heaven, the colors of the savior. Something I had not seen in so long, a sky that was always out of reach; something I had not heard in so long, a song that I could never hear.

Ruins.lore: In the ruins of an ancient civilization , destroyed by the destructive rituals and dark sorcery , only a place known as the Sanctuary remains, though it has crumbled in form. For countless years after the civilization's downfall, the Sanctuary became a resting place for spirits. There, the spirits lingered, harmonizing the thoughts of the ancient people with their own magical essence and will, bathing the ruins in a turquoise glow It is said that those who encounter or step into this place will regain inner peace and tranquility

The rings vary in size; The main ring is situated above the player's head, also manifesting the 6-pointed white star crown from the opening cutscene. The two side rings show white text that can be assumed to be runic within, with a misty summoning-circle-like black and white effect on the floor beneath the player in a large ring, similar to that of Apostolos : Veil’s floor particles. The player's main body grows large black wings, with a slightly large wingspan, and small wheel-like parts at the edge-parts of the wings, with the signature X forming over the player's face; similar, if not identical to that of Undefined.

The player levitates in a position similar to Archangel, with their head being slightly tilted down. Behind the player, three huge red circles spin, with all of them having four lines inside them, looking similar to Memory's and Red Full Moon's halos. Finally, from the aura's top, red spears identical to the one the player holds fall into the ground around the player, similar to Archangel's falling swords.

A teal and yellow fog covers the screen, and in the center, a golden crown fades in and out with a sound before a blue and yellow eight-pointed star appears, revolving
Sovereign.appearance: The player is seated on a semi-levitating throne, with their head leaning on their left arm, and their right arm resting on the throne while holding a spear. Both of the player’s legs dangle off of the chair, with the right one resting on top of the seat of the throne, and the left one is left dangling. The player can be seen wearing a blue crown with gold spikes at each end. Above the throne, a large blue/white and gold orb with a gold star in the middle floats in place, similar to the ones like Exotic : Apex, Impeached, Abomination and Exotic : Void, partially concealed by a spinning pattern of 8 yellow and 8 blue colored shards or diamonds that look like an arrow mixed with a lance, the stick being gold or blue, and the blade being blue or gold, combined in a zig-zag pattern, appearing similar to a crown. The crown also glows blue and gold in a zig-zag pattern. The orb can be seen absorbing blue particles, presumably creating a spotlight-like effect that illuminates the throne and the player, or bestowing power. Two large white balls rotate above the throne opposite from each other in a titled manner. The throne has a gold-colored diamond symbol that shines at the top part of the throne, and a blue geo symbol on the middle part of the throne. The floor that is connected to the throne is shaped like a heptagon. The front part of the floor throne has a diamond shape with an "X" symbol that faces the corners. The throne and the floor part of the throne also feature multiple gold engravings. A blue circular aura emanates outwards from under the throne with five four-pointed stars placed on their respective corners, slowly rotating. Outside of the aura, small golden beams of light slowly drip down to then fade soon after appearance.
Sovereign.lore: Look at this Shining Figure Sovereign , revered as the most Glorious and Magnificent being among all rulers in history. He sought only Pure Justice and order dedicating his life to achieving the Eternal Peace in the world, but by Evil he was... [CENSORED]

Ruins_Withered.description: Ruins : Withered is a Glorious tier aura listed in the collection (After clicking on Ruins). Released on the 2025 April Fools update, it is obtainable with a chance of 1 in 800,000,000, or 1 in 400,000,000 in the Lost Forest biome.
Ruins_Withered.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The opening cutscene for appears to be the normal , however, the cutscene fades into a darker version, shifting into a turquoise hue, and then flashing three unique symbols before revealing the .
Ruins_Withered.appearance: The player is in the same idle position of Ruins, but shrouded in a large black and blue outlined star glowing vigorously, and trapped in a shrouded lantern's casing. Two small pillars side to side point upward tilting towards the player coated with light blue crystals and ropes of blue mist. The appearance is similar to Ruins, the pillars in the same positioning. However, these pillars are cracked and tumbled upon each other with their shapes converging to a fancy window shape. The pillars are encased in an icy blue fog and wrapped in it also (strings) with bright blue crystals pointing out of the pillars. Three windows, two being the same but small, and one tall and large one is formed with a bright teal stoic coloring, though pouring upward a bit. They have delicate and intricate patterns showcased in a dark teal and primarily have a moon symbol as showed in the cutscene in the upper of every window. Two pillars differ as they stick out from the two edges. Every window's top and the two pillars have teal orbs on top shining a bright white center. Around the player is some bright mint lanterns floating, and below the player is a large variating forest green/mint flame effect as a circle, the center outline by a large + in a bright teal similar to Sovereign.
Ruins_Withered.lore: Once radiant with sacred beauty, the ancient ruins of the spirits have become a nest for the dead and nightmares, twisted by a fallen lord. No longer shining, the defiled ruins now crave the souls of the living who pass nearby.

Aegis.appearance: Aegis is a large, blue to dark blue and black aura with a prominent futuristic theme, reminiscent of Virtual. It features a rotating laser cannon that floats above the player, constantly emitting dark blue smoke, light blue lines, and light blue stars that move to the backside of the cannon. The cannon is adorned with four large wings, each with four blue panels behind them, along with two small boomerangs on the back. Additionally, there are smaller wing parts with a blue line running through the middle section between each large wing, and a large set of thrusters floating outside its rear end. Between these thrusters, there are interconnected parts, two screen-like objects in each space, and glowing blue lines resembling wires. Six light blue orbs, similar to Hyper-Volt’s orbs, orbit around the midsection of the structure with trails, all interconnected by energy. The midsection also has a black ring that spins at the same speed as the cannon. The mouth of the cannon has four horn-like objects with barbs or holes colored in blue, along with armor plates on the exterior. The source of the beam is a glowing blue circle located inside the horn-like objects, which constantly emits blue lightning. Below the cannon, the floor features a light blue swirl effect that spins counterclockwise, along with various geometric designs, including a hexagon with six lines connected to hollow circles at the corners, six full circles interconnected by lines, four thick lines with triangles pointing outward, and a circular futuristic screen. Additional details include meridian-like lines appearing at different angles, a three-bladed fan effect spinning, and lance-shaped objects that also spin counterclockwise. Floating around the aura are light-blue [ Tesseracts] (4D objects visualized in a 3D space), as well as 3D quadrilateral shapes such as cubes (hexahedrons) and five-sided pyramids (pentahedrons). Various geometric shapes transition from circles to decahedrons (10-sided shapes), then decrease in complexity down to triangles (3-sided), before looping back into a hollow circle. Small glowing circles and straight blue lines rise from the player's feet, spinning and tilting as they ascend. Blue lightning effects scatter throughout the inner sigil, constantly being emitted before dissipating. A screen is positioned in front of the player, displaying various controls and functionalities of the cannon. The player takes on a commanding stance, with their body briefly glitching as they point forward with their right hand. This motion causes their hand to bob up and down before glitching again and placing their hand behind their back, cycling repeatedly, similar to Overture and Overture : History. The screen in front of them follows their hand movement, bobbing in sync. Upon closer inspection, the player’s head can be seen wearing a glasses-like screen covering their eyes, with their right eye glowing faintly.
Aegis.ability: Aegis's ability, activated by pressing the X key, causes the cannon to move back and face downwards. The orbs begin to start rotating counterclockwise, spinning twice as fast. The laser cannon then fires a massive blue beam of energy directly in front of the player, slowly moving upwards with the beam hitting an object or going infinitely, depending on where the cannon is facing. If a player gets hit by the beam, the player continuously loses 3 HP per tick, raw amount of ticks is 20-24, though usually only 6-8 connect. The ability has a cooldown of 35 seconds, with a windup of 2 seconds and the ability itself lasting for around 5 seconds. |-| Ability= |-| Ability (On Player) =
Aegis.lore: Aegis , Named after the ' Shield of The Sky ' Aegis is an anti-star satellite weapon currently being restored by the Science Foundation. It has existed in space for an incredibly long time. During an era when wizards ruled the world, a group of engineers, discontent with this, sought the blessing of the [God of Knowledge] . Over half a century, they passed down their craft, culminating in this technological marvel. Its highest output is powerful enough to collapse a star, but the downside is that after use, the weapon cannot be operated for a prolonged period. Throughout history, this weapon has been used only twice .

Eisveil.lore: A lone beacon shining through the frost lined trees, illuminating the cold winter into a sea of silver light. Its radiance dances across icy branches, breathing quiet magic into the frozen forest.

Afterwards, the stars pulses once, then the pulsing sound plays mu
Dreamscape.appearance: When equipped, the player rises into the air. Streetlights and various other road signs accompany the player, floating with the player. The player head covered by a black square that flickering the phrase "Wake Up.". Above the player, a bright, star-like light shines, while what can be interpreted as fog blankets the aura.
Dreamscape.lore: *DAY 109* I keep having the same dream, over and over again. In it, I'm always walking along an endless road. I can't tell whatever it's day or night, but the sky glows with an artificial light, and thick fog blankets everything. Street lamps flicker sporadically along the path, accompanied by scattered road signs. But I've never seen a car, a person, or even a single thing moving. Each time I dream, the duration seems to stretch longer. At first, it felt like less than an hour. But now... It feels like decades have passed. There seems to be nothing allowed to me but walking. Or maybe I've long since forgotten how to even try doing anything else. When I walk in this dream, I count the seconds. 2,207,568,830... I think it's been over seventy years. Please, someone get me out of here. Where is this? Free me. What is happening to me? Let me out. Who am I? Help me please... Maybe death would be better than this...

Poseidon_Atlantis.description: Poseidon : Atlantis is a Glorious tier aura added in the Eon 1-25. It can be obtained with a chance of 1 in 850,000,000 or 1 in 212,500,000 during Rainy. It is a mutation of Poseidon.
Poseidon_Atlantis.appearance: The player seems underwater and is seen floating, wearing a golden-like crown with a blue crystal on the front while also holding a big trident with a blue orb attached to it. The trident faces towards a giant yellow light. Pillars, bubbles and algaes seem to be floating around the whole aura. There are also four little stars rotating above the player and the whole aura.
Poseidon_Atlantis.lore: "Atlantis rose in the middle of the enormous ocean, where the waters were too deep for light to reach and too dangerous to travel on. Its walls were as high as cliffs compared to the creatures living within them, separating them from the outside. Giant statues of Poseidon stood high on every road, almost like patrolling them with silence. Bright crystals within its foundation made the city shine from every angle. To the faithful, Atlantis was paradise; to the exiled, it was a monument of obsession." -Sailor's Journal

Behind the wings floats a second, larger eye, with a gold crest around it. The player is wrapped in a golden ribbon while holding a sword. The blade is seemingly made of light, and the cross-guard has a hole in the center with a star inside. The cross-guard consists of two wings, leading down into the hilt, which has a spiked hand guard. Over the players head, a large, realistic png of an eye glows yellow. Floating around the player are two rings of gold-crested blue eyes. On the ground, there is a large gold lighting effect that constantly pulses outward. There are also small rainbow reflections that appear and rotate on the ground, as well as a large, pulsing ring with symbols inside it slowly rotating the player. There is a large, golden beam shining up from the ground, reaching a third, even larger eye at the top of the aura, surrounded by a detailed golden crest. All around the top of the aura, there are golden clouds that slowly spiral upwards towards the eye.

", " leave me alone. ", " you're a monster. ", " he's not real. ", " save me. ", and " i feel █████'s presence. " Behind the player, a creature looms behind them, its hands to the left and right of the player with 4 claws and a head without a lower jaw; making the lower jaw look like a smoothed-out triangle.
Nyctophobia.lore: I've always been afraid of the dark. Countless nightmares, endlessly falling deeper into nothingness. Until one day, something caught my fall. Something so horrible, I froze up in terror. I always hear them.. I always feel [█████]'s presence... So close yet so far away... always lurking. It's a monster. A fragment of my twisted dreams. A ripped page In a word-less book. Is this reality? No, This is a nightmare ever-lasting.

Luminosity.lore: "Audite me, arma mea. Quaerite semina chaos in hoc mundo relicta, et amne chaos purgate." The era of primordial chaos came to an end by the hands of Sol. Sol knew—no, he could feel—that fragments of the chaos he had annihilated still lingered in the world. He understood that his mission would not be complete until every last trace of it was purged. Yet the remnants of chaos were too small, too well hidden, for even him to find. Thus, Sol bestowed consciousness upon his weapons, leaving them behind as his legacy—so that even after his disappearance, they would continue the eternal hunt for chaos. However, an unforeseen variable arose. Chaos began to grow its power much faster than Sol had anticipated. The other weapons, scattered across the world in pursuit of the seeds of chaos, were destroyed by its resurgence—until only one remained. The sword that carried the brightest light. The blade Luminosity, symbol of Sol's purest power, bears a name that is not only its own but also that of a transcendent being dwelling within it. Now, it stands as Sol's final legacy—and the only key to the tomb where he rests. For countless ages, the sword has continued its search, seeking both the shattered remnants of its kin and the dormant seeds of chaos.

Equinox.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === 's cutscene starts with the screen having two clear black and white sides that swap on beat. It features a star in the middle that is affected by the black and white sides. There are pulse effects, music bars, and vertical lines that appear with the beat of the music, along with smoke and spark
Equinox.appearance: When the player equips Equinox, one black and one white sphere appear and circle around the player. A neon-white star can be seen within these spheres, a white ring also appears around both spheres. A white circle appears below the player, which releases small black splinters and spreads them. One large black and one large white circle forms around the underside of the entire aura. In the very center of the aura, along with the player, is a Chinese word,「 衡 」, below the player, which translates to "balance" in English. Four small orbs with the Chinese words 陰 , 陽 , 衡 , and 無 are formed around the player's head respectively. Zooming the camera closer to Equinox will result in black and white music bars bouncing in sync with the orbs exploding, along with an effect in which the screen starts bouncing. The main gimmick in which Equinox functions is in which it inverts the black and white colors that the aura contains according to the beat of the music it plays.
Equinox.ability: 陰 · Release (E) — The user puts their arms together and spin, putting their head in their arms while the orbs move faster and closer to the player before slowing to an almost complete stop. A sigil pulses along with text 6 times throughout the ability. The text that appears during each pulse is chosen from two sentences: " Don't. Don't. Run. Run. Away. Away. From. From. Your. Your. Fate. Fate. " or " Come. Come. And. And. Face. Face. Your. Your. True. True. Destiny. Destiny. " On the final pulse, the Chinese word "陰" appears. The orbs spin rapidly and a shockwave is released, dealing 4 hits that deal 50 damage in total (20 + 15 + 10 + 5). The hits landed depend on the distance of nearby players, increasing the amount of hits landed the lesser the distance. Meaning, if they were decently far from the user but enough to get affected by the ability, it would only deal 5 damage, increasing the damage dealt if they were close enough beforehand. 陰 · Release has a windup of 3.6 seconds and in Boss Raids has a cooldown of 6 seconds. | 陽 · Confiscation (T) — The user sends a star onto the area ahead, then said star turns into a black hole, sucking up debris from the nearby terrain and dealing 1.5 damage per hit for 40 hits to players near the black hole (60 damage total). The black hole's position is always on a decent distance in front of the user, meaning they can move the black hole to their desire by moving or changing directions. Additionally, this ability can heal the user proportional to the targets affected by the black hole (even players having their PvP off). The ability can heal the user up until around 150 health, if several players are affected (ex. players at spawn). The healing is reduced in boss fights because in fact, the healing is proportional to how many entities that are affected by the black hole (including players). 陽 · Confiscation has a windup of 6.5 seconds and in Boss Raids has a cooldown of 30 seconds. | 無 · Extinction (R) — The user T-poses, stopping both orbs from spinning. The user then puts their hand together and spins counter-clockwise, the orbs converging and fusing, causing a yin yang symbol to appear, along with the Chinese word, 無. After a short windup, the user fires a black & white beam wherever they are facing, dealing high damage to anyone hit similar to Aegis. This beam deals ~70 damage if the entire duration hits. The range of the beam is also infinite, only stopping upon hitting an obstacle.
Equinox.lore: The force that exists between [Positive] and [Negative] . Something that is made up of the concept itself. All that is known about this substance is that it is simply between [Positive] and [Negative] , and nothing else. Creator's Note You probably know what this aura is. I actually regretted deleting this aura. So I decided to reappear it this time with a different form, with a ridiculous rarity of 2.5 Billion. Well, whether this satisfies the rarity of 2.5 Billion is up to you to decide (sure it doesn't), but this aura is still special to me. Congratulations!

Tree_House.description: Tree House‎‎ is a Transcendent tier aura that was added in the radiant forest update, and has a base chance of 1 in 3,800,000,000 of being rolled, and 1 in 1,900,000,000 in Lost Forest.
Tree_House.cutscene_note: The Tree House Cutscene has dialogue. "Long ago, a seed took flight, And grew a tree with a heart of light. As seasons passed, leaves drifted away, Now life blooms here, both night and day. Would you relive it, come what may?"
Tree_House.ability: Enchanted Shockwave, Nature's Guard, Healing Beam, Nature's Wrath, and Healing Haze
Tree_House.lore: “In the heart of a vast and endless forest, where the sun’s golden gaze scarcely touched the earth, a Tree rose taller than all others. Its branches stretched towards the heavens, and its roots delved deep into the forgotten soil, as though reaching for something far beyond the world's grasp. For it was not born of life alone, nor nurtured by rain or sunlight, but by the Hopes of those who once believed. Every wish whispered beneath the stars, every dream carried into the unknown, and every prayer lost to the wind had found its way into the heart of this ancient being. And so it grew. Through seasons, it stood untouched by the passing of time, a silent witness to the world that lived and perished beneath its branches. Though the forest around it changed, though mighty trees fell and new saplings rose, its presence remained. A light in darkness, a promise amidst despair. Those who wandered without purpose found their way to it. The lost, the weary, the forgotten gathered beneath its sheltering boughs, drawn not by the promise of salvation, but by a warmth they could scarcely explain. Even those defeated in battle, removed from their home regardless if due to pride, whose names had been swallowed by history and whose dreams had been shattered upon the cruel edges of fate, found themselves drawn to its gentle radiance. Magicians who had once stood unyielding upon bloodied fields now lay peacefully beneath its leaves. For in the presence of this Tree , there were no victors or vanquished, no glory or shame, only souls, united beneath a light that asked nothing of them. Yet, beneath its beauty, there lingered a truth far stranger than any tale the forest could tell. For this Tree was a seed blessed by 『God』 , yet never bound by its laws. It neither feared the coming of winter nor surrendered to the slow decay of the ages. While all things succumbed to the inevitable embrace of entropy , it endured, defying the very nature of existence. Its leaves might fall, its branches might tremble, and its shadow might lengthen beneath a setting sun, yet its heart would never wither. And so, deep within the endless forest, the tree continued to stand; gathering the broken, sheltering the lost, and giving life to those who had long forgotten what it meant to live. As long as a single soul sought its light, its heart would beat. And as long as its heart would beat, hope would never truly perish.” — 『The Encyclopedia of Life』 By [???]

Three blades spin around player just like Abyssal Hunter, connected to a ring. The blades are sharp, now looking like real blades, with a cyan glowing end, still leaving a trail. Fishes swim around the player swiftly just like it's unmutated counterpart. The player is standing on anchor like a surfboard, holding it with the right arm, while the left arm is stretched out behind player. The anchor has changed too, the back end of the handle is looks like the end of trident (Most likely due to the lore of Abyssal Hunter massacring Poseidon and forging the anchor and the trident together since it looks very similar), while the front end of the handle has a unique glowing pattern, while its horns has a sharp end similar to a scythe with a cyan glow. Matrix_Steampunk.description: Matrix : Steampunk is a craftable aura. It is a mutation of Matrix and gives a collected stat of 1,841,004,000 when crafted.
Matrix_Steampunk.appearance: Matrix : Steampunk features a color scheme alike to Topaz, with the aura itself appearing to be a condensed Matrix : Overdrive. The player floats above the ground bobbing slowly. A golden large ring spins around the player like Gilded. The aura is sat around a giant wavy, thin blue grid akin its precedent, Matrix. Below this is also a large portal effect of topaz and black, ending at the outline of the grid. Additionally, rested on the outline of the grid, there are 4 blue diamonds on each corner pulsing. They all connect with a thin hologram alike to Innovator that is also wavy, saying " STEAMPUNK " Similar to Matrix : Overdrive, three markers (diamond and arrow downwards) with a shining blue bottom slowly move around the aura. The entire form is surrounded by cogs fitting the steampunk theme. Four sets of cogs rest behind the player, three small, one big. The large and small cog behind the player has a clock on them like Overture, the time being represented in roman numerals and two fasting spinning clock hands. These two cogs also spark a lot of white electricity quickly. Additionally, near the bottom left corner is two more cogs facing the player, each sparking against each other. All of these cogs having a glowing white center like a star, while emanating topaz-colored flame like effects around them as a thin aura. To the other side of the two sparking cogs is a hammer, with an iron top and brown bottom, the handle being held by a blue spell almost like Apostolos's weapons. It also releases a thin topaz flame. The cogs and hammer are all alive, constantly bobbing up and down. Similar to Wonderland, a small train, like a toy and a steampunk blimp orbit the aura in a circle, the steampunk blimp leaving behind a thin golden trail, while the train leaves behind thin golden tracks, akin to Express. They also have a topaz flamed aura around them. Infront of the four sets of clocks behind the player are two lanterns, dangling in the air from a shining white light and white chains similarly to Overture. Each lantern is a brown casing with white shining light inside. Behind everything is two pillars with a moving upward grid at rapid paces with a topaz opaque coloring. They are fully stationary. One in the upper left corner is taller than the upper right pillar. Two golden hot air ballons float to the side of the player also, each with a topaz aura to them and bobbing slightly. Small particles of golden colored cogs float around the entire aura alongside thin beams of light upward that quickly come in and out. Furthermore, golden electric sometimes crackles along the aura. Lastly, a thin black fog rises upward from the entire aura that then fades.

True_Kyawthuite.obtainment: Exclusive to THE RADIANT FOREST (1 in 825,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
True_Kyawthuite.description: True Kyawthuite is a Challenged tier aura that was added in the Radiant Forest Update. It is rollable with a 1/825,000 chance only after first rolling Kyawthuite and Kyawthuite : Remembrance.
True_Kyawthuite.appearance: Several small rocks float around the central levitating player. Orange smog and particles from the floor undee then surround the floating player. There is also a bright white branches starting from center of the floor under the player. The center and the edge of the floor aura is bright, while the part between them are relatively darker.
True_Kyawthuite.lore: She calls him, "Kyawthuite." The daft boy from an old village. He was never into all of that magic his village has pressured him into. Even from his parents, he was never safe from all the pressure his lineage was known for. His interest was of a different kind of arts; pencils instead of wands, sketches instead of books. He was looked down upon for pursuing this talent, instead of the Arcane Arts. He'd rather find peace in maintenance, in patience, and in the slow flow of his life. Little did they know, and little did he know, He would have fulfilled their expectations, over and over.

True_Twilight.obtainment: Exclusive to THE RADIANT FOREST (1 in 6,000,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
True_Twilight.description: True Twilight is a Challenged tier aura that was added in the Radiant Forest Update. It is rollable with a 1/6,000,000 chance ONLY after first rolling Twilight, Twilight : Iridescent Memory, and Twilight : Withering Grace.
True_Twilight.appearance: True Twilight is a twilight-themed aura thats shows lots of purple and dark color. The aura provides a cresent moon for players to lie down on. There are multiple particles that resembles stars around the player.
True_Twilight.lore: He calls her, "Twilight." She was a quite, fragile girl, with a world of wonder locked behind her eyes. It was never her fault that tragedy found her so soon, stripping away her family and her home in a war she was too small to understand. Escaping into the deep woods that night, she left behind a burning world. At the heart of the trees, the Jewel of the Moon found her in the dark. It offered her peace. She accepted with all of her heart, to become the youngest of its guardians. For a long time, she did not feel alone. She found purpose in that duty. She tended to the pale flora, learning the gentle rhythm of the night, and guiding lost wanderers back to safety. Even as her kin faded into stone one by one, leaving her as the solitary keeper of a silent forest, she did not despair. She did not wait for a savior. She simply tended her garden, content to be the light in the dark for anyone who crossed her threshold. Little did the forest know, and little did she know, the most fragile among them would end up carrying the weight of eternity, over and over.

True_Jade.obtainment: Exclusive to THE RADIANT FOREST (1 in 10,250,000); cannot be rolled through breakthrough elsewhere.
True_Jade.description: True Jade is a Challenged tier aura that was added in the Radiant Forest Update. It is rollable with a 1/125,000 chance only after first rolling Jade and Jade : Purity.
True_Jade.appearance: When equipped, True Jade places the player near multiple pebbles, rotating around the player. In the background, graphics of mountains can be seen, rotating in the opposite direction of the pebbles. Similarly to Jade, the player is surrounded by a circular, green aura.
True_Jade.lore: They call him, "Jade." The silent wanderer of the deep canopies. To the weary travelers who happened to cross his path, he seemed like nothing more than a quiet, weathered hermit: an old man with mass clinging to his cloak, eyes as still as mountain pools, and hands that guided the fleeing toward shelter. When the broken fell to their knees in the dark, it was his steady, root-like presence that offered them quiet ground to rest upon. They thought he was merely an elder who had spent a lifetime in the wild, a man who had simply lived among the pines for so long that he had taken on their silence. Little did the wanderers know, and little did the world know... He was that very forest .

Both cubes spin quickly. At the center of the structure, there is a black star, encased in a much bigger neon star, surrounded by black particles. Projection.description: Projection is a Challenged rarity aura that was added in Eon 1-20. It can only be rolled inside the Singularity biome with a chance of 1 in 197,000,000.
Projection.appearance: Projection consists of a large black hemisphere, filled with stars. Inside of the hemisphere, the player floats, with an arm behind their head, the rest of their limbs resting. Below the player is a bright yellow model of the solar system. The sun is directly below the player, the rest of the planets circle around the sun in the middle. Next to the player are two yellow screens, one of which including an image of a black hole, with “DECAY” written below the image, and the other screen including an image of a planet of some sort.
Projection.lore: One of the earliest yet most intrigued and advanced examples of studies regarding the cosmos. This seemingly endless collection of notes of papers, projected for anyone to see any time, focused their words on a specific object: the Singularity. The majority of the illustrations and the doodles helped visualise what if looked like, showing not only how powerful its sheer force of gravity is, making it unable for anything to get out of its range, but also how greatly its force attracts the people's eyes and curiosity.

A flowing circle circles the star like the aura but with no points and only waves. The cutscene ends with a star looked to be drawn with chalk pulsing twice before revealing the au

The player is in a surfing position standing on a 5 pointed hollow star while the star bobs up and down. A catalyst ball of purple is contained behind the player in a spinning circle seemingly made of metal. The glowing ball is similar to the aura Impeached, seeming like a blackhole or purple star.
Point_Zero.lore: Radio signals from [?] have been picked up by The Science Foundation. The signals include a transmitted sequence, presumably from eons ago. [UNATHORIZED DISCLOSURE OF THIS SEQUENCE WILL RESULT IN IMMEDIATE TERMINATION] you have been warned. "Twenty seven years, Eleven months, Two weeks, Five hours, and Nineteen minutes. I could be more specific if you'd like. It's a wonder, really, how I'd lived for all these years with one question hat scratched, pulled, ranked my mind: Why must I be anchored to this Earth's crust? And I've ached, for those years, to let the fruits of my labour come into affect. Ached. You will all rot in human form, I will be free. Free to bask in my cravings, forever. I don't remember this place clearly. I never wanted to be here. It was simply the only place left to conduct my research. I had to isolate myself from them. They're too loud. My mind does not think as others do. It never has. Not even as a child. If you had seen the their faces at the sight of me, you would have laughed. Skin stretched taut against bone. Am I still one of you? They thought I was insane, they don't understand. The Great Attractor, I need to feel it, with my own hands. I need to see it, with my own eyes. I need to taste it, with my own mouth. I want to become it. To take its form. To be free. To consume. i am so hungryyy y yy. I shall see you, in the distant future, don't be scared of what you may find me as." An updated transmission has been received. Await further directives. [PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS ARE VOID. THE WORLD WILL HEAR MY ¿cries?] "So long ago, had I been so ¿gullible? I never made that arrow, it just, exists. I think. I don't think anyone sees it except for me. Yet it lures me in, With it's scent. When my feet slip the bonds of Earth, I did not close my eyes. I couldn't, I was too rotten. So, so gullible. The Attractor's Fool. Seven Hundred and Twenty Five Million years, One months, Fifteen days and Nine hours. I didn't resist, I thought it would bless me. I was wrong. It bare me, like a marionette. I am The Attractor. The centre of The Universe. The Singularity."

Leviathan.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen fades to black, after which the screen fades back in showing the Deep Abyss with two cinematic bars at the top and bottom of the screen. After ~2 seconds, the text below appears in order at the middle of the screen: "SILENCE IS THE ONLY LANGUAGE SPOKEN IN MY DOMAIN. . . " &
Leviathan.appearance: The player floats high up, holding two weapons which are an anchor and what seems to be a spear, above a large blue floor, with fish and what seems to be jellyfish swimming up from the floor, aswell as bubbles which pop after reaching too high. The player is wrapped by the Leviathan, which it seems to have “tamed”. The Leviathan take the appearance of a dark, blue creature with spikes on the top of it’s skin aswell as blue fins and a large, blue tail. The entire aura has a dark blue/teal tone to it.
Leviathan.lore: In the beginning, there was no throne—only endless water. Before Poseidon raised his dominion from coral and storm, something older had already taken root beneath the abyss. When Poseidon rose, the sea bent to his will—all but one. Leviathan—a god not born, but formed by the crushing weight of the deep, crowned by silence, and veiled in time. As time went on, a hunter came—merciless, tireless—tearing through the deep, leaving only silence in its path. But even it, for all its hunger, veered away from the deepest trench. It knows. All things do. Leviathan is not prey. It is not predator. It is the ocean's oldest wound—still open, still waiting. No records speak its name. No temple dares. It is not remembered in words, only in fear. And it is said: to say its name is to awaken it. And when it awakens, it does not rage blindly. It chooses—not many, only a rare few. To them, it does what not many gods of Olympus ever could: it crowns them. Not with gold or laurel, but with the weight of the abyss. Kings not of men, but something deeper. Through them, it stirs. Through them, it remembers. It changes them. Their vision pierces deeper than darkness. Their fear is drowned. Their will is no longer their own. What returns from its touch no longer human, no longer whole. They are made to endure, made to rule. Since then, the sea has not known peace—only waiting. --- [This aura is not affected by Runes.] · This aura can only be obtained from Rainy or Glitched.

It then shows a lamp turning off and then showing the player resting on their side, with the following words showing up on their screen in order: ''i'' ''close'' ''my eyes...'' ''Slowly...'' The camer
Dream_Catcher.appearance: Upon equipping Dream Catcher, its appearance is primarily a radiant lavender-white aura with soft violet hues around the player’s avatar similar to Celestial : Divine. At the bottom, dense glowing mist and clouds form, emitting bright particles that rise upward. Small white, slightly yellowish sparkling stars and glowing dust flow around the aura, creating a dreamy atmosphere. Around the player, there is a large glowing circular dreamcatcher consisting of circular hoops, somewhat resembling a web pattern, that is connected to white wings made of feathers with a violet-like tone. On top of those, there is a curved line with cascading curtains of light descending from above, similar to aurora-like streams or heavenly rays. Hanging beneath the dreamcatcher are several glowing strings that are attached to feathers, which sway gently. The feathers blend elegantly and shine with a pale white-violet light. The entire aura has a soft purple glow with strong white highlights, making the dreamcatcher appear as a divine, celestial object. The lighting matches the overall lavender-white appearance.
Dream_Catcher.lore: It was an accident that I picked it up. The sweet whispers directed at me lured me into a deep sleep, and gentle hands covered my eyes, erasing reality. In this place, pain, sorrow, and regret held no meaning. The less I could move, the more at ease my heart became. Even though that was the very thing I feared most. In the end, I forgot how to wake from this dream. — DAY ███, 27th Journal Entry of ??? — "Welcome to the ██████████." — The Key of Dreams [This Aura is not affected by Runes.] • This aura can only be obtained at Night.

Memory.lore: This is considered a follower of Oblivion , or a mere speck of existence by its influence. It does not engage in any actions, but its mere presence is Extremely Deadly as it can strip away the will of both living and non-living things without distinguishing between them. If you have encountered it... No, it's already Too Late .

Meta.lore: I came from somewhere. Where could that be? Where did you come from? Do you know where that is? It could be 'near', or 'far'. It could be 'high', or 'low'. It could be 'there', or 'here'. If it doesn't exist, can we say it has a location? Just because it has a location, can it really exist? Isn't 'where' more important than existence? What is your answer? Do you hear me? [This aura is not affected by any kind of luck.] *No potions/gauntlets help with rolling this aura

Eden.ability: Equip Dialogue — Upon equipping Eden, the user and Eden will have text appear above them. There are four pairs of lines, you can view them below. " Let's get into this. DO NOT THINK IT WILL END WITHOUT PAIN. " " Let's get this job done quickly. FEED ME. " " We can't rest just yet. UGH... " " Another job. ANOTHER FEAST. " " Nowhere to run. NOWHERE TO HIDE. " | Charge (Passive) — When Eden is equipped, a bar appears showing the current charge that can be from 0 to 100. Other abilities can either add or consume charge. " " That's that and this is this. " " Let's finish this quickly. " " That's our target, Eden. " " Go to hell. " " Nowhere to run. " | Darkmatter Barrage — Eden vanishes as the player opens a portal in front of them with the voice line " Swallow them, Eden. " Copies of Eden start flying from the portal and quickly vanishing, after 2 seconds the portal closes. Eden reappears with a voice line " I NEED MORE. " The player gains 12 Charge and deals 36 damage. Darkmatter Barrage has a 10 second cooldown. Additionally, text saying " [display name], The Void Contractor Swallow them, Eden. " appear at the lower left of the screen. | Cut Into Nothing — Eden vanishes and turns into a sword held by the player, which swings it in front of themselves with the voice line " Be gone. " appear at the lower left of the screen. | Impale — Eden vanishes and turns into a dagger held by the player, which stabs and lunges themselves forward with a voice line " Surprise. " appear at the lower left of the screen. | Deadeye — This ability requires style rating V active to be used, otherwise a text will appear saying "You need V Combo Rank to use this.". Eden.lore: The Devourer of the Void, Eden Eden is a sentient embodiment of the void itself, born from the being who created The Limbo. Its purpose is singular: to consume all that reaches Limbo. Anything swallowed by Eden is erased from existence; no memory, no trace, not even a record remains Even surviving a single encounter with Eden leaves one as nothing more than a shell of their former self stripped of identity, reduced to a mere form or fragmented existence. However, after its creator vanished from the world, Eden lost its strength. NOW, it has neither the will nor the power to devour anything any longer.

Oppression.appearance: Oppression is a massive aura with a monotone and noir color scheme, fitting appearances of auras such as Glitch (except for the colors Glitch has), Undefined, Nihility, and Equinox. The player is handled like a puppet, with their arms and legs attached with stars of black outlining and a white center. The player's face is covered in black glitches, preventing others from seeing it. While the player's body features a black shattered heart and a black outline of a star emitting a glowing white center. Below the player is a number of effects, separated in layers similar to many auras. The first layer is a swirling black vortex, closing inward, towards the player. The second layer is a white section similar to Overture's clocks, with runic symbols inscribed onto it. The third layer is almost identical to the 1st, but with a blended black and white inside. The most inner layer is a vortex of white and black circles going into the center constantly separated by an unstable white outline. In the center of the structure is a special 8-pointed star with white points on the left and right. Around the 2nd outer layer, bright white particles floating upward before fading effects swirl around. The massive structure has white particles floating outward of it in bright dashes at a rapid speed.
Oppression.lore: "Once in the past, there existed a being with immense and unstable power, strong enough to drive the world to the brink of collapse. This being left cracks across the world and gradually expanded its influence. The world's authorities united to stop it, using every means available, but ultimately, they failed . In the end, 「 God 」 confronted the being, and though the being defied even 「 God 」, when 「 God 」 drew His sword and struck, all the cracks left by the being were wiped clean. It seemed like everything had finally ended. The world regained its peace, and authorities sighed in relief. ...But is this truly the end? The remnants of that power did not disappear. Perhaps this is just the beginning. This story... is not over yet."

Hellborn.lore: What a joke of a world. They called it a masterpiece. Called themselves gods for playing with it. And yet look at what they've done to it. Flawed, rotten, incomplete... Everything that breathes will kneel before me, even those pathetic excuses for gods. They were nothing but architects of a failed design. I am the true architect. I will be the hand that shapes this world, the will that gives it purpose. And when everything stands beneath my gaze... There will be no one left to call themselves a god but me. I am GOD. Illusionary.lore: I don’t remember when I was born. Or if I ever was. I am here now. I think. Maybe. I ask that more than I should. But no one answers. Not even you. I feel you watching. Time folds here. Inward. Backward. I blink and centuries collapse into seconds. Do you feel it yet? The bending? The echo? The part of me that's now inside you? I forgot my name. ...or was it yours?

Tomorrow.lore: [Cycle 8,128] He did not reach for the jewel. He did not ask the sky for another thousand years. He understood, at last, the cruelty of a stasis that refused to let go. And so, to all that mattered to him, he gave his final grace. He let the Crimson Canopy finally shatter. He let all of their memories finally go, one last time. With no memory for the world to hold onto, the forest began to heal itself of their history. The statues crumbled into glowing mis. The deep carvings knitted into untouched bark. The colors lifted from the cave walls, everything carried away by a wind that no longer needed to listen. Her form dissolved into a cascade of bioluminescent light, ascending from the earth, leaving only a single blue flower to sway in the sudden quiet. The world was forgetting them. Willingly. Peacefully. In the center of the radiant, erased clearing, the fabric of the dark tore open. A rift of pure, silver light spilled across the grass: a pathway to the true moon . He stood before the threshold. He no longer carried the weight of eight million years in his chest, a treasure the earth could no longer hold. He did not look back at the Radiant Forest . He gazed only into the silver expanse. There, bathed in the pale, quiet light, she was waiting for him. As he stepped into the veil, he whispered into the jewel: "There will never be another Tomorrow. "

Divinus_Love.description: Divinus : Love is an Event rarity aura that was added in the , seen after clicking on Divinus. It was obtained by completing the first quest for the event and is a mutation of Divinus.
Divinus_Love.appearance: Divinus : Love is very similar to the original Divinus, but instead of having a yellow shield in the middle of the body, the player has a pink heart pulsing on the center of their chest. Pink smoke and tiny particles surround the player, seemingly a recolored version of the older yellow smoke and particles.
Divinus_Love.lore: Perchance, maybe love is the strongest emotion?
