Flushed_Heart_Eye.description: Flushed : Heart Eye is an Event rarity aura that was added in the , seen after clicking on :Flushed:. It could have been obtained by completing Lime's Valentine’s Day quests, and is a mutation of :Flushed:. This aura is now unobtainable due to the event ending.
Flushed_Heart_Eye.appearance: Flushed : Heart Eye is similar to the original, non-mutated :Flushed:, with the only difference being that the aura surrounding the player is pink, instead of the classic yellow, and consists of heart-shaped particles. In addition to this, the emoji from :Flushed: is replaced with a [ heart eye emoji (😍)].

Celestial_Cupid.description: Celestial : Cupid is an Event tier re-skin aura of Celestial. It was obtained through a Valentine’s Quest that required 2 Celestial auras, 30,000 Rolls, and 10 .
Celestial_Cupid.appearance: Celestial : Cupid is similar to its original form, with the exception of a singular pink portal, following the same shard-like pattern. It deviates by removing the other portal, and the circle halo behind the player, instead replacing them with a pink cupid's bow. The player also hovers above the ground, looking towards the sky.
Celestial_Cupid.lore: Do you want your love to come true?? I'll make it come true!

Blossom.description: Blossom is a Event tier aura that was added in Era 3 as part of 2024 Valentines update. It was obtained through a Valentine's Quest that required 1x Celestial, 20x Divinus, 5x :Flushed:, 50x Ruby, and 333 Rolls.
Blossom.appearance: Blossom displays a pink flower with pink petals that fall from above the player's head, in addition to very thin pink swirling effects, circling around the player partially, before eventually disappearing. At the player's feet, a pink portal swirls around. A pink flower will appear on top of the players head. There is also a butterfly spinning around the player in a ring pattern. Japanese characters appear infront of the player, " ” which translate to "Hatsune Miku". The creator of the aura added this as an easter egg due to the creator liking Hatsune Miku. On the waist of the player a katana will appear when equipping the aura.
Blossom.ability: Blossom has 2 abilities: Blooming — [X] Blooming : The player spins their sword, creating an area with lots of pink slashes that starts moving forward and then explodes. The victim gets slashed 1-8 times ( each slash dealing 5 damage ) depending on how they move or where they are standing, dealing 5-40 dmg in total. | Petalwind — [Q] Petalwind : Similarly to Arcane, the player teleports forward, leaving a pink trail behind them. This ability has a very short cooldown.

Defined.description: Defined is an aura released during Era 6 for the April Fools Event, and is currently unobtainable. It is a Event tier aura listed in the collection (after clicking on Undefined). It had a 1 in 2,222 chance of being rolled in the Null biome, and a 1 in 2,222,000 chance of being rolled via breakthrough.
Defined.appearance: Defined's appearance is nearly identical to that of Undefined, with the main difference being that a white circle, or 0, is featured on the player's face, rather than a black X, symbolizing its opposite. The portal under the player is also inverted, where it starts black and turns white. Prior to Era 8.5, the title of Defined read: ! ! ! [Limited], contrasting to Undefined's "?̶̘̎͒?̴̨͎̹͓̹̈́?̴̨̺̳̙̓̍͌͠" title, due to Defined being the opposite of Undefined. After the Era 8.5 update, the rarity was changed to: [Limited] - 2024 April Fool.

Kromat1k.description: Kromat1k is a Event tier aura, and is currently unobtainable. It is a mutation of Chromatic, and was obtainable from April 5th 2024 until April 27th 2024, during the April Fools Event.
Kromat1k.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== has a basic opening effect. Its opening consists of a red star, expanding, as a bright red gradient grows into the middle of the screen, revealing the .
Kromat1k.appearance: Kromat1k has many similarities to the standard Chromatic, as well as several notable differences. The audio visualizer ring is similar to the original, but the usual effects are replaced with studs that undulate up and down in accordance with the beat of the music. In a similar fashion, the two stars circling the player are also simplified, the black effect obscuring them being much more uniform in shape. Additionally, the player dances randomly, their limbs moving about freely. Kromat1k is inspired by “classic” or "old" Roblox. Some suggest that this aura is meant to resemble what Chromatic would’ve looked like in the early days of Roblox, due to the use of older assets.
Kromat1k.lore: y35! Ffeel my unst0wpavb1e beat!? Aura dedicated to April Fool's Day. You can get it until [April 26, 2024]

Impeached_i'm_peach.description: Impeached is a Glorious tier aura that was added in Era 4. It has a base rarity of 1 in 200,000,000 and has a native rarity of 1 in 40,000,000 to be rolled during the Corruption or Glitched, under the effects of the or under the effects of the .
Impeached_i'm_peach.music_file: Terraria Calamity Mod Scrap - Threats of The Ocean Floor .ogg
Impeached_i'm_peach.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A quick jingle plays as a purple star appears in the middle accompanied by a hoarse wind noise that plays throughout the cutscene, a purple swirl effect appears behind the star along with patterns moving from the left to the right of the screen. Multiple small black squares with purple outlines f
Impeached_i'm_peach.appearance: Impeached is a royal-themed aura, primarily a color of purple and violet. It shares appearances with auras such as Harvester, Oblivion, and Exotic : Apex. The player is seen bobbing up and down above the ground, with their right arm in their face and their left arm slumped downward. The player is impaled with a smaller scale of the sword used in Impeached's ability, and there is black smog between the puncture entry and exit of the sword. The player's torso is also surrounded by a long singular black chain, equal to the color of the sword. Surrounding the player are three orbs, each with a unique design. The outer layer of the orb is black fuzzy, while the inner circle is violet with a bright white light shining. A vortex-like effect occurs in the outer layer, with a mixed black and violet color. The larger orb behind the player is behind the player, around 5-7 meters back and 3-5 meters ascended above ground. The larger orb shares a similar appearance to the smaller orbs, but with a spiky black effect and a bright star light shining. It also has an appearance similar to Exotic : Apex with purple, black, and violet rays constantly releasing. Crackles of electricity in large blacks and violets spark around constantly, and tiny sparkling effects in violet slowly appear and flash as they move downward.
Impeached_i'm_peach.ability: Impeached has an ability that raises the player's right hand while releasing purple particles that disappear right after a quarter of a second and spawns a large 8-pointed star on the ground to mark where the giant black sword will fall. After a few seconds, the sword descends and creates a shockwave, spreading a crack and releasing purple and black lightning on the floor of the aura along the sword with a sigil like the one on the aura itself manifest around the sword. This ability deals 30 damage and has a cooldown of 30 seconds and a windup of 1.75-1.6 seconds. The move can hit up to 15 studs behind the user and 95 studs in front of the user, or just a 50 studs impact radius from the sword.

Watermelon.description: Watermelon is an aura that was obtainable through rolling with a 1 in 320,000 chance during the Summer 2024 Event. It became unobtainable on 08/23, but this was reverted shortly after to extend the summer quests to end on 08/30. On 08/31/2024 it has become unobtainable.
Watermelon.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== Its opening consists of a pale, red star, with a green tip, expanding, similar to the and the Era 5 cutscene. As the star expands to its largest, the screen fades into white and red, with a green stripe on the bottom. After that, everything turns white as the screen starts to crack, revealing the
Watermelon.appearance: The Watermelon aura appears to be a large watermelon that encapsulates the player, not displaying any sort of idle or walk movement animations.
Watermelon.ability: Whenever the ability of Watermelon is used, it plays the corresponding voice line: "It's the most beautiful thing I've ever seen in my life, it's watermelon, inside a watermelon!". This recording originates from an old Vine that was popular in 2013 (A video of the Vine can be seen [ — oiETVvdDa7Y here]).
Watermelon.lore: This is the most beautiful thing I've ever seen in my life. It's Watermelon! inside a Watermelon!!!

StarRider_Starfish.description: StarRider : Starfish is a Event tier aura that was added in the Era 8.5. It is a mutation of StarRider and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 250,000 or 1 in 25,000 during Starfall.
StarRider_Starfish.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== This aura has a basic opening effect. Its opening consists of a light yellow color expanding from the sides of the screen, with a light yellow star in the center, expanding into .
StarRider_Starfish.appearance: StarRider : Starfish allows the player to ride atop a large orange starfish, leaning backward slightly, as if they are trying to maintain their balance. Bubbles and sparkle effects are emitted from the starfish's center, falling near the ground before dissipating. Smoke billows from the starfish, creating a trail behind the player.
StarRider_Starfish.lore: A little friend who will join you on a wonderful trip

Shard_Surfer.description: Shard Surfer is an Event aura that was added in the Era 8.5 with a rarity of 1 in 225,000,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 75,000,000 in Snowy.
Shard_Surfer.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== has a relatively simple opening. Its cutscene consists of a blue, eight-pointed star, rotating in the center of the screen, accompanied by rising aquamarine particles and a blue and white gradient around it, before the screen expands to reveal the aura itself. This aura is missing the "pulsing" e
Shard_Surfer.appearance: Shard Surfer grants the player a glowing, aqua shard, which they ride atop whilst being pulled into a whirlpool-like portal beneath them. The portal's center glows with a neon blue color, whilst darker effects circle around it. Once it reaches the edge of the circle, the particles fade. Surrounding the player are four larger shards, which emit a wave-like pattern. They emit a mass of blue particles. Additionally, a large, radiant star sits above the player, enveloped in a layer of light blue particles. Thin slashes, which resemble strings, gradually shrink towards the star's center, before disappearing, similarly to Natural.

Surfer.description: Surfer is an aura added in Era 8.5. It is obtained by completing the 3rd quest from Lime in the Summer 2024 Event.
Surfer.appearance: Surfer creates a large, wave-like effect that envelops the player, slowly transitioning from blue to white as it rises and curls to create a pocket. It also grants the player a surfboard, which they use in order to ride the aforementioned waves, wobbling about slightly, as they assume a crouched stance. Additionally, light blue particles ascend from the base of the aura.

Innovator.description: Innovator is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1, and had a 1 in 30,000,000 chance of being rolled during Innovator Event 2024. The aura is now unobtainable.
Innovator.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black, as a quick jingle effect plays, a wind noise also playing in the background. The screen is covered in black gradient from the top to the bottom as well as a very dark shade of purple at the middle, with a star that looks similar to 's. The star slowly expands, a purple/b
Innovator.appearance: Innovator creates a purple portal-like circle beneath the player, rotating while occasionally pulsating. In this portal's center lies a light blue cross, resembling a radar, and the words ' INNOVATOR ' and ' PROTECTED ' hovers just above the portal's edges. In addition, Innovator also provides the player with a set of wings, consisting of several crystal-like outlines, flapping as the user moves. The player hovers over the ground lazily with their left arm raised, enveloped by particles. Above the player rests a large cube, surrounded by purple orbs that are interconnected by a ring of arrow symbols, rotating alongside another sorting sphere that leaves a wispy trail in its wake. Housed in the cube's center is a rectangular outline that contains the 'Roll' button. This structure explodes after a while, expanding in size for a split second. The "orb" is also similar to Virtual's orb

Pump.description: Pump is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1, and has a 1 in 200,000 chance of being rolled. It is part of the Halloween event and will become an event aura. This aura cannot be rolled via breakthrough, and can only be rolled in the Pumpkin Moon biome.
Pump.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, and an ominous sound effect plays. A white fog forms at the bottom of the screen and in the center, a purplish blue four-pointed star revolves while slowly expanding, before the edges glow light yellow, revealing after a white scene cracking sequence.
Pump.appearance: A pumpkin, resembling the [ Sinister P.] hat, obscures the player's face, emitting flame-like particles as its interior glows with a yellow hue. A pale yellow face, similar to that of the pumpkin head itself, manifests on the player's chest, with a portal-like circle of the same color writhing under the player's feet, similar to Archangel. The face that can be seen on the players chest is shimmering a bit.

Lunar_Nightfall.description: Lunar : Nightfall is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1, seen after clicking on Lunar. It had a 1 in 3,000,000 chance of being rolled during the Graveyard biome and was a mutation of Lunar.
Lunar_Nightfall.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The opening animation is similar to other cutscenes with at least 1 in a million chance. A quick jingle plays as the background transitions to black. A dark, 8 pointed purple star in the screen's center, similar to 's, increasing in size until revealing .
Lunar_Nightfall.appearance: The player floats midair in a position similar to that of Gravitational, enveloped by a thick layer of mist-like violet particles. The player wields a distinct object in either hand; a purple, pitchfork-like staff in the left and an enchantment book in the right, a moon-shaped sigil manifesting above it. Similar to Lunar, light-purple constellations form in the player's vicinity, along with a crescent-shaped moon that slowly revolves around them. Additionally, a circular floor aura appears beneath the player with a similar design to Corrosive, emitting black fog-like particles as it quivers.
Lunar_Nightfall.ability: Night Impale Is an ability where the player does a swift stab with its staff, dealing 10 damage first. The player then swings its hand clockwise before doing the same stab again, dealing 20 damage. This deals 30 damage in total.
Lunar_Nightfall.lore: The dark sky bathed in moonlight, descends.

Vital.description: Vital is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1, and had a 1 in 6,000,000 chance of being rolled during the Halloween Event 2024. It is part of the Halloween event and has become an event aura. This aura cannot be rolled via breakthrough and could have only be rolled in the Pumpkin Moon or Glitched biome.
Vital.appearance: The player is surrounded by a thick red and black mist that emerges from a portal-like effect below the player, where said effect starts off with a light-red effect below and around the player's feet, then goes outward while also darkening the light-red effect into a very dark shade of red at last. Quickly being launched from the floor are some red tinted petals that disappear shortly after. The player seems to be connected by a glowing red wire to a white heart-rate monitor, where said monitor have a red electricity effect at its head. The heart monitor presumably displays the player's heartbeat having dangerous spikes, while also displaying a warning sign symbol that is comparable to the one that Matrix : Overdrive is associated with.

Moonflower.description: Moonflower is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1, and had a 1 in 10,000,000 chance of being rolled. It was part of the Halloween Event 2024 and has now become an event aura. This aura cannot be rolled via breakthrough and can only be rolled in the Pumpkin Moon biome.
Moonflower.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen will become black, as chiming noises play in the beginning of the cutscene. A windy noise extending the entirety of the cutscene plays in the background. The bottom of the player’s screen will have faint purple particles emerging from it, and the top is black. In the center there is
Moonflower.appearance: The player slightly levitates above a blue, portal-like floor effect, while also wearing a blue and black scarf, similar to Bloodlust. Two blue flowers, with an shining blue pistil that has an slight glare effect similar to Starscourge : Radiant's crystal shards, comes from the portal-like floor effect in a similar manner to Twilight : Iridescent Memory, as two stars orbit the player that leaves a blue trail with blue stars, similar to Overture, but with an slight glare effect. A blue halo stays behind the player, which is also on the left of a single blue star with an glare effect as well, which is also backed in an odd, fire-like rope that fades away as it goes up. Some light-blue particles, that are presumably rain, appears and falls down into the floor. Very small blue particles that are similar to Impeached or Sovereign can be seen being launched below the player. The main part of the aura, which is a blue-tinted moon, floats right behind the player, similar to how Lunar : Full Moon's moon is treated in relation with the aura itself.
Moonflower.lore: The beautiful flower which blooms only at night and lightens up paths at those who are lost in vast, Dark Forest . It is also one of the last of its Species as it was massively harvested by people who enjoyed company of the flower, now hidden in the Deep Forest .

Cryptfire.description: Cryptfire is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1, and had a 1 in 21,000,000 chance of being rolled. It was part of the Halloween Event and can no longer be obtained. This aura could not be rolled via breakthrough, and can only be rolled in the Graveyard or Glitched.
Cryptfire.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen will become filled with black, purple and green stripes as chiming noises play in the beginning of the cutscene. A windy noise extending the entirety of the cutscene plays in the background. The bottom of the player’s screen will have purple particles emerging from it, In the center
Cryptfire.appearance: Cryptfire is an aura with a color scheme of purple and green and cyan, with hints of blue in the title. The player's body glows with a bright luminous purple light, surrounded by multiple effects of fire and purple particles. Light purple electricity enters around the player, similar to Matrix : Overdrive and a deep purple gas, similar to Memory. The player wields a larger sword with a bright glow, but the lighting is replaced by a dark whirlpool/spiral rising upward. Behind the player is layers of effects, including slashes in dark purple, electric bright green/cyan, and dashes of light purple. Some dots in either cyan/bright green or purple rise around the player, starting at a higher altitude and moving upward in different speeds and locations. Around the player are three cyan/bright green colored lampposts, one in-between the bottom and right lamppost, and two more in-between but a bit further back behind the lampposts. These scaled copies of lampposts move up and down, twirling around as green flames wisp around them with occasional electricity in a bright cyan at the top and bottom. Lastly, three mushrooms, one in-between the bottom and right lamppost and two more in-between but a bit further back behind the lampposts, have bright purple spots and purple flame-like effects around them.
Cryptfire.lore: A Mysterious Light enchants you, guiding you on a journey to the other side of the world.

Soul_Hunter.description: Soul Hunter is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1, and had a 1 in 40,000,000 chance of being rolled during the Halloween 2024 Update. It was part of the Halloween event and has become an event aura. This aura cannot be rolled via breakthrough and was only to be rolled in the Graveyard or Glitched biome.
Soul_Hunter.appearance: Soul Hunter features a reddish pink theme, with the player wielding a sawblade with an inner glow ring and four bending corners. The player also has a bright red glow on their right eye, similar to Rage : Brawler. They wear a red scarf on their neck, wavering like in the wind, comparable to Bloodlust. Sawblades circling the player, leaving a small trail, are also glowing reddish pink. The player's aura is engulfed by a light flame effect, and a portal-like effect of a bright white/pink underneath them. The player's red souls rise from the ground, wiping upward like smoke before disappearing. The player's aura is a unique blend of red, pink, and black elements, creating a captivating experience for the player.
Soul_Hunter.lore: A terrifying creature that hunts poor souls.

Dullahan.description: Dullahan is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1, and had a 1 in 72,000,000 chance of being rolled in the Graveyard biome. It was part of the Halloween Event 2024, which has ended, thus making this aura unobtainable as of February 8, 2025.
Dullahan.music_file: Knight's crusade main orchestra and drums only.mp3
Dullahan.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become filled with 3 black stripes, as chiming noises play in the beginning of the cutscene. The 10m+ windy noise extending the entirety of the cutscene plays in the background. The bottom of the player’s screen will have neon green particles emerging from it, which fade as they r
Dullahan.appearance: Dullahan is an aura with a theme similar to the Headless Horseman, featuring bright cyan or bright green colors. The player wields a weapon similar to a lightsaber, with a black handle and a glowing cyan upper half, with a sharp-looking pointed tip. They wear armor and are engulfed in a bright fiery flame of cyan color. The player rides a horse with a ribcage design and a black body. Surrounding the player are three tombstones, one damaged and another repaired, and one with a cross design. Green flames surround them, resembling Cryptfire's items. Beneath the player is a stable emblem marked in a green outline and black inner circle with green spiking inside. Beyond the player is a fiery expanding black and cyan flame, constantly moving outward before fading. A green flame effect rises above the tombstones, visible as it engulfs the aura. Particles in bright green or black and green resemble souls, similar to Soul Hunter's souls.
Dullahan.lore: Since ancient times, Dullahan has been a terror to mankind, standing on the thin line between Life and Death . With a jet-black Spirit Horse , his body is covered with a Cold Green Halo , with green flames rising from where his head used to be. This spirit spear in his hand gives off a gloomy echo, like a warning of an inescapable fate.

Nightmare_Sky.description: Nightmare Sky is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1, and has a 1 in 190,000,000 chance of being rolled. It is part of the Halloween event and will become an event aura. This aura cannot be rolled via breakthrough, and can only be rolled in the Pumpkin Moon biome.
Nightmare_Sky.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black while a quick jingle plays, and hoarse wind sounds begin playing in the background that last through the cutscene, while a purple 8-pointed star expands and spins throughout the cutscene. Bright purple fog floats through the screen, and purple fire appears around the star
Nightmare_Sky.appearance: Nightmare Sky is an aura with a color scheme similar to Lunar and Impeached, comprised mainly of varying shades of purple. The player floats up and down with the rest of the aura, their left hand behind them holding a sparkle, and their right hand held in front of them. There are 4 candles surrounding the player, burning with a purple flame, linked to one another by purple, glowing chains. The player's torso faintly glows in bright purple, and four pillars sit idly behind the player, and besides them bright, purple lanterns float by chains seemingly connected to the air by nothing, while ejecting particles from their bottoms every few seconds. Behind the pillars are books, which shine a purple spotlight down upon the player. Above the entire structure is a massive moon, similar to Lunar : Full Moon, which glows bright purple and pulses weakly. In front of the moon above the rest of the aura is a purple, clouded sky with stars fading in and out occasionally, and smaller stars dotting the sky. Below the player is a shining purple ring of sigils, similar to Dullahan. The final outline (the 8th) has a runic symbol pattern, similar to Impeached. Small particles release from the ground, rising upwards, as well as faint ghosts, and runic symbols and small particles swirl around the aura, creating a purple fog-like effect.
Nightmare_Sky.lore: In this realm, a swirling purple sky pulses with an unsettling glow, casting an otherworldly hue over everything below. The air is thick with an electric tension, and a sense of unease lingers as the atmosphere vibrates with whispers of hidden fears. Within this aura, dreams twist into dark reveries, creating a surreal landscape where reality bends and the imagination runs wild.

Harvester.description: Harvester‎ is a Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-1 and It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 666,000,000 only inside Graveyard or Glitched.
Harvester.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== has a very unique opening cutscene that differs from most auras. A very large red 4-pointed star appears, with the points extended out, covering a large portion of the screen. The star is larger at two ends, which is more noticeable towards the end of the cutscene. Pink/red particles float upward
Harvester.appearance: Harvester is depicted with a red and pink color scheme, similar to Bloodlust. The player's eyes are bright white with faint purple, and a bright flame of red and black swirls around the player. Two souls are attached to the player, one from the right with a red grasp and the other from the left in a purple grasp. The player's aura is surrounded by a large expanse of dark red flame effects, a small reddish pink circle flashing like a hologram, and a layer of purple underneath the flames. The player also wields a long glowing red scythe, similar to Bloodlust. Next to the player is a structure of two rings, one larger and one smaller around the player's size, with them shining brightly with a reddish-pink outlined glow on half the circumference. Above the player is a massive deep red orb in a perfect sphere with a dark inside and a bright reddish pink star pulsing bright flames. The orb has six points of breaking structures with lanterns dangling downward, rotating at 0.32-0.4 rotations per second. The aura is surrounded by souls spread in reddish pink and purple, fading then out, similar to Soul Hunter. Red and purple particles constantly move around the bottom of the aura and the orb structure at fast rates, with some faded into the ground and others coming back up. A faint barrier around the flame-like effects rises like a spiral before fading out at 9-12 meters high.
Harvester.lore: The Lord of the Night harvests souls consumed by madness, adding them to his collection and gazing upon them with a Chilling Laughter that sends shivers down their spines.

Apostolos_Veil.obtainment: Limited (1/800,000,000 (Only in Pumpkin Moon OR Graveyard) (Limited) Halloween 2024)
Apostolos_Veil.description: Apostolos : Veil is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-1. It is a mutation of Apostolos. It was rollable as a 1 in 800,000,000, exclusive to the Graveyard and Pumpkin Moon biomes and was part of the Halloween 2024 event, and it is become unobtainable as of February 8, 2025.
Apostolos_Veil.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== has a special opening effect (like most globals.) It is very similar to its original aura, , but with different colors. The screen goes black as an 8 pointed bluish / green colored star appears on the screen. A purple sigil of a 4-pointed star appears in the background, shifting between green and
Apostolos_Veil.appearance: Apostolos : Veil has a color scheme of orange, purple, and green themes is present. The player sits on a cross-like structure, glowing brightly with a long scarf. Beneath, a massive circle displays purple and white flame effects, resembling Nightmare Sky and Impeached. The left side features structures resembling those from Dullahan, Overture : History, and Sailor : Flying Dutchman. A 10 to 14-meter black pillar wrapped in a thin green spiral emits green flames and sparkles. Nearby, a tombstone with a pointed tip emits green flames and is wrapped in a thin green spiral. Two tall sword or lantern-like structures flank the pillar, emitting green pentagrams and trails. On the right side, structures mirror the left but feature orange hues and Pump-inspired designs. Two white candles with black bases emit bright orange flames surrounded by eternal orange fire, akin to Nightmare Sky but with a distinct theme. Behind the player is a massive star reminiscent of Apostolos, levitating 20-39 meters above the ground. Two energy blade structures connect each side's items and colors, evoking chaos and order in a distinct variation.
Apostolos_Veil.lore: Once a year, on a single day, this enigmatic being emerges to fill the world with fear. Shrouded in mystery and its origins unknowable, this entity has become a symbol of Halloween. It roams through the night of terror, reveling in grand feasts and banquets with its minions. Amidst the celebrations, it jokes about the impending "Day of Destruction" that will one day return and delights in betting on which faction will triumph to claim the world.

Wonderland.description: Wonderland was obtainable with a 1/4,000,000 chance to be rolled in the Snowy weather, and a 1/12,000,000 chance with Breakthrough. Wonderland is obtainable through the roulette as well, with a 1/10 chance of being obtained in the normal wheel, a 1/4 chance of being obtained in the rare wheel. Wonderland was not obtainable through the mega wheel, and after the Winter 2025 Event, is unobtainable.
Wonderland.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== Having an opening very similar to , opens with ringing effect, and a faded blue 1/1M+ star with a faded blue background and black fog at the top and bottom of the screen. Blue particles rise up from the bottom, to the top of the screen, where they eventually fade away after a breif moment. Two st
Wonderland.appearance: Wonderland is a clear snow globe with a wooden base, containing the player inside. The player, with their arms crossed, appears to be shaking slightly, seemingly from cold temperatures inside of the snow globe, with the idea being supported with the snow falling inside the snow globe. Three presents are around the player, with the first present, to the right, being colored red, with a green bow The second present, to the left of the player being light blue with a yellow bow, with the third present, behind the player being a magenta-pink color with a dark blue bow. Around the snow globe is a table, a pine tree, some Christmas lights, with a toy train orbiting around it. On top of the table is a mug of hot cocoa, a plate with three cookies, and two torches. Underneath the snow globe is a variety of different particles, including, and not limited to a transparent, expanding snowflake. Above the aura is its title. Instead of the rarity displaying, it shows as (Limited - 2025 Winter). This is a trait shared across all 2025 Winter auras.

Santa_Frost.description: Santa Frost is an Event aura listed in the collection and had a 1/15,000,000 chance of being rolled in the Snowy, and a 1/45,000,000 chance of being rolled with Breakthrough. Santa Frost was also obtainable through the roulette wheel with a 1/100 chance in the normal wheel, a 1/10 chance in the rare wheel, and a 1/4 chance in the mega wheel. Santa Frost was only obtainable in the 2025 Christmas Event, which is now over.
Santa_Frost.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A blue eight-pointed star fades into the screen, with its tips a bronze color. A diagonal, faint streak of blue crosses the screen behind the star as blue particles begin to rise up into the cutscene. The star then fades out, revealing .
Santa_Frost.appearance: features Santa's sleigh, with four reindeer; each taking one corner around the sleigh. The reindeer appear ice-blue, and lack facial expressions or tails. As the reindeer run, pulling the sleigh, snow and frost particles breeze by, as well as star constellations and other sparkling particles above the player. The player holds on to the reindeer with reigns, wrapped around their wrists like bracelets. The player sits with their left leg crossed over their right and their right arm held in the air; their left arm resting on the seat they are sitting on. The sleigh idly bobs up and down, levitating in the air while it is pulled by reindeer. Alongside the reindeer, streaks of gold and blue breeze by. On the back of both of the runner bottoms hide a glowing snowflake, pulsing a bronze-ish color.

Winter_Fantasy.description: Winter Fantasy is Event tier aura and had a 1 in 72,000,000 chance of being rolled through Breakthrough, and a 1/24,000,000 chance of being rolled in Snowy weather during the Winter Event 2025. Winter Fantasy has chance of being obtained in the roulette, with a 1/1000 chance, or 1/3000 if including other rewards in the same rarity in the normal wheel, a 1/100 chance, or 1/200 if including other rewards in the same rarity in the rare wheel, and a 1/10 or 1/20 chance if including other rewards in the same rarity in the mega wheel. This aura is now unobtainable.
Winter_Fantasy.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The opening is similar to and as an eight-pointed star opens up, with a deep dark blue and light blue effect background, the star in the center being light blue and slowly darker on the other sides. Two sides are cut off, similar to . One side that is cut off has a darker blue spot, and one of
Winter_Fantasy.appearance: Winter Fantasy has a light blue general color scheme. The player floats above the ground in a pose similar to Galaxy, as a thick blue bubble engulfs the player similarly to and Bubble. A bright flashing star emits from the center of the player, constantly fading in and out, reducing and increasing in size per flash. The player is surrounded by two large aurora beams that look similar to Celestial, spiraling from the ground and having a large appearance, bending upward to a large light blue snowflake that in the center of large snowflake, a flashing blue star and portal-like effects being emitted from the snowflake. The snowflake also calmly bobs up and down. Similarly to Jade, a sphere effect in a very transparent aurora color engulfs the player fully. Akin to Aether, black, green, and light blue flamelike effects emit from below the player, below that being a blue expanding portal effect. Two luminous light blue reindeers rotate around the player, the back of those reindeer being a sleigh in the same color and glow.

Express.description: Express was an aura obtainable with a chance of 1 in 30,000,000 in the Snowy Biome being a 50/50 against Arcane : Dark. For breakthrough, the chances of obtaining it was 1 in 90,000,000. This aura could've also been obtained through the Roulette game mode as an Exalted rarity in the Regular (0.05% chance), Rare (0.5% chance), or Mega (5% chance) Roulettes.
Express.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black, as a quick jingle effect plays, a wind noise also playing in the background. At the bottom is a few gold/bronze and blue lines slanted diagonally, but mostly vertical, which is similar to a lot of Christmas auras. Gold particles float upwards and fade away after some time.
Express.appearance: Express is an aura that is similar to the train most likely, the Polar Express, the color scheme itself being similar to Santa Frost. The train itself is just two parts, the locomotive of the train being a long black piece connected by four large wheels and one small one on each side with the driver's seat at the back of the locomotive, each window on top having a blue light attached. The player also hangs from the top right of the back locomotive. The top of it is heavily dusted with snow, with the side of the more frontier side of the locomotive having snowflake ornaments that are glowing. The back side is a red carriage with some presents and a flat snowman, similar to a red wagon a child would use. The front of the train also has a yellow bright light. The train runs on a constantly moving forward light blue rail surrounded by some spiraling upward effects, similar to Santa Frost. Lastly, surrounding the train is snowflakes and snow particles floating around bathed in a light blue fog, with multiple red, blue, and deep yellow stars seemingly hanging in the air, bobbing up and down rapidly. At the end of the rails (where the front of the train is,) there are two stars constantly rotating in a golden color bobbing up and down, leaving behind a yellow trail. The player themself also has a hat on their head and a lush white scarf like Abyssal Hunter's scarf around the player's neck.

Abominable.description: Abominable is an aura added on Febuary 8, 2025, in the 2025 Winter event. It had a breakthrough rarity of 1 in 120,000,000, or a native rarity of 1 in 40,000,000 in Snowy biome. You could've also obtained this from the Exalted/Glorious rarity from the Roulette minigame.
Abominable.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen goes black with light blue particles floating upward as a hoarse wind noise plays throughout the cutscene, reminiscent to that of . 5 cyan stars of various hues show up with a subtle "dinging" noise, as they soon fly out over the screen. Bright lines stretch from the bottom of the scre
Abominable.appearance: Abominable takes a similar appearance to Permafrost. It has you floating well over a blue mass of particles in a circle. Each are different hues, which blend seamlessly with each other. Lighter blue and white sides near the center, and darker blue and white is near the outline of the circle, and the particles fade away after making it to the extreme border of the circle of particles. You are also floating over a larger circle of outlines of icicles of different, with white particles surrounding the icicles while spiraling upwards in a large circle. The vertexes of the icicles have white dots on them. The icicles are mostly transparent. Snowflakes forcefully head upwards in a vortex motion. It also has blue streams rushing out from the ground below you, and the text shaking, similarly to Harvester. Your avatar is surrounded by what seems to be a frozen aura, blending in with the theme of Wintertime.

Atlas_Yuletide.description: Atlas : Yuletide was obtainable via 1 in 510,000,000 Breakthrough. The chances of obtaining it were 1 in 170,000,000 in Snowy. It was also obtainable through spinning Glorious on the Rare Wheel (0.05% chance) or the Mega Wheel (0.5% chance.)
Atlas_Yuletide.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The opening cutscene for closely resembles that of . It begins with a black screen, followed by a bright light-blue, eight-pointed star appearing at the center. Blue fire-like effects rise from both the top and bottom of the screen, while stars blink and float upward from the bottom. An invisible
Atlas_Yuletide.appearance: Atlas : Yuletide surrounds the player with 7 presents of varying colors, while a star floats in a wide circular orbit around them. The ground beneath shows the cardinal directions—North, East, South, and West—identical to the base aura Atlas. On each side of the player, candy cane-like pillars float with lights resting on top. Two rope-like objects extend behind the player, holding a large snow globe that contains a floating island. Above the snow globe, a rainbow hovers in place.
Atlas_Yuletide.lore: The Titan Who Guard the Celestial Sphere Titans are not merely oversized humans. They surpass modern humanity in every aspect science, magic, society to a degree that the term ancient does them no justice. They built a history deeper and more brilliant than any other civilization. But on the day the [red moon] rose, everything turned to ashes . It is said that in their final moments, the last remaining Titan stood alone, upholding the celestial sphere.

Blossom_Frozen.description: Blossom : Frozen was a limited-time aura that was obtained after completing all of Lime's quests, who can still be found next to Jake’s Workshop (as of 2/15/25). It had a limited stock of 25,000, and the last aura was claimed on 2/18/2025 at around 7:03 PM (UTC+4), or 10:03 (EST), which means it is now unobtainable.
Blossom_Frozen.appearance: Blossom : Frozen displays a snowflake shape above the player with smaller particles falling down (snowflakes, frosts), there are also small blue stars, a larger star that circles around. In addition, the player wields a winter-themed katana, which as presumed is the katana that can be found inside of the ice spikes near spawn.
Blossom_Frozen.ability: Below Zero — Below Zero does a quick slash, dashing you foward and dealing 25 damage to those hit by it. It has a 4 second cooldown and a 1,75 second windup. It teleports you about 51 studs forward with the width of the damage hitbox being 12 studs. The move is also able to hit 5 studs above the user's head | Absolute Zero — Absolute Zero shoots out a short ranged ice-like gust of wind that deals 7 damage for 6 ticks, totaling 42 damage if all hits land with a 10 second cooldown and it lasts for around 2,5 seconds. It's range is about 14 studs, and it's width is around 4 studs, the move can also hit around two studs above the user's head

Frigid.description: Frigid is a limited aura that was obtained after completing all of Lime's quests, who used to be found next to Jake’s Workshop.
Frigid.appearance: Frigid features the player surrounded by four sky blue shards similar to Permafrost, one shard on each side floating above the ground, while leaving behind a thin trail. Closely to the player, two snowflake symbols surround the player's side similar to Winter Fantasy's snowflake, each emitting cyan and white whirlpool effects, and a third located on the player's torso, and two more smaller snowflakes orbit around the player up and down in an infinity pattern leaving behind small white trails. The player also has an icy halo equal to Quartz. Above the player, an orb reminiscent to Oblivion is seen as it is in a dark cyan, cyan, light blue, and white color scheme while emitting particles. Also akin to Oblivion, small rocks in a bright sky-blue orbit below the players waist. Below the player's feet are a loaded amount of bright white flame effects.
Frigid.ability: <span style — "font-weight: 600; font-family: Sarpanch; color: #f9f9f9; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.1px black;">Frozen Spikes : The player charges up a large array of ice spikes and launches it forward, similar to Archangel's firestorm, or Luminosity's Shock ability [E]. Each spike does 15 damage and has a unique hitbox for each. The player can technically hit somebody twice by positioning them between two spikes, but as the spikes show up in rapid succession it is unlikely you will ever get 3 hits, making its effective damage 15-30. The move can hit up to 56 studs away. The ability will then go on cooldown for approximately 10 seconds, and the move's windup takes about 1.7 seconds.

pukeko.description: pukeko is an Event tier aura added in the 2025 April Fools Event Update and re-added in the 2026 April Fools Event Update with a rarity of 1 in 3,198.
pukeko.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen will become black, an ominous noise playing in the background before the edges glow white, before eventually revealing .
pukeko.appearance: pukeko is a pure meme, consisting of the bird Pukeko Chick (baby) flashing back and forth with another part of an exploding outward flame circle. It is a pure static image, while the flame constantly explodes outward.

Flushed_Troll.description: Flushed : Troll is an Event rarity aura that was added in the , and returned in the April Fools 2026 event. It had a 1 in 1,000,000 chance of being rolled during the event (However, when equipped, above the title shows a joke rarity of "2 in 1"). It is a mutation of :Flushed:.
Flushed_Troll.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === 's current cutscene is a near duplicate of 's cutscene. It starts normally, but during the words "will you be my puppet?" There are supposed to be two options. Yes and No. No then changes to Yes. In , the YES option changes to NO. Then, it changes the question to "what" then "bruh". 's former c
Flushed_Troll.appearance: Flushed : Troll is similar to the original :Flushed: aura. The Flushed Emoji (😳) is replaced by a PNG of the TrollFace. The yellow particles on the original is recolored to white and now spirals vertically clockwise.

Origin_Onion.description: Origin : Onion was added in the April Fools 2025 update. Although it displays the rarity of the aura to be 1 in 6,500,000, it was actually obtainable with a chance of 1 in 8,000,000 and is a mutation of Origin.
Origin_Onion.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== Just like , the cutscene contains a fully white star. There is a normal grey background with tiny white particles flying from the bottom to the top of the screen. As the star expands, a fully white vignette effect appears on the screen. The cutscene ends with a flash of white, revealing the aura.
Origin_Onion.appearance: Most attributes of the aura are very contrast to Origin, however, it has an onion ring around the character to replace Origin's ring. All other particles have been changed to onions as well.

Glock_the_glock_of_the_sky.description: Glock : the glock of the sky is an Event rarity aura that was added in the . It had a rarity of 1 in 170,000,000 before it became unobtainable, and is a troll aura mutation of Glock. It was only available for 10 days, and was the second ever April fools event global, with the first being Impeached: i'm peach.
Glock_the_glock_of_the_sky.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== has a special opening effect. The screen turns black, as a real-life image of a Glock with a white background appears rotating in the center, accompanied by numerous smaller copies of the same image spinning in the background—mirroring the visual style of but using Glock decals, followed by the s
Glock_the_glock_of_the_sky.appearance: The player floats and gyrates, continuously flipping upside down in a loop. The main feature of the aura is a large gun positioned above the player’s head, seemingly borrowed from the Glock aura—resized and repositioned. Surrounding the top of the gun are 6 large blue orbs made from Roblox’s default particle effects that circle around the gun, reminiscent of Aegis. There are also tiny blue particles that appear and disappear around the giant [ Glock-17] The floor beneath the player displays a glowing, blue star-like pattern.
Glock_the_glock_of_the_sky.ability: Upon pressing F, the user assumes a stance similar to Aegis. At the same time, the gigantic glock slowly falls toward the user before exploding. This ability deals 10,000 damage, but only to the user. It has a cooldown of 35 seconds, with a wind-up of around 1 second. This ability is completely useless in combat, as it only deals damage to the user.
Glock_the_glock_of_the_sky._fandom_title: Glock : the glock of the sky

Windy_Egg.description: Windy Egg is a Limited Aura added in Eon 1.45 Easter 2025 as with no defined rarity, obtainable from the Zephyr Egg.
Windy_Egg.appearance: The Zephyr Egg rests on top of the player with minty ring rotating around it. Like Wind, minty rings orbit around the player constantly and slash in and out. A thin teal fog comes from the egg, and the player is surrounded with minty stars flashing in and out. Occasionally, a small burst of opaque minty sparkles come out of the player and slightly move before fading abruptly.

Snowy_Egg.description: Snowy Egg is a Limited Aura added in Eon 1.45 Easter 2025 as with no defined rarity, obtainable from the Blizzardous Egg.
Snowy_Egg.appearance: The player has a thin white flame-like effect emitting from them. Snowflakes and small white sparkles fly out from the player also. An opaque minty vortex swirls below the player, additionally pulsing a star constantly. The Blizzardous Egg orbits the player at an angle leaving behind a long white trail. White sparkles come in and out around the player.

Rainy_Egg.description: Rainy Egg is an Event Aura added in the Easter 2025 event. It has no defined rarity and was obtainable from the Downpour Egg.
Rainy_Egg.appearance: Like Stormal, a dark storm cloud floats above the player dropping down blue rain with a thin splashing effect like Sailor. The Downpour Egg rests on the player's right shoulder, as it and the player have an azure, blue aura. A small vortex effect in an azure color swirl below the player. Bubbles rise upward from the bottom of the aura that quickly pop when they appear.

Sandstorm_Egg.description: Sandstorm Egg is an Event Aura that was added in the 2025 Easter event or the Eon 1.45 update. It has no defined rarity and was only obtainable from the Crypt Egg.
Sandstorm_Egg.appearance: When Sandstorm Egg is equipped, the player is enveloped in a cloud of sand. A small cloud of dust can be seen on the player's floor, pulsating from the inside outward. Above it, small circular streaks can be seen. The egg itself is also held in the player's right hand while observing it. Above the player, a small beam can be seen rising towards the sky in small, pulsating intervals. Small characters can also be seen rising from the floor towards the sky and then eventually disappearing.

Hellfire_Egg.description: Hellfire Egg is a Limited Aura added in Eon 1.45 Easter 2025 as with no defined rarity, obtainable from the Hellishfire Egg.
Hellfire_Egg.appearance: The player kneels on top of a big version of the Hellishfire Egg spewing out flames. The egg emits fire around it. The player can also be seen engulfed in flames.

Starfall_Egg.description: Starfall Egg is a Limited Aura added in Eon 1.45 Easter 2025 as with no defined rarity, obtainable from the Meteoric Egg.
Starfall_Egg.appearance: When the player equips Starfall Egg, the character levitates in a pose like as if its flying down like a comet. The player holds the Meteoric Egg in the right arm and the player covers its face with the left arm. As the player flies down, you can see a blue trail leaving by, some stars and and dust flying out from under the player's feet.

Corruption_Egg.description: Corruption Egg is a Limited Aura added in Eon 1.45 Easter 2025 as with no defined rarity, obtainable from the Corrupted Egg.
Corruption_Egg.appearance: When equipped, Corruption Egg places the egg above the player's head. Purple smoke with streaks rises from the mouth of the egg. At the bottom of the egg there sits a purple glowing dot from which three chains extend. These chains are connected to the player's head. The player themself has purple glowing eyes and is enveloped in a cloud of purple smoke mixed with white particles. At the bottom of the player a purple portal appears that pulsates from the inside to the outside. Within this portal small white dots appear that flash over time.

Null_Egg.description: Null Egg is the Limited Aura in Easter 2025 event that is added Eon-1.45 as with no defined rarity, obtainable from the EGG?.
Null_Egg.appearance: When the Null Egg aura is equipped, the EGG? appears in the player's hands. The player is found in a position where they are hugging and holding the egg. Meanwhile, a black X can be seen on the player's face and two other Xs, black and white, move around the player. Glitches can be seen around the player, which appear at intervals and then disappear again. On the ground, a puddle of black and white can be seen moving from the inside out. The player floats above it.

Glitched_Egg.description: Glitched Egg is a Limited Aura added in Eon 1.45 Easter 2025 as with no defined rarity, obtainable from the {"ItemName":"Egg"}.
Glitched_Egg.appearance: As the Player levitates and shakes rapidly, {"ItemName":"Egg"} flies around the Player leaving a white-rainbow trail, the {"ItemName":"Egg"} emits some transparent squares with white-outline, black squares with white-outline and white-rainbow numbers, on the ground, inside the player and inside the {"ItemName":"Egg"} there is a circle white-rainbow effects that gets bigger with time and then disappears, on right eye of the Player you can see a white-rainbow star, some white-rainbow glitch effects appear around the player. The aura is mostly white-rainbow.

Manta.description: Manta is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-6, and can be obtained via rolling with a chance of 1 in 300,000,000 normally and a 1 in 150,000,000 during the Blazing Sun Biome.
Manta.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen shows a dark-blueish star on a black background that gradually becomes blue at the bottom, with bubbles rising from below, similarly to 's cutscene. After a few seconds, a manta pulses twice before another manta rushes over the screen making a transition between the end of the cutsce
Manta.appearance: When Manta is equipped, the player is seated on a large manta ray. Said manta ray pulls a blue comet tail in front of it, as it gently flows upwards and downwards, like a steady rocking chair. The comet tail consists of white and light blue streaks that run from front to back. Smaller particles can also be seen, in which are meant to represent water splashes. Blue mist is also visible, and a dark blue water tail forms below the manta ray. Mixed with the comet tail are small star parts.

Aegis_Watergun.description: Aegis : Watergun is a Summer 2025 exclusive aura with a rarity of 1 in 825,000,000, or 1 in 412,500,000 during Blazing Sun. It is a mutation of Aegis.
Aegis_Watergun.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The cutscene for is almost the exact same as its non-mutation counterpart, however, the main star is a slightly darker blue, with a color change happening in the middle of the cutscene to a sand-like color, along with different text (shown below) written before doing the usual pulses to reveal
Aegis_Watergun.appearance: Aegis : Watergun has a similar appearance to Aegis, but the DEMOLISHER is replaced with a water gun-looking replica. There are also floaters on the floor and rings surrounding the player, one of the rings displays a shield and text that reads " Splash Zone ". The player is standing in a pool of water next to a control panel, the control panel displays a star in the center and 6 arrows (3 on both sides) pointing outwards from it. Water races from the front of the water gun to the back of it, along with what appear to be [ tesseract]-like beach balls. Blue orbs (similar to the ones that Aegis and Glock : the glock of the sky have) move around the middle part of the DEMOLISHER , with a life raft doing the same but closer to the aura. The front of the gun is similar to Aegis, but it's orange and yellow instead of black and blue. The back of the gun has a green plastic hull with a life raft on each side, each corner has a water compartment, and the compartments are hooked up to the midpoint of the gun. The very back of the gun has an orange circle with blue lines extending from the center of it. Green and yellow lines float from the bottom of the aura to the top, occasionally joined by green, yellow, and white stars that move outwards.
Aegis_Watergun.ability: Aegis : Watergun 's ability, activated by pressing the X key, is very similar to [ Aegis]'s ability, but the blue beam is lighter than its counterpart, and it appears to thinner and look more like water. The original laser sound effect is replaced with a sound of water splashing. However, Aegis : Watergun's ability range is significantly less (about half) than Aegis, despite that, it does slightly more damage.

SandBasket.description: SandBasket is a limited Summer 2025 aura. It was obtainable through the Sandbox with a 1 in 3,500 chance to appear in the grid every reset.
SandBasket.appearance: When equipped, SandBasket gives the player a sand-colored basket on their head, alongside black sunglasses. The player also holds a small blue shovel and another sand basket in their hand. Additionally, some sun rays are emitted from the player's body, alongside sand particles rising upward from the ground.
SandBasket.ability: Whenever the E key is clicked, the player creates a light yellow wall made of twelve bricks, resembling the [ — 20250302223906 wall] created by the classic [ Trowel] Roblox gear. These bricks however have no collision.

Bubble.description: Bubble is a Event tier aura that was added in Summer Update 2025 that can be purchased from Lime's Summer Shop for 500 Clams.
Bubble.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== This cutscene is quite similar to 's cutscene, but a bit less saturated. There is also an obscured bubble image near the star, and another in the top-left corner.
Bubble.appearance: When the Bubble aura is equipped, the player is positioned in a slightly crouched position with both arms in front of the chest. The bubble itself represents an ordinary soap bubble. However, this gives off the typical rainbow effect when light shines into a bubble. The bubble also shimmers and emits a slight glow.

Parasol.description: Parasol is an Event aura released during the Summer 2025 event. It is no longer obtainable and was previously available for 750 clams.
Parasol.appearance: Parasol consists of a sea-themed purplish-blue floor with bubbles that emit from it and pop after a few seconds. Lines resembling rain can be seen pouring down from above the player. The player can be seen holding a closed umbrella while wearing a buoy. Sparkles can also be seen emitting around the player.
Parasol.ability: The user pulls their umbrella back for a moment before dashing forward, deal 20 damage and then performing a spin attack which deal 30 damage at the end. The dash distance is ~65 studs.

Bioluminescent.description: Bioluminescent was added in the Eon 1-6 update. It is sold by Lime for 200 Pearl Blue Clams.
Bioluminescent.appearance: This aura consists of the player floating on top of a blue, celestial floor, with two glowing jellyfish floating behind them. The jellyfish have pulsating shining tips. The aura has dark blue-purple fog that rises to the top of the aura before disappearing with shining particles in it. A school of pink and blue fish circle around the player alongside the floor of the aura. The players torso is enveloped by a glowing blue halo and the player’s occasionally glows.
Bioluminescent.ability: The user marks an area in front of them, summoning a clef sign. This sign then charges up, exploding and raining down multiple water spears that deal 2.5 damage eighteen times in the area.

Life_Guard.description: Life Guard is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-6, and is obtainable at Level 50 in the Season 1 RNG Pass.
Life_Guard.appearance: When Life Guard is equipped, a sun appears above the player's head, emitting sunlight. A small puddle of water appears below the player, making it appear as if the player is standing in water. Additionally, the player holds a red and white lifebuoy in their left hand and wears white sunglasses. Small water particles also appear around the player, and small clouds can be seen below the sun above the player's head. The sun also emits a light aura.
Life_Guard.ability: An AOE field is summoned in front of the user, any player within this field is healed for around 20 hp. This field lasts 3 seconds and follows the user, keeping a set distance away in front of the user. |-|Idle= |-|Moving=

Ink_PaintballGun.description: Ink : PaintballGun is an Event rarity aura that was added in the . It could be obtained by exchanging the , which was only obtainable by reaching Level 100 in the Season 1 RNG Pass.
Ink_PaintballGun.appearance: Around the player, there are a range of multi-colored neon particle effects, and occasional lightning strikes above the player. They are also holding the [ Roblox Paintball Gun] in their right hand and the iconic [ Roblox Sword] in their left. There is also a glowing paint splash effect on the ground under the player in the same neon colors.
Ink_PaintballGun.ability: Splash Slash — The Player slashes with the sword, dealing 35 damage and causing a glowing neon blue and glowing neon yellow slash effect with glowing neon yellow , pink , and green particles. | Ink Blaster — The Player lowers the paintball gun from their shoulder aiming it directly in front of them to which the paintball gun will charge for 2 seconds before firing a beam of pink light dealing 10 damage along with an muzzle flash of glowing neon yellow , pink , and green particles. | Dyed-n-Seek — The Player goes underground and remains hidden for about 7 seconds, becoming invulnerable and increasing walk speed. While underground, the player's location is shown as a puddle of glowing neon yellow , pink , and green colors. After resurfacing, the ability deals 17 damage in a small radius.

Scorpion.description: Scorpion is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-7, and can only be obtained by reaching Tier 100 in the Season 2 pass.
Scorpion.appearance: The player stands in a defensive position, with a giant scorpion tail attached to the back of their torso. There is also a small scorpion on the player's left arm. Both the player's and the scorpion's tails have a small golden glow on the stinger. Small, sand-like particles appear on the ground beneath the player, with more tiny sand particles floating upwards around the player.
Scorpion.ability: Dash — {{#tag:tabber|Dash - Forward= [Q]Dash : The player does a simple dash towards any direction they want. The direction of the dash can be adjusted using shiftlock. This ability has a cooldown of 3 seconds. - Dash - Left= The user does simple dash in left. - Dash - Right= The user does simple dash in right. - Dash - Back= The user does simple dash in back. }} | StabScorpion — [R]StabScorpion : The player uses their tail to sting anything in front of them, creating small particles in front of the attack. This ability does 15+(2x5) damage, totaling to 25 damage. The cooldown for the ability is 8 seconds. | Tailswing — [X]Tailswing : The player slows down and does a 360, whipping their tail around, creating particles similar to Spectre around the player. This ability only does 5 damage and has a cooldown of 6 seconds. | Sandstorm Punch — [E]SandstormPunch : The player lunges forward and swings their hand forwards with a scorpion. The scorpion on the player then bites the target, in which the ability is used, doing 12 damage and having a cooldown of 5 seconds.

Pump_Trickster.description: Pump : Trickster is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-9. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 600,000 inside Pumpkin Moon or Glitched Biome only. It is a mutation of Pump.
Pump_Trickster.appearance: Pump : Trickster consists of a dark orange base, with orange effects ascending from the ground and a dark orange fog surrounding the player. Jack-o-lanterns floats on each side of the player, one with a frown and one with a smile. The player themselves wears a jack-o-lantern on their head, with two devil horns piercing through it along with a devil tail on their waist. The player wields a trident in their left hand similar to Undead : Devil and a pumpkin lantern in their right hand, similar to Flora : Evergreen.
Pump_Trickster.lore: If you need to make a deal, he is the right pumpkin to ask. You can make any deal but make sure not to roll the sad pumpkin...

Celestial_Wicked.description: Celestial : Wicked is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-9. It is a mutation of Celestial, and has a 1 in 1,500,000 chance of being rolled exclusively during the Pumpkin Moon biome.
Celestial_Wicked.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A 8-pointed white star appears with white partials. and stats rotating at the center of the player's screen. The star slowly expands, and the background is covered with white color all around the border of the screen before revealing .
Celestial_Wicked.appearance: When the aura is equipped, the player sits on a broom, in a position identical to Celestial, their arm raised to their chest, sitting down. The player gets a purple witch's hat, and 2 beams curve upwards, with small stars at the end of them, one being green, the other being a red-orange color. Behind the player, a circular shape with curving lines that resemble a pumpkin floats behind them, and orange floor particles swirl calmly below the player.

Lunar_Cultist.description: Lunar : Cultist is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-9, seen after clicking on Lunar. It could have been rolled with a chance of 1 in 2,000,000 only inside Graveyard or Glitched, and is a mutation of Lunar.
Lunar_Cultist.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene === Upon rolling, a purple star with eight points and a dark line in the middle will appear. After spinning for about 3 seconds, the star grows closer to the screen, and the background turns purple with dark lines, and then revealing .
Lunar_Cultist.appearance: When Lunar : Cultist is equipped, you get a primarily purple aura. The player seems to be wearing a hood over their head. Purple light ascends from the floor near the player, coming from a large purple sigil on the ground that also emits light. Two candles move around from the sides of the player, with the player also holding a candle. Lastly, a constellation of stars seems to orbit the player, similar to Lunar.
Lunar_Cultist.lore: It was made with Moonlight by an Unknown being on a quiet night.

Headless.description: The Headless is a Event aura added in the Halloween 2025 update. It can only be obtained in the Graveyard biome.
Headless.appearance: Headless has a spectral cyan-like appearance. The player has their head severed from their body and wielded by themselves. Spectral effects emit from the place where the head once was. A sigil is present at the player's feet and behind the player, similar to Maelstrom. A lantern hangs by a a cyan floating chain to the left of the player, and turquoise effects and black fog complete the appearance.A fire aura that is emitted from the portal benath the player can be seen aswell.
Headless.lore: One night, a traveler met a terrible fate on the old forest road. Their life ended suddenly, their soul torn from their body. Now, they wander, silent, headless, and furious. Bound to the place where they fell. Each night, they wait, listening for footsteps, longing for the next lost soul to cross their path.

Werewolf.description: Werewolf is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-9, and has a 1 in 3,600,000 chance of being rolled exclusively during the Graveyard biome.
Werewolf.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene === The opening cutscene is extremely similar to with the "lines" slightly slanted to the left side.
Werewolf.appearance: The player seems to be wearing a wolf mask with glowing eyes and ears, claws, and a wolf tail. There's a glowing moon similar to Lunar : Full Moon above their head with two dead trees branching out from both sides to above the moon. There's yellow-beige and grey effects on the ground with the same yellow-beige colored ghost like effects floating upwards.

Shucks.description: Shucks is a Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9 and It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 4,460,000 only inside Blood Rain or Glitched.
Shucks.appearance: Shucks has an appearance of a bloody butcher, holding a saw blade in the right hand, and possibly two "victims" that were hooked up, with their corresponding photos floating right aside them. Red particles appear on the whole aura and other elements, representing blood.

Oni.description: Oni is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It has a base chance of 1 in 6,666,666 of being rolled in the Blood Rain or Glitched Biome only.
Oni.appearance: Oni has a color scheme similar to Bloodlust. It showcases a blood red sigil on the ground, whilst emitting bright red particles and dark fog. A japanese arc (torii gate) is visible, perched behind the player, covered with dark fog and blood red debris. The player wears an Oni Mask, (hence the name of the aura) and wields a spiked bat in their right hand. The player stretches out their left hand similar to Aegis's second idle animation, revealing dark, crimson magic surrounding the chinese symbol for Ghost ( 鬼 ).

Sinister.description: Sinister is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-9, and has a 1 in 15,000,000 chance of being rolled exclusively during the Pumpkin Moon biome.
Sinister.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black whilst an eight-pointed star spins in the center. The screen is covered in a black-yellowish gradient from the top to the bottom, similar to the star itself which slowly expands, before spinning rapidly, revealing .
Sinister.appearance: Sinister surrounds the player with a glowing orange and yellow aura. Two floating jack-o’-lanterns spin slowly beside the player, shining with golden light. A large full moon glows brightly behind them, casting a warm orange hue. The ground beneath has a circular pattern that pulses and sparkles. Two yellow stars that move around the player in circular motion can be seen as well.
Sinister.lore: The Sinister Bloom. Once born from the same lineage as Moonflower now twisted by shadows of the Darkness Forest. It rooms where light dares not linger, feeding on fear and sorrow. Legends say it glows... Not to guide, but to lure. Drawing the wandering souls deeper into the Woods. Few who follow its orange glow ever return, but they're never the same...

Headless_Horseman.description: Headless : Horseman is a Event tier aura that was added in the Eon 1-9. It is a mutation of Headless and can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 32,000,000 only inside Pumpkin Moon or Glitched.
Headless_Horseman.appearance: When equipped, The player is sat down on a black horse, with flaming orange eyes, their head is gone, and they hold a fiery pumpkin, below the horse a large circle of orange particles can be seen which swirls calmly from the inside to the outside, along with orange fiery fog moving upwards. A few lit candles swirl and float around the horse, and player aswell.
Headless_Horseman.lore: On All Hallows' Eve, the Headless Horseman rises, carrying an pumpkin he stole to replace the head he once had. Once a soldier betrayed in battle, he now roams the night as a vengeful spirit, hunting any living soul who disturbs the dead. As he passes the graveyard, he senses a lingering green presence of a dark spirit that was there not long ago. An unseen veil seems to guide his path, drawing him ever onward. Along his journey, he may encounter forces as dark as himself. when dawn breaks, he vanishes, only to rise again, next Halloween.

Reaper.description: Reaper is a Event aura added in the Eon 1-9. It has a 1 in 66,000,000 chance of being rolled exclusively during the Blood Rain or Glitched biome.
Reaper.appearance: When equipped, Reaper takes appearance of a red-schemed aura, with a rotating giant dark crown-like halo at the top, which consists of a red, whirlpool-like effect around the halo. In the middle of the said halo, a structure that resembles an eye appears. The eye emits red, beam-like particles which travel all the way to the player. The player floats slightly above the floor, holding a huge red scythe in their right arm, while resting their left arm on their hip. At both left and right sides from the player, two red, screen-like objects appear. Those screens have animated eyes on them which blink and look around constantly. The background for the screen consists of many red and white lanes, making an illusion of a static background. The aura's floor looks similar to a red whirlpool, with a big four-pointed star at the middle, under the player. Finally, a lot of red particles rise up from the aura's bottom, as well as red, wave-like effects appear around the player, and soul-like particles are flying from the bottom of the aura to the top, similar to the ones Graveborn has.

Accursed.description: Accursed is a Event aura added in the Eon 1-9. It has a 1 in 82,000,000 chance of being rolled exclusively during the Blood Rain or Glitched biome.
Accursed.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen turns black whilst a 8-pointed star spins in the center. The screen is covered in a black-to-dark-pinkish-red gradient from the top to the bottom like the star itself that slowly expands, before taking rapidly in speed, revealing .
Accursed.appearance: Accursed has a dark-magenta appearance, it has 2 black pillars with orbs on top of them and dark-magenta runic symbols shifting up and down on them. Below the pillars, there are 2 rocks with those symbols changing rapidly. Accursed has a big rock behind the player, on that rock, there are 3 flat discs that pulse with the same runic symbols as on the pillars and small rocks. Accursed has its pillars, and big rock connected by wide lines which are also dark magenta, there is also a pentagram in which the player stands in the middle of it. Every structure (and the floor) emits magenta particles. Every so often, the floor pulses with a ring of the runic symbols everything else has. On the player, the same runes flash on them and a light pink line(?) is placed on their eye.

Bloodgarden.description: Bloodgarden is a Event aura added in the Eon 1-9 and has a 1 in 88,000,000 chance to be rolled during Blood Rain.
Bloodgarden.appearance: Bloodgarden appears to have the player standing in a grassy field, standing in front of a corpse. Around the player is a mace, sword, battle axe and an Excalibur. Behind the player is a tree with a beating heart in the trunk, the leaves are a scribbly mess of red with the word "KILL" being present along with shattered glass. The player's arms are covered in blood, with the head being distorted and the word "KILL" occasionally appearing.
Bloodgarden.lore: After countless battles, beauty fades away, leaving only desolate, lingering murderous intent.

Grief.description: Grief is an Event aura that was added in the second part of the Halloween 2025 event. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 88,250,000 only inside Graveyard or Glitched.
Grief.appearance: When equipped, Grief places the play on the floor, as well as spawning a giant orb that looks like an eye. The same orb is connected to 8 gravestones that levitate around the player. The aura also has a lot of dark blue, and black particles that spawn around the said graves and around the player. The aura's floor has a bright, cyan particle in the center.

Crimson.description: Crimson is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It has a base chance of 1 in 120,000,000 of being rolled in the Blood Rain biome.
Crimson.appearance: Crimson has a pinkish-red appearance. The player is holding a double-edged scythe and wearing a hood, with a band across the torso. Eight candles and four spikes surround the player, along with a glowing ring encircling them.

Graveborn.description: Graveborn is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It had a base chance of 1 in 290,000,000 of being rolled in the Graveyard biome.
Graveborn.appearance: Graveborn takes appearance of a large coffin that is being held by three hands. The player is floating above it, holding a scythe. Chains appear around the coffin, and a stone cross floats near by. The aura has a teal color scheme. An orb is floating near the player and the stone cross, being teal-colored as well.

Afterparty.description: Afterparty is an Event tier aura that was obtainable during Halloween 2025 Update and had a 1 in 440,000,000 chance of being rolled. It is unobtainable outside of Graveyard.
Afterparty.appearance: In terms of color, the aura is turquoise with a color changing script similar to Chromatic : Genesis which changes it to a greener turquoise. Layout wise, the aura has 2 Spotlights in the front, A DJ stage with a built in DJ pad and an actual DJ, and 2 horned speakers adjacent to the stage. The floor uses smooth textures and has complex sigil work, which not only fills in space, but also give the floor its iconic square look. The speakers and the floor both have particles which emit every beat, similar to Chromatic : Genesis. This feature expands on the original DJ concept by conncecting the song with the aura itself.
Afterparty.lore: As their time comes to pass, those souls full of disorder and passion find themselves drawn upon by unseen hands. These forces guide them through the inbetween of the material and that of the soul, to bring them forth to their eternal dance. An everlasting party lies in wait for those rowdy and charismatic beings who have departed from the mortal plane, and as long as there is someone to listen, the music shall never cease.

Phantasma.description: Phantasma is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 462,600,000 exclusively inside the Pumpkin Moon or Glitched.
Phantasma.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The cutscene features a light-orange colored star with flames of the same color coming from up, the center of the star, and bottom. It also has dust like particles similar to cutscene. At the end, a smiling spooky face pops two times before the cutscene ends.
Phantasma.appearance: Phantasma takes appearance of a yellow/orange, vintage-themed aura, having a lot of old-ish objects within the aura. The player gains a unique idle animation, where they stand still, rotating a stick on something that looks like a music box. Around the player, there are a lot of orange, dust-like particles. At the top of the aura, there's a big vintage chandelier that slowly moves. Two paintings are floating behind the player, with one of them featuring an unknown building, while the seconding painting features a man riding on a horse, with other horse standing near by. Both paintings are kept in a vintage-styled frame for both of them, as well as both paintings being black and white, giving them an old style. At the front from the player, two sandy colored pillars are floating, with a plant near one of the pillars. Behind the said plant, there's a candleholder. Another candleholder is floating near the player's right, alongside an object that resembles an old shelf. Finally, there is a large, vintage clock, with Roman numerals on it, similar to the ones Overture and Overture : History have.
