The same clock has a gold pendulum, that go from one side to the other quickly. Near the said clock, there's another old-looking shelf. All of the objects are made out of wood.
Phantasma.lore: It is said that the old mansion's owner had died while playing music box, and now their soul is forever trapped inside it. those who stumbled upon it and play it, they will have the same fate.

Apocalypse.description: Apocalypse is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 624,000,000 exclusively inside Graveyard or Glitched.
Apocalypse.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The cutscene features a light-blue 4 pointed star similar to 's old or 's cutscene. It also has dust like particles behind the star and coming from the bottom being light-blue and light-orange. Afterwards, a sigil pops 2 times before the aura is revealed.
Apocalypse.appearance: Apocalypse consists of a floor made up of a soft dark blue ripple of smoke, with fire coming from it. The player is surrounded by 15 zombies, as well as some street assets such as street lights, a stop sign, and a rusted car. Behind the player are 3 deteriorated buildings that are on fire, all under a shining teal moon.
Apocalypse.lore: When the moon ascends and the sky burns, divine radiance pierces the ruin. From its brilliance, the fallen awaken — neither living nor dead — bound to the one who wields the light. A power of creation through destruction, where even death obeys the illumination.

Wraithlight.description: Wraithlight is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It has a base chance of 1 in 695,000,000 of being rolled in the Blood Rain biome.
Wraithlight.appearance: Wraithlight appears to be an orange storm accompanied by 4 flying Victorian street lamps that dance around the player. There is also a star below the player, and a symbol inside the avatar of the player.

Malediction.description: Malediction is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It has a base chance of 1 in 730,000,000 of being rolled in the Blood Rain biome.
Malediction.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === has a special opening effect. The screen fades into a black-to-red gradient as an 8-pointed dark red star appears on the screen, with red flames burning from the bottom and the top. A synchronized red ring rotates along with the star, with small red skulls shifting randomly in the background. A
Malediction.appearance: Malediction surrounds the player with a swirling red vortex filled with dark mist and glowing particles. A bright red circle with a star shape hovers above the center, glowing and pulsing. Behind it, tall stone pillars and large skulls with glowing red eyes rise from behind the mist, adding to its dark and cursed look.

Banshee.description: Banshee is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 730,000,000 only inside Graveyard.
Banshee.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen turns black as a quick jingle plays, accompanied by a hoarse wind sound that continues throughout the cutscene. A smoke like fog appears around the black star as it turns. The star has four points with a static rainbow bordering it. A constant smoke like wind circle flows around the st
Banshee.appearance: After Banshee is equipped, a huge entity appears, which is holding the player. As seen by the player's pose, they're "controlling" the entity. Teal-colored whirlpool of particles is swarming the aura, with them later rising up and disappearing. The aura's title is also teal-colored, and has some Korean letters behind the main title. The entire color scheme of the aura is similar to the one Headless has.
Banshee.lore: A scream echoed in my head. My skull turned into a chamber for that piercing sound, embedding itself into my memory. I will never forget. What is it...? A memory? A future? A ghost? It closes in on me each night, like a haunting figure in my nightmare dreamscape. The mournful light of it's hazed eyes, a disturbing gaze impaling the inside of my brain. Will things be okay?

Ravage.description: Ravage is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 930,000,000 only inside Graveyard.
Ravage.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== cutscene features a 8 pointed star with medium sized white dust particle effects and fog surrounding the star similar to 's mid opening; furthermore, the star is enclosed in a white sigil that rotates clockwise (in the opposite direction of the star) and the star expels white flames out of it. th
Ravage.appearance: Ravage contains a large muscular humanoid beast with a wendigo skull for a head, with the player mounting on it's back in a dark forest. the floor is covered in a dark, dim, and gloomy fog, the beast is surrounded by 5 spruce trees (2 of which seem to be withered and have less leaves compared to the other 3 trees) with their leaves covered in a thin layer of snow. the atmosphere is composed of debris spiralling around the forest, and small dust debris comming out of the trees, and small yet noticeable white flames coming out of the tops of each tree. in addition, the sky contains a bright light blue glare, with a beam coming out of it and enshrouding the beast; furthermore, the beast is surrounded by 2 beams spiralling around it.
Ravage.lore: My head split open. Or, that's what it felt like; I fell unconscious at the moment it happened. I felt my head hit the ground. A demonic soul reaping the consequences of its actings, I was. A sirlain, a steak, a stirfry of human; Blinded with hunger, an insatiable greed, I took a bite into my family, my community, until I felt it. A spirit, a spirit of evil, a possession I was under. My face split open, my limbs contorted. And then, I hungered more.

Arachnophobia.description: Arachnophobia is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 940,000,000 only inside Pumpkin Moon.
Arachnophobia.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== cutscene features a large 8 pointed red star accompained by spider webs that occasionally appear in the screen with dust-like particles coming from the bottom. At the end a spider icon pops 2 times before the cutscene ends.
Arachnophobia.appearance: When Arachnophobia is equipped, a giant spider on a giant red spider web appears to be holding the player. Big rocks appear to be holding the spider web. A blood moon appears behind the player and the spider, with random symbols rising up. As well as some red wave-like particles rise from the floor to the top of the aura.

Lamenthyr.description: Lamenthyr is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 1,000,000,000 only inside Blood Rain or Glitched.
Lamenthyr.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== 's cutscene starts with a grey Roblox avatar shattering through a red circular gate, with door-like openings appearing around the "gate", each with eyes inside of them, all of them looking around chaotically. Then, a few seconds later, the text " "You've seen it, Haven't you?" " appears on the bo
Lamenthyr.appearance: Lamenthyr Consists of the player floating above a violent crimson storm of swirling particles, the player has one arm raised above their head, and one arm to the side, held outwards. The player wields a large scythe above them, red energy flowing down the tip of the scythe. A tiny lantern is connected to the blade of the scythe, with a calm, red sparkle inside of it. The player gains a metallic, pointed, fossil-like tail that swishes behind them, leaving a small red trail where it moves. above the player are two metallic, sharp rings, spinning in different directions, leaving behind red trails on the tips of the sharp edges. The player's face is censored with a black square, similarly to Juxtaposition. Behind the player is a huge, metallic spine-like object. It moves around quickly, pushing into the ground, wrapping around the player's position, and reaching out to the right of the player. Behind this object, there is a large, circular portal, identical to the one in Lamenthyr's cutscene. It barely moves, the metallic ring around the portal rotates very slowly. Inside of the portal appears to be a sigil, surrounded by a clock-like design. Around the player are three metallic rectangular frames, varying in size, all facing the player. Inside of the frames are many eyes, rapidly looking around, along with red, glitchy particles. Finally, many spikes, and sharp rocks are present in the aura, varying in size, one huge spike to the left of the portal, and many smaller spikes around the bottom of the aura.
Lamenthyr.lore: Genesis • O In the beginning, when God? created me me me me ▮▮▮▮▮▮▮▮ a lizard?bird?▮▮▮? flew?walked?swam? down to you?. Sometimes?? Maybe it was never. Although, you? don't know, you didn't check to see if it was. And he?she?it? was free, free to do what he?she?it? willed, and yet he?she?it? didn't, for there was no message that foretold. It fell. A burning creature. It screamed my name. Or, well, so I thought, but it turns out we all heard it scream our own name. We're walking over to check it out. It's so stupid, they have no idea whats over there. Why am I even walking with them?? I know this won't end well. IT BURNS

Erebus.description: Erebus is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9. It can be rolled with a chance of 1 in 1,200,000,000 only inside Blood Rain or Glitched.
Erebus.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The cutscene starts as a black screen, reminiscent of . After that, a runic-like structure slightly resembling an eye appears with text saying " '''"The last judgement draweth nigh. . ."''' " (text saying the same thing also appears in 's cutscene), disappearing shortly after. The screen starts t
Erebus.appearance: Erebus has a crimson aura surrounding the player. A fractured red circle glows beneath the player’s feet, consisting of glyphs and symbols. Jagged red shards can be seen around the player. Multiple glowing red eyes fade in and out within the aura. Around the player, short pulses of red and black energy flicker. Though it’s base color is a blood-red hue, the aura shifts to a dark blue hue at night on Sol’s Island, and a deep pinkish-purple in the cave at night. This aura shares a visual similarity with Harvester.
Erebus.lore: The Last Judgement draweth nigh... The most corrupted, hideous, and unholy of all beings in mythology. Once a divine messenger of God... Torn apart.

Veinweaver.description: Veinweaver is a limited Halloween 2025 Event aura. It can be bought from Jack The Pumpkin for 4,000 .
Veinweaver.appearance: When equipped, Veinweaver takes the appearance of a spider. The player stands with their arms crossed, and head titled down. Spider legs are coming from the user's back, making it look like the user is standing with their help. A small spider web appears at the back of the aura, and the player gains 6 pink-ish glowing eyes. The aura itself is based around the spider.

Dreadsea.description: Dreadsea is an Event aura that was added in the Halloween 2025 Event. It can be bought from Jack The Pumpkin for 6,000 .
Dreadsea.appearance: Dreadsea appears to be a canoe, sailing through purplish colored mist and water.
Dreadsea.lore: Beneath the cover of the Oceans Castings, fueled by [ REDACTED ] Which whom crosses its path is discarded into a world of cataclysm.

Carousel.appearance: When equipped, Carousel takes appearance of of a purple-themed aura, having a huge carousel in the middle, and a lot of swarming neon purple particles. The player's avatar outline can be seen outside of the carousel. Horses are attached to the carousel and spinning along with it, and two of the horses are carrying two ghosts on their backs. There are also rapidly appearing and disappearing, bats that are floating above the aura itself.

Lament.description: Lament is a limited Halloween 2025 Event aura. It can be bought from Jack The Pumpkin for 22,000 .
Lament.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The screen suddenly fades to black. A loud, high pitched sound can be heard, with wind following. A turquoise star pops out, spinning clockwise with moving patterns similar to wind around it. Below, shadows of grass can be seen swaying, while cloudy particles sit above. Multiple coloured particle
Lament.appearance: When Lament is equipped, it takes appearance of a giant sprawling tree, and the leaves of the tree emits skull effects that fade away and is surrounded by four floating purple and turquoise lanterns connected with beams. The player is located beneath the gargantuan growth with what seems to be a field of fauna, flora and grass and two bushes growing at the aura's base. The player is tremendously shaking, with tears coming out from both eyes, as if they are weeping, and a wispy fog surrounding the head. Behind the player are three translucent purple-tinted panels of shards, with a rift-esque or galaxy-like effect coming out from them. Under the aura and player is a heavy dark purple fog, and mystical flames and ghosts emit from the fog, along with ghostly hands rising from the fog. All the leaves, such as the bushes or the tree emits a turquoise light.

Thaneborne.description: Thaneborne was a limited Halloween 2025 Event aura. It was obtainable from the Jack The Pumpkin NPC for 25,000 .
Thaneborne.appearance: When Thaneborne is equipped, a huge skeletal dragon appears, and the player is floating next to them. The player has a rapidly spinning [ Roblox Spawn Point] crown on their head, and corruption on their right eye and right shoulder. Under the dragon and player lies a portal-esque floor, with galaxy-like effects coming out of it, and 2 rings with crystals seemingly following the rings orbiting around a rock in the middle of the aura under the dragon, and there are light yellow and purple orbs that fly past the aura. A purple moon appears on top of the title, player and the dragon. Two blank "corpses" with an appearance that resembles a dummy seem to be orbiting around the aura with blood-like purple effects coming out from the back of their torso, as well as an abundance of rocks appearing from the aura's floor and orbiting around the aura before disappearing shortly after.. Purple DNA-like beams rise up and circle around the aura.

Slaughter.description: Slaughter is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-9, and can only be obtained by reaching Level 50 in the Season III Season Pass.
Slaughter.appearance: After equipping Slaughter, vibrant red particles emanate from the player, with its shade abruptly getting darker from beneath, resembling a portal-like floor. Brighter red waves emit beneath the player outwards, fading not too far away. The player also sports what appears to be armor, covering their upper arms entirely, with the forearm only being strapped. The player's upper torso is entirely covered, with no coverage for the lower half. Knee pads are also placed on both legs. With this, the player also wields two daggers, one on each hand, emitting particles that resemble blood. The player's face is also overlaid with a red glowing sinister grin, while two red pointed horns are placed on the player's head. The player also sports a red pointed tail that sways slowly from left to right, all of which emit varying shades of red particles.
Slaughter.ability: SCREAM — [X] SCREAM: The player ducks down with their arms crossed, then rises back up, releasing red slash-like particles. A screaming sound can also be heard. The entire ability deals fifteen damage, with five separate ticks dealing three damage. This move has a cooldown of twenty seconds. | Bloody Slash — [E] Bloody Slash: The player crosses their arms slightly upwards, then lashes them back out, creating an X-shaped slash from the two daggers dealing twelve damage. This move has a cooldown of fifteen seconds. | Final Execution — [Z] Final Execution: The player performs a short windup, then proceeds to leap around a small area, gaining a speed boost and creating slashes dealing three damage with ten ticks, repeating the slashes for roughly three seconds for a total of 30 damage. This move has a cooldown of fifteen seconds. | Slash Strike — [F] Slash Strike: Crossing the daggers for half a second, the user rushes forward and delivers a slash projectile with only their right dagger, dealing ten damage. This move has a cooldown of thirteen seconds.
Slaughter.lore: A sanguinary lunatic, wielding two perilous crimson blades. Fond of slaughter and bloodshed, they mercilessly slaughter anyone and everyone. They are regarded to be a associate of the Blood addicts and have only one notion. Kill them all.

Snowball.description: Snowball is an Event aura that was added in the 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 10,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 5,000 in Aurora.
Snowball.appearance: The player glows light blue and holds a snowball. They slowly sway from left to right and the player's right hand is covered in a snow trail. Snowflakes fall around the player and a small cyan floor aura can be seen below the player.
Snowball.lore: Perfect thing to make on a snowday!

StarRider_Snowflake.description: StarRider : Snowflake is an Event tier aura that was added in 2025 Christmas Event with a chance of 1 in 240,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 120,000 in Aurora. It is a mutation of StarRider.
StarRider_Snowflake.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A dark blue star spins in the middle of the screen getting gradually closer. In the last few frames of the animation, a navy-blue glow surrounds the screen. Then, the screen cracks open, revealing .
StarRider_Snowflake.appearance: StarRider : Snowflake takes the appearance of the player riding a cyan-coloured snowflake, similar to its original aura counterpart. A blue snowflake crest is in the torso of the user, occassionally pulsating and expanding forwards. The player also has a light blue glow on their face and the rest of their body.
StarRider_Snowflake.lore: A little friend who will join you on a wonderful trip

Cryogenic.obtainment: Limited (1/250,000 (only in Aurora unaffected by luck) (Limited) Christmas 2025)
Cryogenic.description: Cryogenic is an Event aura that was obtainable during Christmas 2025 with a fixed chance of 1 in 250,000 to be rolled only whilst being in Aurora biome.
Cryogenic.appearance: The player stands in a leaning position, similar to Arcane, holding a bow in the back and wielding a dagger on reverse grip in the right hand, which the player spins around every 9 seconds. Slight fog and smoke covers them, and occasional sparkles appear around the player. The player's hands are covered with bright shiny ice. Some snowy lines can be seen twirling around the player's shoulders. Behind Cryogenic's title, a big snowflake can be seen. The player also emits a faint blue light.
Cryogenic.lore: [This aura is not affected by any kind of luck.] : No potions / gauntlets help with rolling this aura A being frozen long ago. However, its frozen heart continued to beat, and a hunter with a frozen heart was born. It is a cruel sentinel that freezes everything in sight, it prioritizes eliminating beings with warm hearts. Unless there was something to melt it's heart, it would continue on its way as a hunter. Passive - [Frostbite] ‎ Every attack Cryogenic does inflicts [Frostbite] stack based on the damage dealt. When [Frostbite] stack reaches 100, the victim frozes for 5 seconds, making them unable to move. If the [Frostbite] stack remains unchanged for more then 10 seconds, the stack is removed.

Gingerbread.description: Gingerbread is an Event aura that was added in the 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 3,750,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 1,875,000 in Aurora.
Gingerbread.appearance: Gingerbread appears to be themed around gingerbreads. Two of christmas tree gingerbreads levitate behind the player, alongside two round gingerbreads with snowflakes on them, and one gingerbread house behind the two gingerbread trees. The player itself appears to be holding a big gingerbread man. Cookie-colored particles rise up from the bottom of the aura, and travel all the way to the player's head. The player's legs are slightly covered in the particles of the same color as floor, which is also a cookie-like color.
Gingerbread.lore: A taste of holiday magic. Its warmth can soften the coldest streaks of luck.

Jackfrost.description: Jackfrost is an Event aura that was added in the 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 4,700,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 2,350,000 in Aurora.
Jackfrost.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === Upon rolling, a eight-pronged blue star cut by two black lines appears in the middle of the screen, gradually getting bigger as well as spinning faster. In the last few frames of the animation, a blue glow with multiple black lines appears across the screen, revealing .
Jackfrost.appearance: When equipped, Jackfrost gives the player a light-blue, icy staff, alongside giving the player a unique pose, where they stand holding the said icy staff. A light-blue wind appears from the back of the player and travels to the front, while some snowflakes and squares are traveling from the bottom of the aura to the player's head. At the aura's floor, a light-blue storm appears, and circles around the player. Lastly, a snowflake appears on the player's torso, as well as the player's limbs are covered in light-blue snow.
Jackfrost.lore: A shard of the Longest Night, given form. It does not hate, nor love Its the The Whisper of the Frost

Lost_Soul_Wander.description: Lost Soul : Wander is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-13 and has a 1 in 9,400,000 (or 1 in 4,700,000 during the Aurora biome) chance of being rolled. It is a mutation of Lost Soul.
Lost_Soul_Wander.appearance: Once Lost Soul : Wander is equipped, it gains a light-blue color scheme. Two light-blue stars are orbiting around the player, while other four stars are floating close to the player. A light blue aurora-like effect appears slightly above the player's head. Light-blue leaf particles and gold-like star particles appear to be falling down the said aurora effect. The player appears to be holding a sphere that looks similar to a mini-black hole. A yellow-ish bracelet appears to be circling around the same arm that holds the black hole. Lastly, the player's limbs are covered in a light-blue color, with on arms looking like it's gloves and shoes for legs.
Lost_Soul_Wander.lore: Will the miracle of Christmas reach this small soul as well?

Frostwood.description: Frostwood is an Event aura that was added in the 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 24,500,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 12,250,000 in Aurora.
Frostwood.appearance: When Frostwood is equipped, the user stands between 4 pine trees. Snow and ice pieces are falling around. The ground is covered in snow with a spiral pattern. Around user appears some wind blows. Player seem to be lost in deep Frostwood.

North_Pole.description: North Pole is an Event aura that was added in the 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 45,000,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 22,500,000 in Aurora.
North_Pole.appearance: When equipped, North Pole makes the player levitate slightly above the ground, with the player holding a what seems to be magic wand. The bottom of the aura continuously emits blue whirlpool-like floor. A light-blue trail of effects rises up from the bottom all the way to the top, where it merges with the cyan-like glowing star. A trail of particles with the same color also circulates around the player.
North_Pole.lore: In a frozen wonderland with a chilling breeze, a being who guides all the ice.

Sky_Burst.description: Sky Burst is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-13 with a base chance of 1 in 60,000,000, and a 1 in 30,000,000 during Aurora.
Sky_Burst.appearance: When equipped, Sky Burst makes the player sit in a yellow-ish rocket, rising their left arm up as the aura's animation goes. Yellow particles swarm the player, as well as fly past to make an illusion of a moving rocket. The rocket itself has two boosters on both sides and one at the back, with all of them emitting fire particles. Pink firework explosions appear within the aura's range, as well as aura's title featuring a yellow party hat.

Encase.description: Encase is an Event aura added on December 20, 2025 in the Christmas 2025 event. It has a breakthrough rarity of 1 in 230,000,000 or a native rarity of 1 in 115,000,000 in Aurora biome.
Encase.cutscene_note: The screen turns black as a quick jingle noise plays, accompanied by wind noises that continue through the cutscene. In the middle of the screen, dark cyan and black diagonally striped fog appears, whilst dark cyan particles rise from the bottom. In the center of the screen, a dark cyan star with the same gradient slowly revolves while progressively expanding and revolving faster. As the fog in th
Encase.appearance: Upon equipping Encase, the player levitates a short distance above the ground, holding out their left arm with a snowflake in their hand, whilst blizzard particles revolve around them. Behind the player's back are 4 wings made of icy fragments resembling Luminosity's wings. The player also holds a spear made of ice in their right hand, and 2 twitching bodies encased in ice with a snowflake in their torsos float on both sides of the player's wings. A snowflake sigil is located on the player's back. There is a text above the aura name that slowly alternates between 3 different phrases, similar to Pixelation and Matrix : Reality. Snowflake particles rise from the ground close to the player.
Encase.lore: A godlike being who encases threats of the cold, frozen until the end of time.

CryoFang.description: CryoFang is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-13 with a base chance of 1 in 380,000,000, and a 1 in 190,000,000 during Aurora.
CryoFang.appearance: When equipped, CryoFang appears with a giant white wolf. The said wolf idles around the player, having a light-blue eye color, and a trail of effects going off the eye with the same color. The player gains a unique pose, where they hold a huge spear, similar to the one Sovereign has. The player also holds their left arm out and points out to the left. Around the player and the wolf, a blizzard-like floor appears, circulating around the player and the wolf. At the top of the aura, a cloud-like effect resembles a grey cloud which constantly emits snow particles which travel all the way down and enter the blizzard floor. Between the floor and the top of the aura, an effect similar to aurora circles around. The aura's title has a big snowflake in the middle, and a moon at the start of the title. Finally, there's a light-blue circle that looks similar to the one Astral has, which also circulates around the player and the entity.
CryoFang.lore: Snow fell without sound, burying the world beneath layers of pale bule silence as the cold grew deeper with every passing second. The air cracked with frozen energy, and within a radiant circle of ice, CryoFang slowly took shape, its presence warping frost and light alike. Each deliberate movement sent sharp ripples across the ground, as if the land itself acknowledged its return. Its glowing blue eyes held no rage, only an ancient duty to guard a realm forgotten by time and memory. When the blizzard reached its peak and the sky vanished into white, CryoFang dissolved into the storm, becoming nothing more than a whisper of eternal winter.

Northern.description: Northern is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-13 with a chance of 1 in 405,000,000 and a 1 in 202,500,000 chance in the Aurora biome.
Northern.music_file: SoulerP, Soul Trader - 極寒の STRIKE.mp3
Northern.appearance: When Northern is equipped, an ice dragon wearing a blue cloak will appear above floating snowflakes, the player will sit on top of the dragon holding a big icy sword, also with a blue cloak on. On the ground below is many, many blue and purple particles, made to feel as if traveling fast on the dragon. Above the dragon, there are 2 auroras and a blue-tinted moon, along with some fading-in and fading-out stars.
Northern.lore: For in the snowy north of the world, there once lived a peaceful village. Snow covered the land, lights glowed in the windows, and a warm Christmas filled the air. For a time, the village knew only calm and happiness. But the peace did not last. A cruel being known only as Slaughter descended upon the village, spreading chaos and destruction for its own pleasure. Homes burned, the snow was stained, and the joy of the village was shattered. But luckily, two brave guardians were riding alongside a powerful dragon of the north. Seeing the village in chaos, they rushed to help the village without hesitation. The fight was brutal. The guardian stood on the edge of death, it stood no match to Slaughter. In that moment, the dragon refused to lose its rider. With a roar that shook the frozen skies, it annihilated Slaughter from the face of Earth. From that day on, the Northern Dragon and its Guardians become legends. No longer bound to one village, they roam the frozen lands together, watching over the north. Wherever they pass, peace is restored, and happiness slowly returns. The north remembers them as protectors. The world knows them as guardians.

EveNight.description: EveNight is an Event aura that was added in the 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 424,000,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 212,000,000 in Aurora.
EveNight.cutscene_note: ==Opening Cutscene== The cutscene starts with the signature hoarse wind sound effect present in most tier cutscenes. A 16-pointed yellow star appears and slowly spins, along with smaller 4-pointed yellow stars flashing constantly in the background, reminiscent of 's and 's old cutscenes. Glowing blue particles and fog
EveNight.appearance: When equipped, EveNight takes appearance of a christmas-themed aura, with a huge christmas tree at the center of the aura, that is holding on an object similar to a blackhole that Lost Soul : Wander has. Around the christmas tree, variety of light particles appear, as well as christmas lights appearing on the tree itself. At the bottom of the same christmas tree, the player sits, holding a teddy bear in their right arm, and keeping their left arm close to their knee. The player floats slightly above the red bed. Around the bed, three gifts circulate, with them being a red, green and blue gifts. The said gifts are rotating clockwise. At the bottom of the aura, two merged cubes appear, similar the the ones Aegis has. Finally, around the aura itself falling stars appear, as well as some aurora lights. Text above the aura's rarity title is written in a similar manner to Matrix : Reality's texts, switching between " ", " ", " " and " ".
EveNight.lore: The dream of a child on christmas eve...

Workshop.description: Workshop is an Event aura that was added in the 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 700,000,000 and a native rarity of 1 in 350,000,000 in Aurora.
Workshop.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === A star appears during the start of the animation, there are also gift boxes on the top and bottom of the cutscene, and glittering stars are scattered around, there are five-pointed stars rising from the bottom. There are also green and red dots. Then, a giftbox symbol appears along with more gl
Workshop.appearance: When equipped, Workshop takes appearance of a gigantic gifts workshop station with a moving, grey conveyor line, a yellow and red colored mechanical arm, gifts and four elves. The elves are placed in a specific order: One shivering infront of the fireplace, one at the conveyor start, holding a rocket toy, one placing gifts on the conveyor line, and last one holding a gift at the end of the conveyor line. The conveyor has 3 main points: The start, where different toys come out of, the wrapping station, where an elf wraps the gift, and the area where the arm puts the gift in the snowglobe. The entire aura's color scheme is mostly yellow/red, with yellow particles rising up from the bottom of the aura to the top. A variety of gifts appear on the aura, with them being: Red, yellow, cyan, green and purple. Few floating gifts are located at the second elf, while the other floating gifts are levitating next to the mechanical arm. The player stands at the middle of the aura, holding up their head with left arm, while also holding their right arm. Behind the player, there's a big fireplace with a glowing present sign ontop of it. The fireplace itself is seemingly made out of bricks, with a fire and logs inside, and 4 stockings attached to the fireplace with a bow in the center. The aura's title is gold/yellow-colored, with a big present behind the title itself. Some of the letters are slowly floating up and down.

Parol.description: Parol is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-13. It has a breakthrough rarity of 1 in 760,000,000, and a native rarity of 1 in 380,000,000 to be rolled in the Aurora biome.
Parol.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The Cutscene starts with a 16-sided multi-color star with mostly red and blue, with a tint of pink. Similar colored small stars flash in the background as the star keeps spinning. Snowflakes drift from the bottom to the top, also multi coloured. As the cutscene comes to an end, a half red, half b
Parol.appearance: Parol takes appearance of a blue and purple colored aura, with the main aspect of the aura being a huge, blue and purple colored star. The said star rotates slowly, emitting a lot of particles and having an aurora appearing around it. Some particles rise up and circulate around the star before reaching the top of the aura and exploding. At the bottom, there's a deep-blue "lake" is formed. The same "lake" smoothly spins, having a light-blue borders and emitting a lot of blue and purple particles. Similar to Bioluminescent, a lot of wavy-like lines appear, which also seem to be changing their form similar to the "lake" at the aura's bottom. The said lines are consisting deep blue, blue and purple colors. Finally, the player is seemingly floating slightly above the aura's bottom, with a pose that looks similar to Antivirus

Sovereign_Frostveil.description: Sovereign : Frostveil is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-13, and it was added in 2025 Christmas event with a breakthrough rarity of 1/1,000,000,000 and a native rarity of 1/500,000,000 during the Aurora biome. It is a mutation of Sovereign.
Sovereign_Frostveil.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The cutscene starts with the same cutscene that uses, turning black as an unsheathing effect plays, accompanied by a hoarse wind noise that continues throughout the cutscene. A teal and yellow fog covers the screen, and in the center, a golden crown fades in and out with a sound before a blue and
Sovereign_Frostveil.appearance: Sovereign : Frostveil is an aurora borealis themed and much larger version of Sovereign. It features a throne that is similar to its original counterpart, except it resembles a sleigh, harbors antler-like structures on top, and includes a sack of presents in the back. A grey sphere is placed near the middle of the throne, reminiscent of a reindeer's nose. A large dark orb hovers above the throne, similar to the lighter blue one in Sovereign. Surrounding the orb are 8 blue and gold hexagonal ornaments, in place of Sovereign's arrows, rotating counter-clockwise around the orb. Above the orb are two 8-pointed stars, the larger one rotating clockwise, with the smaller one above rotating counter-clockwise. In replacement of the original Sovereign's blue/gold ribbons, there are now 4 long spikes facing downward and rotating clockwise around the throne. The player wields a candy cane scepter on their left hand. The scepter's tip is a snowglobe with presents visible inside, along with 2 branches resembling pine.
Sovereign_Frostveil.lore: For now, it's the same as the Sovereign lore. - 54_xyz -

Winter_Garden.description: Winter Garden is an Event aura that was added in the 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 1,450,012,025 and a native rarity of 1 in 725,006,013 in Aurora.
Winter_Garden.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The player's screen turns black. Then the screen does two faint blue pulses before switching to the view of a lotus flower with 's theme playing along with it, with many light blue-purple particles and snowflakes revolving around. The words Do you see me? appears in the middle of the screen in a
Winter_Garden.appearance: Winter Garden takes inspiration from lotus, looking very similar to Lotusfall, having a light-blue color scheme, with many lotuses placed around the aura. Two big, light-blue lotuses are levitating above the aura, with both of them slowly tilting from one side to the other. Near them, a giant, purple-ish moon appears, being very similar to the ones Nightmare Sky and Moonflower have. Beneath the said moon, the player levitates and holds out a small, light-blue snowflake. Next the to the player, another light-blue lotus appears, levitating and slowly rotating. At the front of the aura, three light-blue lotuses appear. On the aura's floor, sea-like particles are formed, creating an illusion of the entire aura taking a place on the lake. From the said "lake", a lot of light-blue, purple-ish particles rise up, and circulate around aura all the way to the top. Finally, from the top of the aura, there are snowflake particles slowly falling down, leaving purple-ish trails as they descend down to the aura's floor.
Winter_Garden.lore: A lotus lays within the garden, buried in snow under the blizzard. The bloom that whispers, and the flower of life.

Dream_Traveler.description: Dream Traveler is a 2025 Christmas Event limited aura and was added in the Part 2 of the 2025 Christmas Event. It can be rolled with a rarity of 1 in 2,025,012,025 or 1 in 1,012,506,012 during the Aurora biome.
Dream_Traveler.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === 's cutscene starts of with a train sound effect and a black screen with red and blue fog, snowflakes and stars hovering and flashing over the screen, and text saying either " '''''"Why, to the North Pole, of course!" ‎ ''''' ", " '''''"What is your Wish, Dear Fellow" ‎ ''''' ", " '''''"Tell me,
Dream_Traveler.appearance: When equipped, Dream Traveler takes appearance of a purple, blue, pink and yellow themed aura, with a lot of aspects of it referencing [ The Polar Express], and with one of the main details being The Express itself. The Express that is presented on the aura takes appearance of an old steam train that seems to be coming out from one of the neon purple portal, and goes on with rails that resemble film tape. The same film tape can also been see on the opposite side, with three gingerbreads placed on it. The player seems to be floating highly above the huge red star that is located at the aura's bottom. The player also gains unique sets of accessories, those being conductor's hat and a bugle. Behind the player, there's a gigantic floating book that seems to be emitting a lot of particles and beams from it, as well as more film tapes and another red star. At the book's left, another purple and black portal is presented, alongside another portal at the book's right. Both portals are seemingly not leading anywhere. All three portals are emitting different particles, as well as having a big purple barrier in them, creating an illusion of a working portal. At the aura's bottom there are a lot of purple and red particles, as well as a huge red star mentioned before. Those particles are slowly rising and circulating all the way to the top of the aura, and upon making to there, disappearing. Lastly, there are many snowflake particles appearing from the sky, as well as some particles that resemble falling stars also appear at the top of the aura, and then falling down to the bottom.
Dream_Traveler.lore: Legend has it that on every Christmas Eve, a nutcracker-like figure appears in people's dreams. He arrives accompanied by the sound of a train, his face remaining indistinguishable. When the sound of a trumpet emerges, he brings sweet dreams and grants wishes. As these dreams descend, people drift into serene slumber within them, awaiting the arrival of a new day.

Present.description: Present is an Event tier aura that was added in Eon 1-13 with a chance of 1 in 100 (1%) from being rolled from the Christmas Roulette.
Present.appearance: The player emits a red circle at the bottom with a green outline, both emmiting fire-like particles. In the torso, a red 6-pointed snowflake lies in the center, pulsing at given intervals. Curved green streaks of light surrond the player, with occasional red streaks appearing. The player holds a present itself with a candy cane strapped to the back of the torso, and the head of the player contains two colored eyes, green and red respectively.
Present.lore: A moment of perfect stillness, wrapped in time itself.

Skyforge.description: Skyforge is a Event tier aura that was added in 2025 Christmas Update with 1/500 chance of being rolled from the Christmas Roulette.
Skyforge.appearance: The aura revolves around the hot-air-balloon structure in the center, accompanied by decorative lights of various different colors, with swirling particles of color surrounding the top. Presents float beside it, each emitting their own particles, while colorful debris pass. The bottom of the hot-air-balloon holds a small platform over a blue circular aura, where the player resides, holding one arm out forward.
Skyforge.lore: Can you imagine? Santa is known to appear in many different forms around the world. In some countries, he is said to ride a sleigh led by Rudolph; in others, he travels in a massive hot-air balloon; and in yet others, small fairies arrive carrying gifts and hand them out. There may be even more forms beyond that. The sleigh we know as Santa's was simply just one of many kinds of Santa.

Christmastide.description: Christmastide is a Event tier aura that was added in 2025 Christmas Event with a rarity of 1 in 1,000 [from Christmas Roulette].
Christmastide.appearance: Christmastide is an aura that has the player floating above a deep blue and white circle, wearing a Santa hat whilst carrying a giant candy cane, held over the shoulder, similarly to Chillsear. Around the player are multiple gift boxes circling them. Behind the player are 3 stars, one red, one yellow and one green. These stars will occasionally pulsate. To the side of player are 2 giant candy canes on the ground, and two yellow and green horses. Around the player is a revolving sleigh.
Christmastide.lore: "Wow, it feels like we're already standing at the edge of the end of all four seasons. It's something I feel every year—while a year feels long as you're living through it, it somehow feels unbelievably short when you look back on it. What have you accomplished this year? Surely, there must have been some incredible moments, right? Even if they weren't something huge, that's okay. Small memories can still hold great meaning. Nothing happened at all? Congratulations! Just making it through without anything bad happening is already a success! Was it full of bad things instead? Oh no... but don't worry. Bad things can happen to anyone. When people go through hardships, the pain often makes them forget all the good things they experienced as well. So please, hold on to even the smallest bits of happiness. I'll be rooting for those little joys to grow like a snowball and come back to you as something truly great. With that, I hope you have a wonderful end to the year. Merry Christmas!" - - Someone who loves Christmas -

Reina.description: Reina is the Event tier aura that was added in the Winter/Christmas Update and can only be obtained by reaching Level 50 in the Season IV Season Pass.
Reina.appearance: Reina Consists of the player standing in a small snowstorm, with small shapes and snowflakes swirling upwards around them. They hold a scepter with a light blue glowing ball floating at the end of it. The player has some moose antlers and small moose ears on their head. The player is equipped with a blue coat, and brown fluffy legs, with white fluff inside the coat, and white cuffs.
Reina.ability: HooveStomp — Player stomps on the ground, dealing twelve damage to nearby players. | BlizzardRush — Player swings their wand, creating a whirlwind that will fly forward up to 30 studs until disappearing. If a player gets hit, they take twelve damage, and the whirlwind disappears. This ability will also give a short speed boost to the user. | IceCrush — Player spins their staff around above them, slowing them down, and then swings it forward. After three seconds, a giant ice ball will fall far in front of the player, dealing massive AOE damage. Deals fifteen damage if in range. | PiercingCold — Player swings their staff forward, creating four small spikes that will fly forward. If a player hits a spike, it will disappear and deal twelve damage to that player. This ability also slows down the user.
Reina.lore: Reina is a protector of the forest. Half human and Half Reindeer, is against the Blood addicts, her main apponents especially being slaughter. The power of Ice makes Reina powerful enough to protect the villagers and the animals from the Blood addicts’s assaults.

Symphony_Bloomed.description: Symphony : Bloomed is an Event mutation of Symphony that was added in the Eon 1-16 and can be obtained with a chance 1 in 375,000,000.
Symphony_Bloomed.music_file: solore - floating under the expanse of stars (part 1+2).mp3
Symphony_Bloomed.appearance: Symphony : Bloomed is a pink recolor of Symphony with updated effects and models, such as the wings and the crown above the aura. There are flowers blooming around the aura, and a flower resembling a lotus blooming inside the crown.

Velvet.description: Velvet is an Event tier aura that can only be obtained by completing Lime's Valentines 2026 quest.
Velvet.appearance: Velvet has the player holding a heart shaped box of chocolates, with small pink wings on their back. The player also has a circle on the ground below them and one above them with hearts hanging below and spinning around the character. Multiple pink heart particles come from the player's torso along with pink light beams attatched to them.
Velvet.ability: [E] Sweet Confession gives an effect to players in a certain range of the user called "Sweet Delight", giving 100% luck for 5 minutes. The cooldown for the ability is also 5 minutes, meaning the buff has no downtime if the ability is constantly used. You cannot buff yourself through this ability.

Blood_Demon.description: Blood Demon ( , also known as ) is a Event tier aura added in the Boss Raid 2 Update.
Blood_Demon.appearance: When equipped, Blood Demon takes appearance of mostly red-themed aura, with it also being similar to Red Full Moon and Fragments of the Crimson Moon. The player appears to be floating slightly above the ground, holding a staff that is very similar to the one that The Amalgamation Boss has. Behind the player, a circling halo-like structure appears, with quickly rotates behind the player's back. Behind the said structure, a red, half-moon appears, which slowly floats near by. The player also gains a unique accessory, with it being 2 pair of wing-like things, very similar to the ones that The Amalgamation Boss uses during their second phase. The player is also swarmed by orange-ish effects that constantly circulate around the player. Finally, from the aura's bottom, a lot of red, star-like effect appear, traveling to the top and then slowly disappearing.

Hatchwarden.description: Hatchwarden is an Event tier aura that was added in the 2026 Easter Part 1 Update, it can be rolled with a basechance of 1 in 40,000,000 and can be obtained from the .
Hatchwarden.appearance: The player is surrounded by a vivid surge of glowing green energy, spiraling outward in chaotic waves. Beneath them, a bright circular field pulses with intense light, releasing sharp, flickering particles into the air. The aura emits a constant radiant glow, giving the impression of something powerful awakening from within. Its overall presence bears resemblance to a nature-infused aura, similar in style to Jade, but far more volatile and awakened in appearance.
Hatchwarden.lore: A lone guardian that watches over the deepest part of the forest, protecting aa miracle of life that has yet to be born.

Revive.description: Revive is an Event tier aura that was added in the 2026 Easter Part 1 Update and can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 645,000,000. It is also obtainable by using the , which has a 0.0062% chance to spawn naturally, or a 2.16% chance from a Random Egg.
Revive.appearance: The player reaches their arm out upwards, holding an egg in their other arm, floating above a golden floor, the floor is decorated with small patches of pastel grass, and golden colored flowers. The player has a bright halo, and a cross symbol glowing inside of their torso, above the player is a huge, floating bell, glowing brightly, next to the bell are a few vibrant floating eggs. Under the bell, the aura’s title floats, with a large, transparent flower design behind it. Many eggs cover the ground, along with a small wooden boat behind the player, with a few eggs resting inside of it.
Revive.lore: A clear bell chime that awakens dormant life and stirs flowers into bloom.

Eggore.appearance: The player lays in the mouth of a large, pink and blue, plant-like creature. They have two, small, black X shapes covering their eyes, and blue and pink sparkles on their body. In the center of the aura is the plant-like creature, the creature is a cartoony version of a piranha plant. It has a small rabbit nose, and rabbit ears on its head. it has blue and pink streaks above its mouth, representing eyes. The creature's mouth glows neon pink, and has two rabbit teeth at the top of it, and many differently colored smaller teeth. it has a thin body, with a bow-tie, and four legs, with a cyan paw print design on them. Below the creature is a bright pink floor of particles, with a bright glow in the center, right under the creature. Easter eggs will occasionally fly around the creature, before leaving a pink and blue explosion.

Eostre.description: Eostre is a Event aura that was added in the Easter 2026 Part 1 update. It can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 1,000,000,000. It is also obtainable by using the , which has a 0.004% chance of spawning naturally, or a 1.39% chance from a .
Eostre.appearance: In Eostre, the player is surrounded by trees, eggs, and other decorative elements, creating an immersive environment, with a total of five trees and nineteen eggs present throughout the area, eight of which are placed on the ground while the remaining eleven are placed within the trees themselves. On the ground, butterflies, flowers, and rainbows are present throughout. The flowers themselves come in six colors, purple, blue, pink, white, yellow, and green, adding visual variety. The trees contain three specific types of flowers: pink, white, and yellow. The player holds a double-edged sword made of branches, with three butterflies perched on the right arm, one perched on the left arm, and two more resting on the left leg. From the base of the aura, a green and blue glow spreads outward gradually, while around the trees, light particles continuously rise and flower petals gently fall. The trees themselves are approximately 30 studs tall and 45 studs wide with lanterns hanging around them, adding additional lighting and detail. During daytime, the trees, glow, and sword turn green, while the lanterns shift to yellow and green. During nighttime, the trees glow, and the sword turns blue, as well as the lanterns changing to a green and blue hue.
Eostre.lore: Eostre, radiant goddess of the Germanic dawn, rises each spring with the first golden light of the east. As she walks across the waking earth, frost loosens, rivers stir, and flowers bloom in her path. Hares leap through the greening fields, signs of life she renews. With gentle hands she awakens the orchards that survived the harsh winter and stirs hope in wandering hearts, promising that after every winter's darkness, the dawn will come again.

Sky_Festival.description: Sky Festival is an Event tier aura that aura added in the 2026 Easter Part 1 Update and can be rolled with a base chance of 1 in 2,000,000,000. It is also obtainable from using the .
Sky_Festival.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== The Cutscene starts with the aura appearing, flying above the clouds. Below, text says: '''''Would you believe if there is a Festival going on in the Sky?''''' After, it says '''''Hop on to see if its true!''''' After, it flys into the nightsky and the aura appears.
Sky_Festival.appearance: When equipped, Sky Festival takes appearance of a gigantic wooden ship, covered in flowers and eggs. The player sits at the very edge of the ship, holding on one of their arms, while keeping the other one up. The player also gets a unique accessory, with it being a hat with bunny ears. The ship's deck appears to be carrying a lot of eggs with various colors, as well as some more flowers. The port also appears to be carrying more eggs, alongside even more flowers. The 3 mast appear to be to be carrying 3 huge eggs and more flowers. The ship itself is floating above a purple-ish fog, creating an illusion of the ship floating above the clouds.
Sky_Festival.lore: A sky-borne bastion of which sails the skies, fuelled by the wind and belief. The eyes of children climb upward in hopes of catching a glimpse of the revered Sky Festival in the briefest moments it dips below the clouds. The Sky festival annually sails the globe to distribute all kinds of sweet treats to those young and old, under only the condition that they believe. Lest they not, the ship remains invisible. This titanic construct is piloted by none other than the Easter Bunny themselves, a one-man crew aboard a wooden behemoth destined for nowhere. The ship is silent as it soars, needing not to make a crescendo upon its arrival; the rain of goods that follows it is more than sufficient. It is unknown how it constantly generates such large mounds of sweets—assumably driven by the same great force that allows the Sky Festival to fly in the first place—believing. It is gone as fast as it comes, a one day global trip, only touching water once it reaches the shorelines of Easter Island, and where it ends up upon touchdown? A forever remaining secret.

The aura's floor seems to be resembling a yellow grass.
Nostalgia.lore: Do you remember those summers? I do... though each year, the memories become a little blurrier. I still hear the laughter carried by the evening breeze, echoing between rows of glowing lanterns that seemed to stretch into the stars. The air was warm, sweet with the scent of food from stalls I'd race between without a single worry in my mind. Back then, time didn't matter. Tomorrow always felt infinitely for away. I thought those nights would never end. I chased fireflies until the sky turned black, watched fireworks bloom like flowers above my head, and believed every wish I whispered into the summer wind would somehow come true. The world felt so much bigger then... yet somehow safer. Simpler. Funny, isn't it? The festival still returns every year. The lanterns still sway. The music still plays. Children still laugh exactly as we once did. Yet when I walk those same paths now, something is missing. Maybe it isn't the festival that's changed. Maybe it's me. The days became shorter. Responsibilities replaced wonder. Somewhere along the way, I stopped looking up when the fireworks painted the sky. I stopped chasing moments because I was too busy chasing tomorrow. *If I could go back... even for one more evening... I'd run through those streets again without thinking about time. I'd hold onto those fleeting moments just a little longer. I'd tell my younger self not to grow up so quickly. Because I finally understand... The most precious memories are the ones you never realize you're making. So if you ever find yourself beneath the glow of summer lanterns, with music dancing through the night and laughter all around you... Stay a little longer. For someone, somewhere... They're already missing this moment.

Tropical_Isles.lore: Tropical Isles Beneath the radiant embrace of on endless summer, the ocean hums a heavenly melody that reaches every shore. Palm trees dance with the wind, flowers bloom without end, and the sea glows like a living symphony. A paradise that hugs you, giving a comforting embrace, inviting every weary soul to rest beneath its eternal tropical skies. As the sun reaches its shuteye stage, it showcases its golden skies, illuminating the clouds above. You hold onto your raft and enjoy your refreshing coconut beverage, the flowers on your dear float are blooming as the sunlight makes them sparkle. You observe the isles, the emerald grass and the pink hibiscuses show their beauty. The mammoth palm trees drop their small leaves which happened to softly land on your face, hanging ribbons glow as you con clearly see. The ocean glimmers a pleasant midnight color which reveals the glimmering sea life. Under the tropical isles, in your vision you can see a colorful array of corals and fish. An abandoned anchor from a ship is enlightened by a holy glow of an ancient pearl which improves your view of these isles. The pearl shows you a mesmerizing light show which reveals to your heart that these are really the Tropical isles.

Crabtropica.lore: Millennia ago, in the height of summertime, a young crab bearing a rock upon his shell roamed Sol's Island. 'Neath the harsh blaze of the sun, he entered the vast sea for the first time. And as the deep blue enveloped him, something shimmering below him like never the young crab had ever borne witness to- the lights of Atlantis itself. He descended into the city, bustling with people and monuments stretching as far as the eye could see. He scuttled along its winding pathways, awestruck by the world around him, until a voice called out to him. Poseidon Himself. Poseidon respected the young crab's perseverance, carrying such a burden on his back at all times, and thus; Poseidon bestowed a gift unlike any other to the young crab- The gift of life. Every year, at the peak of summer, something rises out of the sea- The same young crab, carrying a small island on its back, You deserve some rest, traveller. sorry about the cutscene... we couldn't get someone to animate this crab and after getting an animator there wasnt enough time to make it.

The aura itself is a neon blue relic, with notable sparkles shining around certain areas. A spinning spiral can be seen underneath the player that emanates outwards, alongside even more sparkles. A spinning circle effect floats above the player, with a square in its middle; each of its corners glowing. Blue lightning can be seen around the player, and the player is equipped with 3 claws on both hands, similar to that of a feline's.
Sol.lore: This is called the worldview itself. It is stronger than everything in this world combined and has outstanding power. It is owned by one person who is at the top among the many engineers who created the world.

Red_Full_Moon.description: Red Full Moon ( , also known as ) is a developer-exclusive aura, and unobtainable from rolling.
Red_Full_Moon.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== A black background with faint fog that has a dark shade of red appears, the words " ", which translates from Japanese to appears and fades away letter after letter, after that, a halo forms that is similar to the one possesses in-game, shortly after, a sigil with the word " " appears, meaning to
Red_Full_Moon.appearance: The player has a ring of spikes pointed out horizontally that acts like an audio visualizer. A large red eight-pointed spike (four of them are longer, and the other four are shorter) facing outwards with two rings that are similar to a halo, and a glowing dark red star is visible inside the halo. At the player’s feet, smoke rises up from the ground. The player can be seen leaning back while floating, their left hand on their head, and the right hand pointing to the front where the player is facing.
Red_Full_Moon.ability: Ability 1 — The player slams their fist down, creating a large, red, shockwave. Red particles and electricity fly everywhere, and a red crater appears on the ground before fading away. The ability kills all players in radius. | Ability 2 — The player marks 3 areas around it, as these marked areas are exhibited as some sort of large, red and black portals, releasing some particles that are red and black as well. After 2 seconds, those portals explode on a large, red and black explosions that kills every player in the explosion's radius. | Ability 3 — The player marks a large, red sphere made up of triangles around the player. After 4 seconds, the force field explodes, releasing a large, red beam up to the sky that emanates an ominous, red and black aura, with many different particles such as red and black stars and lightning, as well as killing every player close to the beam. | Ability 4 — The player summons a red sphere made up of triangles that falls down to the ground, killing every player caught in its kill radius. | Ability 5 — It's like the parry cutscene but it's more different. It starts with a blood moon and stars and lines go out the moon, going closer closer. a bell rings, making the screen go normal. After the bells ring, there will be static and the camera slowly going closer and closer to the camera until there will be a disconnection message, and another bell sounds.
Red_Full_Moon.lore: Chaos. The origin and source of all unstable existence that once filled the primordial world.

Mastermind.description: Mastermind is a Dev Exclusive aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling. It is exclusively to 53_Axis.
Mastermind.appearance: The player is shown in a levitating position, similar to that of Chromatic : Genesis. The player is given a bright, white eye glare, and a slight white and black flare at the hands. Four black and white orbs are seen orbiting about the player, the greek letters Δ, Ω, Σ, and Φ can be seen inside them, they leave no trails. There appears with many complex math equations, such as limits seen fading in and out. Behind the player, a black and white sigil resembling that of Red Full Moon is seen, and other sigils that is inside in certain auras, such as Impeached and Luminosity during its cutscene. The floor has a white portal and white clock sigil.
Mastermind.ability: ZERO — The user raises their fist, clenching it while text simultaneously appears at the bottom left of the screen saying " THIS IS THE END. " followed by the user punching the ground while a sound similar to Overture and Overture : History's ability plays as a gigantic white clock is imprinted into the ground as everything is frozen in place for 10 seconds. Using Mastermind's COLLAPSE ability during the frozen state will freeze the vfx emitted by the ability. | RUSH — The user swiftly teleports in the direction they are moving, similar to Petalwind ability. | COLLAPSE — The user raises their right leg and stomps on the ground, causing six consecutive explosions in the direction of where the user was facing as text appears on the bottom left saying " FUTILE. ", similar to Archangel's ability. If a player has pvp mode turned on, getting hit by any of the 6 explosions will deal 70 damage. This ability will not deal damage if ZERO is active, but will deal damage after ZERO's duration is finished.

Edict.description: Edict is an unobtainable Dev Exclusive aura added in the Eon 1-16 for Word's Admin Abuse event. This aura cannot be obtained through rolling, and was exclusively given to 2word7.
Edict.appearance: Edict takes appearance of a golden-ish themed aura, being very similar to , Mastermind and Red Full Moon, having a large, golden halo floating above the player, with an object that seemingly resembles a flower. The player is floating slightly above the ground, holding a golden scales in one hand, and a big, golden and white gavel in other hand. The scale that player holds is very similar to the one that Verdict has, having a heart on one bowl and a feather on the other. Beneath the player, a golden, circle-like floor appears, consisting with 3 layers of circles. Words , , and appear around the player. Finally, a lot of random letters appear at the bottom of the aura, quickly rising up and fading as they travel the the aura's top.
Edict.lore: Space. The one who created a single book formed from the infinite cosmos that makes up the world, layered with dimensions containing that cosmos.

Abomination.description: Abomination is a developer-exclusive aura, and being unobtainable via rolling as a normal player.
Abomination.appearance: Abomination brightly shines in dark pink and black. The player floats pointed towards the ground and has a giant, glowing pink star orb (similar to Exotic : Apex, Impeached, or Oppression) that hovers and slightly shakes above the player. Additionally, there are three smaller pink orbs connected by dark pink and black lightning, similar to Sol's or Hyper-Volt's orbs but much larger, they twitch around in what seems to be a glitching motion. The orbs also orbit the player, in the way Sol possesses, hinting that it might be the opposite of Sol. Additionally, a large purple and black void surrounds the player from underneath. The aura seems to be a fusion of: Impeached, Exotic : Apex, and Sol. It also has a dark pink / purple recolored version of Abyssal Hunter's OLD floor particles. Abomination's name, along with its rarity, constantly changes capitalization and into different symbols similar to Glitch, Oppression, and Cruel.

Cruel.description: Cruel is a developer-exclusive aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling.
Cruel.music_file: ProSoundEffects - Afterworld Ambience Weird Rumbling Ambience 4.ogg
Cruel.appearance: Cruel creates a slightly transparent, black, glass-cracking effect under the player, which bears a resemblance to the cracking screen at the end of the opening animation, when rolling an aura above the rarity of 99,999, but less than 1,000,000. When Cruel is active, the player also adapts a pose that is similar to Bounded : Unbound's pose, but on the floor. The player also wears a black mask with a red smile, similarly to Flushed : Lobotomy, and :Flushed:. There are also black squares that emanate from, and surround, the player, It also has warning signs and stop signs embedded in its body.

yuyo.description: yuyo is a developer-exclusive aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling.
yuyo.appearance: Similar to Impeached: i'm peach, all of yuyo's effects are derived from one single image. For yuyo, the image presents two dogs cuddling, with a snowy mountain in view. The aura emits many copies of the aforementioned image from below the player, and likewise from their torso. The images also trail around the player's head like a halo, similar to Impeached's orbs.

Find_the_probability_of_this_aura..description: Find the probability of this aura. is a developer-exclusive aura and can't be obtained from rolling. It is for the developer 2word7.
Find_the_probability_of_this_aura..appearance: Find the probability of this aura. adds nothing apart from the aura's title, which contains a math expression in place of where the rarity would be. The player’s face appears to be partially covered by the letter Sigma, which is part of the Greek alphabet, similar to Undefined.

Samgong.description: Samgong is a developer-exclusive aura and cannot be obtained from rolling, despite its chat message showing the rarity (1 in 1,000,000,000).
Samgong.appearance: Samgong makes the player sit on the toilet and plays the occasional fart sound effect. It has no title or rarity display. Pressing X, which is usually the key to activate/use an ability causes a flushing sound to play.
Samgong.lore: 푸쉬쉭!! 뿡..뿡.. 푸드득...!! 뿌르르륵...! 뿌와아아악!!!!! 퐉!! 뿌륵...! 뿌뤄뤄뤅...!!! 퐁당💩

Kanade.description: Kanade is a developer-exclusive aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling.
Kanade.music_file: ON KINJE - Mozart's Morning Bus (Lullaby Ride).mp3
Kanade.appearance: Kanade features a "cloud" of spinning 3D fumo plushies of the character Yoisaki Kanade, which appear and move around the player for a few seconds before disappearing.

Sapphire_Peace.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Sapphire_Peace.description: Sapphire : Peace is an Unobtainable tier aura that was added in 2026/3/14 update. It is a mutation of Sapphire but was not made obtainable.

Godslayer.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Godslayer.description: Godslayer is a Unobtainable tier aura that was added in 2026/3/14 update but was made unobtainable shortly after its release.
Godslayer.appearance: Godslayer is an aura with dark theme. Most of the aura’s color is purple or black, with a huge purple storm violently swirling around the player. The floor under the player has black aura at the core with it turning to purple as it reaches the edge. There are few orange stars above the player, and a huge sigil that rotates itself behind the player.
Godslayer.lore: What was it? How was it? How were the consequences that I brought back to this world? Just like how you treated me before I became what I am today. I am not the █████ you known for eons, you cannot recognize me of what I was with my new profound power, but you’ll discover it sooner or later. As I fell into the Abyss of Malevolence, I yearned, I screamed, and I hollered till my voice shatters, yet no one came to seek my suffering, but only one who came, the one who is evil itself. My deep resentment that I kept for eons, had turned into hatred and wrath, as I am free to do what I want and desire. Now I carry this prison with me, trapping every single gods in countless universes, just so I can prove it to you that I am more than what I was before. Count your days and I will follow through it.

Chromatic_Exotic.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Chromatic_Exotic.description: Chromatic : Exotic was a mutation of Chromatic and was a 1 in 99,999,999 chance of being rolled, before its removal from the game and collection.
Chromatic_Exotic.cutscene_note: ===Opening Cutscene=== This aura had a semi-basic special opening effect; the cutscene began with a red star with the 1M+ star sound, (10M+ star sound in Era 5). The star spun faster and faster, revealing the aura. This aura had the same cutscene as the aura in Era 5.
Chromatic_Exotic.appearance: Once equipped, the player would be given three massive, glowing, rainbow orbs, that would float and orbit around them as they hovered above the ground. An even larger rainbow orb floated above the player, surrounded by multi-colored stars. These orbs would also pulse in sync with the music. A question mark symbol could be seen on the player through the flashing lights, as well as the rainbow effects that covered them. Just like its normal counterpart, a rainbow-colored circular audio visualizer could be seen surrounding the player, in this case wider, with more pointed spiking visuals. A large, rainbow circle, similar to the one underneath Chromatic, would be underneath the player.

Astral_Legendarium.description: Astral : Legendarium was added in a mini update during Eon 1-4.5. It could've been rolled with a breakthrough rarity of 1 in 267,200,000 or a native rarity of 1 in 53,440,000 during Starfall, under the effects of the , or under the effects of the . Unfortunately, it is no longer obtainable, due to being replaced by Astral : Zodiac.
Astral_Legendarium.cutscene_note: === Opening Cutscene === The screen darkens and shows an orange star with a fire-like effect coming from behind it, ashes and rays coming from the bottom. A spinning crown like figure similar to the one in the player's head appears behind the star. After that, a pentagram-like figure pops 2 times, before ending the cut
Astral_Legendarium.appearance: When the player equipped Astral : Legendarium, the effects surrounding them would be similar to that of Gargantua, forming a large yellow orb structure, Gargantua's being a black hole and Astral : Legendarium 's being a quasar. The quasar sits behind, and on the left of the player, moving up and down with the, emitting a golden-yellow glow like the rest of the aura. The player floats in the same position as Astral, holding one hand upward with the other, downward, while floating above the center of the aura. With many small stars orbiting around the aura randomly, leaving behind a long-lasting golden trail, a yellow swirling effect, encapsulated by a golden, yellow ring, is below the player, like Astral, also having a glowing yellow center. Golden particles rise from the ground, and the particles in the middle of the aura rise higher than the rest, surrounding the player.

The_Rock.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
The_Rock.description: The Rock is a developer-exclusive aura and cannot be obtained from rolling. It was confirmed to be removed from the game along with ConstraintTest at some unknown period during the Era 5 Update.
The_Rock.appearance: The Rock consists of an image plastered over the player's face with no other effects. The image in question is that of Dwayne Johnson, (also referred to as "Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson") performing an action known as “[ The People’s Eyebrow]”. This image covers the player's face, and also covers some of the player's torso.

ConstraintTest.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
ConstraintTest.description: ConstraintTest is a developer-exclusive aura and cannot be obtained from rolling. It was confirmed to have been removed from the game along with a similar unused aura titled The Rock, at an unknown period during the Era 5 update.
ConstraintTest.appearance: ConstraintTest consists of a bluish-purple cross standing behind the player’s character, similar in appearance to Undead. Additionally, it has a faint blue portal effect beneath the player. The crucifix used in this version also features black outlines, just like the one seen in Undead.

Layers.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Layers.description: Layers is a developer-exclusive aura and can't be obtained from rolling. It was for the developer xcvbwer123.
Layers.appearance: Layers is a large aura with two massive glowing orbs alternating colors between red and blue in sync with the song. These orbs spin around the player along with two rings below the player. Every beat of the song, the color of the orbs and the rings will switch, and it creates a large shock-wave. This re-positions the player in a slightly different location. This aura also has the player floating far above the ground, in a manner somewhat similar to Chromatic : Exotic, though exaggerated greatly. The size of this aura is immense, so it is also very easy to spot.
Layers.lore: I want to beat this map ngl
