Stardust.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Stardust.description: Stardust is a developer-exclusive aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling.
Stardust.appearance: Above the player floats a large, light-blue star, surrounded by a semi-transparent black cloud, with white particles falling from it. Two rings of swirling light-blue and black aura surround the player, one floating at their torso, whilst the other rests near the ground. Additionally, below the player's feet is a blue, swirling portal effect, similar to Gravitational. It's very similar to Ethereal; their basic designs and themes seem to be almost exactly the same. {{Notes|1====Notes=== * This aura is currently being investigated as it may have been removed in Eon 1. |width=100|height=50}}

Therma.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Therma.description: Therma is a developer-exclusive aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling. As of now, this aura is bugged, which is why it is not currently in-game. However, this aura is being investigated as it may have been deleted in Eon 1.
Therma.appearance: When equipped, Therma grants the player a yellow, pulsating sigil on their back. It features a clock-like design, and two spinning orbs. While hovering above the ground, flames are emitted from the player's feet, propelling them into an idle animation where their limbs are more separated and their hand is raised to hold what seems to be a fireball, resembling the sun. Additionally, debris flies out from under the player into the air while ash pulses under their feet.
Therma.lore: A figure of light and heat, the epitome of energy that never meets the darkness, and in the darkest of moments, they did shine the brightest. Their thermal abilities were described to be comparable to the sparks of creation, Therma.

Sirius_unob.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)

Lunatic.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Lunatic.description: Lunatic is a removed aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling.
Lunatic.appearance: Lunatic shares similarities with Undefined. Lunatic grants the player a large glitch mark around their face, alongside a bold, pink "X" mark, and a scribbled censor. Additionally, Lunatic creates a large star around the base of the player, with lines flashing nearby. This aura has an explosion effect that occurs at regular intervals.
Lunatic.lore: A dazzling, incomplete one that has variable form. Anyone who encounters this becomes frantic.

Hallucination.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Hallucination.description: Hallucination is a removed aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling.
Hallucination.appearance: Hallucination’s appearance seems to be a light, faded tone of blue, with a visibly faded/transparent ring around the player that is constantly moving around them.

Duke.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Duke.description: Duke is a developer exclusive aura, and cannot be obtained through rolling.
Duke.appearance: Upon equipping, green circles rapidly appear around the player in a seemingly random sequence. This aura doesn't display its name when equipped.

Galaxy_Contact.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Galaxy_Contact.description: Galaxy Contact was added in the TBA Update.
Galaxy_Contact.appearance: Galaxy Contact has a glitchy effect appearing on the player's face, similar to Undefined and Defined, as well as a star above the player. The Star has a bright middle point with blue dust being emitted from it. You can also see blue lightning appearing around the star. The glitch effect that is being displayed on the players face has parts of it disappear and reappear somewhere else to give a glitch effect.

Stella.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Stella.description: Stella is a currently an Unobtainable aura which was intended to be obtained via purchasing group merchandise. However, this violated Roblox ToS, so the idea was scrapped and the aura was made developer-exclusive.
Stella.appearance: Stella appears to resemble a stereotypical witch. The player is riding a broom and dawns a hat on their head. This aura is a reference to an NPC with the same name, Stella, who is also a witch.
Stella.ability: Stella has an ability When used, the Stella plushie at the front will enlarge and shrink a bit, additionally making a squeaky pet toy sound.

Deepwoken.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Deepwoken.description: Deepwoken is a developer exclusive aura, likely made to test the PvP elements of the game.
Deepwoken.appearance: Deepwoken does not affect the player's avatar in any way, failing to provide an idle animation, particles, or models. This aura shares that trait with :smiro:.
Deepwoken.ability: The player raises their arms and parries an attack.

:smiro:.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)

Road_Trip.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Road_Trip.description: Road Trip is a developer-exclusive aura, and cannot be obtained from rolling. This is a developer-exclusive aura, making it completely unobtainable for normal players to obtain.
Road_Trip.appearance: The player is riding in a kid’s toy car, with their headlights on. The player rides in a cramped position, with their legs sticking outside the window to make space. Below the car, there is a small, arched, semi-transparent road. This road continuously loops, occasionally causing the toy car to bump up a little.

Stellar.obtainment: Removed / unavailable aura (not obtainable by rolling)
Stellar.description: Stellar was added in the August 2, 2025 Update together with Flow and Alchemist. It was intended to be obtainable by being an Aura Creator for Sol's RNG, but ended up getting removed because it "didn't fit the game and was too grainy".
Stellar.appearance: When you equip the Stellar Aura, a light black-purple mist appears beneath the player, with a light purple glowing rift running through the middle. The player themselves is depicted in a floating position. Above the player, a slightly moving, floating purple wave can be seen. There are also five small cross-like symbols connected to a brightly glowing sphere. Small stars also fall from the sky, leaving behind the symbol of a flower upon impact. A brightly glowing supernova circles the player.
